title: The Midterms Have Changed the Game. Now What?
content:
“It’s important to keep in mind that elections remove people, but they don’t remove infrastructure,” says Scot Nakagawa.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The midterms delivered a stunning rebuke of Trump and the MAGA movement, but what will it take to turn electoral victories into lasting change? In this episode of “Movement Memos,” host Kelly Hayes talks with anti-authoritarian strategist Scot Nakagawa about the opportunities and dangers of this political moment, the enduring power of tech oligarchs, and how movements can build the solidarity and infrastructure needed to defeat authoritarianism and transform our political culture.

Music: Son Monarcas, Dusty Decks, and Guustavv

Note: This a rush transcript and has been lightly edited for clarity. Copy may not be in its final form.

Kelly Hayes: Welcome to “Movement Memos,” a Truthout podcast about organizing, solidarity, and the work of making change. I’m your host, writer and organizer Kelly Hayes.

This week, we’re talking about what comes next after an extraordinary midterm election. In a striking rebuke of Trump, Democrats have won control of both houses of Congress, and won governor’s races in traditionally Republican states like Texas, Georgia, Iowa, and Ohio. Democrats also made down ballot gains, including taking control of the Texas State Board of Education and flipping ten state House seats in South Carolina. These wins came as a result of a massive early voting mobilization, which helped fuel a historic midterm voter turnout — leading some observers to dub this historic event the “No Kings” election.

Unfortunately, reactionaries also won some important victories, including ballot measures attacking trans people in multiple states. In Washington, for example, Initiative 638 restricts the participation of trans girls in grade school and high school athletics.

Where does it leave the tech oligarchs who pledged allegiance to Trump, and where should our movements go from here? To explore these questions, I spoke with Scot Nakagawa, executive director and co-founder of the 22nd Century Initiative and author of the Anti-Authoritarian Playbook. In this episode, we discuss the possibilities and dangers of this moment, and what it would take to build a democracy worthy of the name.

Truthout is an independent news organization, publishing stories that the craven corporate press won’t touch. We are a union shop with the best family and sick leave policies in the industry, and we could not do this work without the support of readers and listeners like you. So thank you for believing in us and for all that you do. And with that, I hope you enjoy the show.

Scot Nakagawa: Well, big question. I’m relieved. I feel, however, quite clear-eyed about the work ahead of us, but I mean, it’s good to have a week where the news is basically ours, and I just want to say I know how much work it took to get us to this point, and so I’m also thinking about the people who did it, who should be very proud of what they’ve accomplished.

So many people who leveraged the momentum of mass marches and community defense to make early voting a mass action. I’m holding all of those folks, and so many others, in my heart, as we sit down to discuss what this moment really means, and where these victories might help us go.

title: Şaredariyên Amedê starta xebatên xwe yên 25ê Mijdarê dan: "Demokratîkbûn tenê bi îradeya rêxistinkirî ya jinan mimkun e"
content:
Şaredariyên DEM Partî yên Amedê, ji bo 25ê Mijdarê Roja Têkoşîna Li Dijî Tundiya Li Ser Jinan li Parka Anîtê daxuyanî dan û starta çalakiyên xwe dan.


Di daxuyaniyê de pankarta “Bi hêza xwe û bi îradeya azad niha dema jinê ye” hate vekirin. Şaredarî, nûnerên rêxistinên jinan û gelek jin beşdar bûn û dirûşma “Jin, Jiyan, Azadî” hate berzkirin.


Daxuyanî bi Kurdî û Tirkî hate xwendin. Metna Kurdî ya daxuyaniyê ji aliyê Midûra Siyasetên Jinan a Şaredariya Peyasê Fatma Budak Guler ve, ya Tirkî jî ji aliyê Seroka Daîreya Siyasetên Jinan a Şaredariya Bajarê Mezin a Amedê Ozden Gurbuz Sumer ve hate xwendin.


Jinan di daxuyaniyê de tekez kirin ku jin ji bo jiyaneke ku ew dikarin bi ziman, çand û nasnameyên xwe yên dayikê bi azadî bijîn, parêzvaniyê dikin. Di daxuyaniyê de hat destnîşankirin ku demokratîkbûna Komarê û aştiya mayînde tenê bi îradeya rêxistinkirî ya jinan mimkun e.


"Em ê têkoşîna xwe li dijî her cûre tundkariyê mezin bikin"


Her weha di daxuyaniyê de hat gotin ji bo avakirina jiyaneke demokratîk, ekolojîk û rizgariya jinan a bi hev re têkoşîn didome û hat gotin:


"Îro, em destpêkirina çalakiyên xwe yên 25'ê Mijdarê radigihînin! Em ê li tax, kolan û gundan bi jinan re bicivin da ku dengê xwe yê hevpar û têkoşîna xwe li dijî her cûre tundûtûjiyê mezin bikin. Bi rêya kombûnên jinan, atolyeyan, çalakiyên hişyarkirinê û bûyerên hevgirtinê, em ê ezmûn, daxwaz û çareseriyên pêşniyarkirî yên jinan bikin kevirê bingehîn ê têkoşîna me ya hevpar. Bi hev re, em ê qadên ku jin dikarin bi azadî li ser jiyana xwe biryarê bidin, têkiliyên hevgirtinê xurt bikin û jiyana civakî bi îradeya xwe ya rêxistinkirî veguherînin zêde bikin."


Piştî daxuyaniyê, jinan belavok belav kirin û banga beşdarbûna meşa ku dê di 25'ê Mijdarê de saet di 17:30'an de li Çerxerêya Dinyayê were lidarxistin, kirin.


(AY)

Der Autoritarismus ist längst da – auch ganz ohne AfD – wenn die Änderungen am Informationsfreiheitsgesetz Frageportale wie ‚Frag den Staat‘ konkret angreifen 


Weniger staatliche Transparenz: Dobrindts Pläne sind „Angriff auf die Pressefreiheit“ 


„

Es gibt breiten Widerstand zu den Plänen des Innenministers, die Informationsfreiheit zu beschneiden. Die Journalismus-Gewerkschaft dju spricht von einem „Angriff auf die Pressefreiheit“, der Bundesdatenschutzbeauftragte hält die Pläne für „rechtlich bedenklich“. Der Widerstand gegen die jüngsten Pläne zur Einschränkung der Informationsfreiheit wächst. Kritik kommt unter anderem vom neuen Bundesdatenschutzbeauftragten, von Human Rights Watch und von Organisationen, die sich für Pressefreiheit einsetzen.


Es ist nicht der erste Vorstoß dieser Art. Bundesinnenminister Alexander Dobrindt (CSU) hatte bereits zuvor versucht, die Informationsfreiheit einzuschränken. Nachdem es gegen die ursprünglichen Pläne massiven Widerspruch bis in die SPD-Fraktion hinein gab, wählt das Ministerium nun einen anderen Ansatz, wie FragDenStaat berichtet. Demnach soll der Staat zum angeblichen Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur in vielen Bereichen Transparenz verweigern dürfen, wie aus dem Entwurf für ein „Transparenz-Anpassungsgesetz“ hervorgeht. Darunter fallen laut FragDenStaat Informationen zu den Bereichen Energie, Transport und Verkehr, Finanzwesen, Gesundheitswesen, Wasser, Ernährung, Informationstechnik und Telekommunikation. (…)


Darauf verweist auch Danica Bensmail, Bundesgeschäftsführerin der Deutschen Journalistinnen- und Journalisten-Union (dju) gegenüber netzpolitik.org: Bei Themen, die kritische Infrastruktur berührten, stünden Journalist:innen schon heute vor verriegelten Aktenschränken. „Wer Sicherheit als Vorwand nimmt, um Transparenz abzuschaffen, will sich scheinbar vor Kontrolle drücken. Journalist:innen von vornherein auszusperren ist ein direkter Angriff auf die Pressefreiheit.“ Bensmail verweist auch auf die Petition zum Erhalt der Informationsfreiheit, die derzeit mehr als 685.000 Unterschriften aufweist. „Der Gesetzentwurf muss in dieser Form vom Tisch. Wir fordern die Weiterentwicklung des IFG zu einem Transparenzgesetz

.“…“

Beitrag von Markus Reuter vom 10. November 2026 in Netzpolitik.org

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Judge to consider motion to dismiss lawsuit by Igloolik Inuit alleging harmful medical experiments
content:
This story was updated on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, at 11:52 a.m. ET.


A Nunavut judge will have to decide whether to hear or dismiss the claims of five Inuit who allege the federal government subjected them to medical experiments in Igloolik in the 1960s and 1970s.


Former Nunavut premier Paul Quassa, filmmaker Zacharias Kunuk, Lazarie Uttak, Lydia Inooya and the late artist Madeline Ivalu, who died in May, are suing the federal government for more than $1 million each in damages.


But lawyers representing the federal government and three universities appeared in the Nunavut Court of Justice before Justice Mark Mossey this week to argue

the 2019 lawsuit

 should be dismissed because it was brought too late.


“Applicable limitations periods under the limitations legislation in effect at the time have long since expired,” Chris Bernier, the federal government’s lawyer, wrote in a motion to the court in August 2025.


The federal government, University of Toronto, University of Manitoba, and University of Alberta are requesting a summary judgement, which if granted would prevent the case from going to trial.


The universities have also motioned to dismiss Canada’s third-party claims against them.


Steven Cooper, the plaintiffs’ lawyer, said Mossey is expected to decide by the end of the year. He said if his clients’ lawsuit is dismissed, it would set a harmful precedent.


“If this case is allowed … to be dismissed in this fashion, this will have an impact across the country, especially in the North,” he said in an interview Tuesday.


The five plaintiffs are among approximately 30 Inuit who say they underwent harmful experiments, including ones that included skin-grafting and ones that were aimed at evaluating their tolerance to extreme cold.


Court documents filed by the federal government’s lawyer note the universities were among the partners involved in the experiments, conducted under a research program called the International Biological Program.


“Our position to the court was simply that the conditions in the North, the knowledge of the plaintiffs, and the law as it stands all suggest that this has to go to trial,” Cooper said. “The world of Igloolik in the ’60s and ’70s was very different than it is now, we have to be careful about applying southern case law to northern realities.”


A spokesperson for the federal Justice Department said it couldn’t comment on the government’s motion for dismissal, saying the Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs departments would be better suited. Spokespeople for the departments were not immediately available to comment. The representative for Crown-Indigenous Relations mentioned the Remembrance Day holiday.


The three universities involved are not targeted by his clients’ 2019 lawsuit, Cooper noted. They came in as third parties, and filed motions alongside the federal government last August to dismiss the case.


Cooper said he believes lawyers for the federal government persuaded the universities to join the legal dispute as a delay tactic.


Nunatsiaq News reached out to the three universities and the lawyers representing them for comment. Only the University of Alberta did not respond.


Janesca Kydd, lawyer for the University of Manitoba, said that the university is not a defendant in the case and that it denies being involved in the experiments. She declined to comment further as the matter remains before the courts.


An unnamed spokesperson for the University of Toronto said its researchers “were not involved in the research at issue.”


“The Government of Canada […] provided the University of Toronto and other universities with a notice of Third-Party Claim,” the university wrote in a statement. “The University of Toronto disputes Canada’s claim against it.”


Cooper said the federal government’s actions go against the spirit of a 2021 civil litigation directive by the former Attorney General of Canada Jody Wilson-Raybould, which noted limitations should be pleaded only in exceptional cases when dealing with historical abuses brought forward by Indigenous Peoples.


Update:

 

This story has been updated to include comment from the University of Manitoba and the University of Toronto. It has also been updated to include the fact that the universities have motioned to dismiss Canada’s third-party claims against them.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Relatives of Slain Freedom Summer Activists Celebrate Scott Colom's Historic Senate Win in Mississippi
content:
Democrat Scott Colom has defeated incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith to become Mississippi’s first African American senator since the post-Civil War Reconstruction era. The electoral breakthrough is particularly meaningful given Mississippi’s history in the civil rights movement. In 1964, three civil rights activists — James Chaney, Michael Schwerner and Andrew Goodman — were murdered by the Ku Klux Klan after traveling to the state to register Black voters. We speak with two of their relatives about Colom’s stunning upset.


“I believe that people were voting for help. And they evidently saw something in Mr. Colom that made them feel like that they could hope again and that he was the help that was needed,” says Angela Lewis, the daughter of James Chaney.


“The people of Mississippi have spoken,” adds David Goodman, the brother of Andrew Goodman. “And we have to cease and desist this divide-and-conquer business, because it’s not in our collective interest as the United States of America.”

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Scott Colom Wins Stunning Victory, Becomes Mississippi's First Black Senator Since Reconstruction
content:
Democrat Scott Colom has made history as Mississippi’s first Democratic senator since 1982 — and its first African American senator since the post-Civil War Reconstruction era. Colom narrowly defeated Republican incumbent Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in a state that President Trump won by nearly 23 points in 2024. Colom’s victory brings the incoming Senate Democratic caucus to 55. Colom gave his victory speech on Wednesday at the historically Black Tougaloo College, just miles from where civil rights activist Medgar Evers was murdered in 1963 by a member of the Ku Klux Klan.


“There were times that I couldn’t get donors to answer the phone; they did not believe a moment like this was possible. But I kept the faith,” said Colom. “There are so many people that had faith in Mississippi at times where it seemed impossible, people like Medgar Evers.”

author: infolibre
title: Μαζικές διαδηλώσεις στην Ισπανία για τη στεγαστική κρίση και το αυξημένο κόστος ζωής
content:
Εκατοντάδες χιλιάδες πολίτες και εργαζόμενοι διαδήλωσαν στην πρώτη γενική απεργία μετά από 14 χρόνια σε όλη την Ισπανία, με βασικό αίτημα το δικαίωμα στη στέγαση και την αύξηση μισθών. Τα συνδικάτα ανεβάζουν τη συμμετοχή σε περίπου

4 εκατομμύρια

, ενώ όπως

σημειώνει

 η CGT πραγματοποιήθηκαν 2.500 πικετοφορίες σε μια μαζική και άνευ προηγουμένου κινητοποίηση, με πρωτοφανή καταστολή από πλευράς της αστυνομίας. Ιδιαίτερα μεγάλη συμμετοχή καταγράφηκε στην

 Καταλονία

 και την

Ανδαλουσία,

με δυναμικές διαδηλώσεις σε Μαδρίτη, Βαρκελώνη και σε περισσότερες από 50 πόλεις, παρά τις άσχημες καιρικές συνθήκες (καταιγίδα Charles) που οδήγησαν σε ακύρωση των απογευματινών πορειών που είχαν προγραμματιστεί στις πόλεις Σεβίλλη, Κόρδοβα, Κάντιθ και Ουέλβα.


Αυτή η άνευ προηγουμένου γενική απεργία,  η οποία καλέστηκε λιγότερο από

τρεις εβδομάδες πριν από τις βουλευτικές εκλογές της 29ης Νοεμβρίου,

 ξεκίνησε ως απάντηση στην κρίση στέγασης —που σημαδεύτηκε από την έξωση της

Maricarmen Abascal

, μιας 87χρονης γυναίκας, η οποία εκδιώχθηκε από το σπίτι όπου ζούσε επί περισσότερες από επτά δεκαετίες, μετά από αύξηση του ενοικίου της. Πέθανε λίγες ημέρες αργότερα.


Η υπόθεσή της έγινε σύμβολο της στεγαστικής κρίσης και πυροδότησε ένα κύμα διαμαρτυριών και καταλήψεων δημόσιων χώρων.


Κοινό μέτωπο


Στη γενική απεργία της 11ης Νοεμβρίου συμμετείχαν οι συνδικαλιστικές οργανώσεις της χώρας, CCOO (Comisiones Obreras), η UGT (Unión General de Trabajadores), η CNT, η CGT, η Co.Bas και άλλες συνδικαλιστικές και κοινωνικές οργανώσεις, καθώς και τα συνδικάτα ενοικιαστών. Παρά τις διαφορές τους, οι οργανώσεις αυτές βρέθηκαν σε

κοινό μέτωπο

 για τη

γενική απεργία,

 αν και η συνεργασία δεν ήταν παντού ομαλή. Στη Σαραγόσα, για παράδειγμα, η CGT, η CNT και το Συνδικάτο Ενοικιαστών πραγματοποίησαν ξεχωριστή πορεία από εκείνη των CCOO και UGT.


Η συμμετοχή CGT, CNT και των μεγάλων συνδικαλιστικών οργανώσεων σε μια κοινή γενική απεργία δείχνει ότι υπάρχει δυνατότητα συγκρότησης ευρύτερων κοινωνικών και εργατικών μετώπων. Ταυτόχρονα, οι αντιθέσεις που εμφανίστηκαν αποκαλύπτουν ένα διαχρονικό πρόβλημα του συνδικαλιστικού κινήματος, του πώς μπορεί δηλαδή να συνεργάζεται με ευρύτερες πολιτικές και κοινωνικές δυνάμεις χωρίς να χάνει την αυτονομία και τον ταξικό του χαρακτήρα.


Για την

 CGT,

 το πραγματικό διακύβευμα δεν είναι μόνο η επιτυχία μιας απεργίας, αλλά η

οικοδόμηση ενός κινήματος ικανού να συνεχίσει τον αγώνα και την επόμενη ημέρα και να ενισχύσει τη δυνατότητα συλλογικής δράσης.

It is the country’s first general strike in 14 years, called by Spain’s two largest unions, UGT and CCOO.

author: Mag
title: Rechte Strukturen bei (Bremer) Feuerwehr aufgedeckt
content:
Dossier


„… In der Bremer Feuerwehr sind rechtsextreme Strukturen aufgedeckt worden. Staatsschutz und Verfassungsschutz ermittelten nun, wie weit die Strukturen reichten (…) Die Vorwürfe umfassten zwei Komplexe: Im ersten gehe es um rechtsextreme und rassistische Bilder, die in der privaten Chatgruppe einer Wachabteilung verteilt wurden, in einem zweiten Komplex gehe es um frauenfeindliche und sexistische Vorfälle auf einer anderen Wache. (…) Ein Rechercheteam von Radio Bremen, dem NDR und der „Süddeutschen Zeitung“ hatte bei eigenen Recherchen herausgefunden, dass einzelne Feuerwehrleute sich bei ihren direkten Vorgesetzten beschwert hätten, dies aber zu nichts geführt habe. Knorr bestätigte dies. Es sei damit zu rechnen, das auch Vorgesetzte von den Chats wussten, sie zumindest tolerierten, möglicherweise auch selbst daran beteiligt waren.“


Meldung vom 25. November 2020 im MiGAZIN


 – siehe leider auch andere Städte:


Rechte Musik und Freiheitsberaubung: Polizeiermittlung nach schweren Vorwürfe und Strafanzeige nach Zeltlager der Jugendfeuerwehr Biederitz in Sachsen-Anhalt


Polizei ermittelt nach Jugendfeuerwehren-Zeltlager in Eisleben


„

Ein Zeltlager von Jugendfeuerwehren vom August dieses Jahres beschäftigt aktuell die Polizei im Süden des Landes. Den Angaben nach ermitteln die Beamten gegen sieben Betreuer des Zeltlagers. Sie sollen unter anderem ein Kind an einen Stuhl gefesselt haben. (…) Wie die Volksstimme (€) berichtet, sollen Kinder der Jugendfeuerwehren aus Biederitz und Heyrothsberge im Sommerzeltlager mit rechter Musik geweckt worden sein. Zudem sei ein Kind gegen seinen Willen an einen Stuhl gefesselt worden. Details zu den Vorfällen teilte die Polizei nicht mit, da die Ermittlungen aktuell noch laufen

…“

Beitrag von MDR SACHSEN-ANHALT vom 10.11.2026

 


Biederitz: Schwerwiegende Vorwürfe nach Feuerwehr-Zeltlager in Eisleben – Erste Feuerwehrleute suspendiert


„Nach einem Jugendfeuerwehr-Zeltlager im Landkreis Mansfeld-Südharz stehen schwerwiegende Vorwürfe gegen Betreuer der Ortsfeuerwehren Biederitz und Heyrothsberge im Raum. Nach Recherchen unserer Redaktion ermittelt das Polizeirevier Jerichower Land wegen des Verdachts der Freiheitsberaubung, Nötigung, des Abspielens rechtsradikaler Musik, des Zeigens des Hitlergrußes sowie der Verletzung der Fürsorge- und Erziehungspflicht. Die Existenz der Ermittlungen und die vorliegenden schriftlichen Dokumente wurden unserer Redaktion von offizieller kommunaler Seite bestätigt.


Nach eigenen Recherchen unserer Redaktion aus verlässlichen Kreisen wurden vor Ort bereits drastische personelle Konsequenzen gezogen. Insgesamt sollen sechs betroffene Einsatzkräfte der Feuerwehr mit sofortiger Wirkung für die Dauer der laufenden Ermittlungen von ihren Aufgaben entbunden und ruhend gestellt worden sein.


Die Vorwürfe im Detail


Grundlage der Ermittlungen sind Vorkommnisse während des siebentägigen Sommerlagers in Eisleben. Dort sollen Kinder unter anderem mit rechtsradikaler Musik geweckt und ein Kind gegen seinen Willen an einen Stuhl gefesselt worden sein. Zudem stehen das Zeigen des Hitlergrußes sowie erheblicher Alkoholkonsum unter den Betreuern im Raum.


Die Vorsitzende des Kreisfeuerwehrverbandes im Exklusiv-Gespräch: „Keine Vorverurteilung, aber lückenlose Aufklärung

“…“

Meldung vom 10.11.2026 in meetingpoint-jl.de

 


Vorwürfe bestätigt: Rassistische Äußerungen bei der Berliner Jugendfeuerwehr


„… Nachwuchskräfte der Berliner Feuerwehr sollen in einer Chatgruppe extremistische Äußerungen gepostet haben. „Die Berliner Feuerwehr wurde darüber informiert, dass es in einer Chatgruppe im Umfeld einer Jugendfeuerwehr, zu Äußerungen in Sprache und Bild gekommen sein soll, die inhaltlich in keiner Weise mit den Grundwerten und dem Selbstverständnis unserer Organisation vereinbar sind“, hieß es in einer Mitteilung. Der Extremismusbeauftragte der Berliner Feuerwehr bestätigte inzwischen die Vorwürfe. Es handele sich um „rassistische Aussagen“ und um Äußerungen gegen andere Mitglieder, sagte Ruben Obenhaus der RBB-„Abendschau“. Die Äußerungen seien in keiner Weise mit den Grundwerten und dem Selbstverständnis der Feuerwehr vereinbar, betonte Obenhaus. Feuerwehrsprecher Vinzenz Kasch sagte, entsprechend werde seine Organisation dagegen vorgehen. Details nannte er jedoch nicht. title: Μικροφωνική διεκδίκησης για το πάρκο Βελισσαρίου, την Πέμπτη 12/11, 18.00, στο Δημαρχείο Ιωαννίνων
content:
Κάλεσμα/Αφίσα από το

Συντονιστικό για το Πάρκο Βελισσαρίου:


Μικροφωνική διεκδίκησης στο Δημαρχείο για το πάρκο Βελισσαρίου και προπαγάνδισης της πορείας την Παρασκευή 13 Νοέμβρη στις 6 μ.μ. Προσυγκέντρωση στην Περιφέρεια Ηπείρου


ΒΕΛΙΣΣΑΡΙΟ ΑΣΤΙΚΟ ΠΑΡΚΟ


ΑΝΑΨΥΧΗΣ & ΠΟΛΙΤΙΣΜΟΥ


ΟΧΙ ΣΤΗΝ ΤΣΙΜΕΝΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ


Απευθύνουμε κάλεσμα για δημιουργία ενός ενωτικού αγωνιστικού μετώπου για να διεκδικήσουμε ώστε ο χώρος του στρατοπέδου Βελισσαρίου να περάσει στην ιδιοκτησία του Δήμου και να μετατραπεί σε ένα Πάρκο Πολιτισμού και Αναψυχής, και να εμποδίσουμε τα σχέδια της τσιμεντοποίησης.


Η δημιουργία ενός Αστικού Πάρκου Αναψυχής και Πολιτισμού στην έκταση του στρατοπέδου Βελισσαρίου είναι η τελευταία ευκαιρία για την πόλη να ανασάνει με ένα αντίβαρο στην αιθαλομίχλη και στα καυσαέρια. Είναι η τελευταία ευκαιρία για τη δημιουργία ενός χώρου που θα είναι διέξοδος για τη νεολαία και τους εργαζόμενους/ες για δραστηριότητες πολιτισμού, αναψυχής και ξεκούρασης. Είναι η τελευταία ευκαιρία για την πόλη να αποκτήσει χαρακτήρα ανθρώπινο και φιλικό προς τους κατοίκους της.


Σημειωτέον ότι σήμερα τα Γιάννενα βρίσκονται στον «πάτο» (στην 755η θέση ανάμεσα σε 761 ευρωπαϊκές πόλεις) από άποψη ποιότητας του αέρα σύμφωνα με τον ευρωπαϊκό οργανισμό περιβάλλοντος


Οι εξελίξεις μέχρι τώρα δείχνουν ότι ο αγώνας για τη διεκδίκηση ενός τέτοιου αυτονόητου αιτήματος αντιμετωπίζει εμπόδια, για τους εξής λόγους:


Έχουμε μια κυβέρνηση που φαίνεται να έχει αποφασίσει την τσιμεντοποίηση του Βελισσαρίου. Ο πρωθυπουργός, στα Γιάννενα υπόσχεται να παραχωρήσει την έκταση του στρατοπέδου Βελισσαρίου στο Δήμο αλλά στην Διεθνή έκθεση Θεσσαλονίκης μάς είπε ότι προγραμματίζει να οικοδομήσει κατοικίες για το στρατό. Σε επερώτηση στη Βουλή από τον τοπικό βουλευτή του ΚΚΕ, ο υφυπουργός Εθνικής άμυνας ήταν πιο καθαρός.


Το 45% της έκτασης θα το χρησιμοποιήσει ο στρατός για εκμετάλλευση κατοικιών. Το άλλο 25% θα το δεσμεύσουν για δρόμους και κοινόχρηστους χώρους, το υπόλοιπο 30% για το Δήμο, που ακόμα και σε αυτό σχεδιάζουν διοικητικά κτίρια. Είναι φανερό ότι τα σχέδια της τωρινής κυβέρνησης είναι για τσιμεντοποίηση του χώρου για συμφέροντα real estate. Θλιβερή συμπόρευση με τα κυβερνητικά σχέδια τσιμεντοποίησης του χώρου έχουν και οι τοπικοί βουλευτές της ΝΔ.


Έχουμε μια Δημοτική Αρχή που κρύβεται και αποφεύγει να πάρει ενεργή θέση για το ζήτημα. Το θέμα του Βελισσαρίου έρχεται για συζήτηση στο Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο μετά από ασφυκτική πίεση και μάζεμα υπογραφών από τους πολίτες. Η Δημοτική Αρχή το συζητάει και στην ουσία «νίπτει τας χείρας της». Η επωδός όλων των παρατάξεων είναι «καλό είναι να παραχωρηθεί στο Δήμο αλλά τι μπορούμε να κάνουμε;» καμία διάθεση διεκδίκησης. Το αντίθετο μάλιστα. Στις προθέσεις τους είναι να «αξιοποιήσουν» το χώρο, εάν και όποιο κομμάτι δοθεί στο Δήμο, για κτίρια, διοικητήριο, κλπ. Ένας χώρος που αποτελεί δημόσια περιουσία και ανήκει στους γιαννιώτες και μπορεί να αποτελέσει πνεύμονα πρασίνου και χώρος αναψυχής και πολιτισμού αντιμετωπίζεται από τη δημοτική αρχή με τα «γυαλιά» της «αξιοποίησης» και «τσιμεντοποίησης».


Για την περιφέρεια του κ. Καχριμάνη ούτε λόγος. Πάντα πιστός στις κυβερνητικές επιλογές. Το τραγικό, και γελοίο μαζί, της υπόθεσης είναι ότι όλοι αυτοί, Δήμαρχοι, Περιφερειάρχης, Δημοτικοί Σύμβουλοι είναι τάχα ευαισθητοποιημένοι για την αιθαλομίχλη που πνίγει την πόλη. Υποκρισία σε όλο της το μεγαλείο.


Ταυτόχρονα φαίνεται καθαρά η μη ύπαρξη βούλησης τόσο από το υπουργείο όσο και από το Δήμο για να ενταχθεί η έκταση του Στρατοπέδου Βελισσαρίου στο Τοπικό Πολεοδομικό Σχέδιο. Είναι και αυτό μια ακόμη απόδειξη της προσπάθειας τσιμεντοποίησης του χώρου παρά τα κούφια λόγια που λέγονται


Είναι λοιπόν φανερό ότι ο αγώνας για να περάσει το Στρατόπεδο Βελισαρίου στο Δήμο και να ματαιωθούν τα σχέδια τσιμεντοποίησης του χώρου, πέφτει στις πλάτες των εργαζομένων, της νεολαίας, και γενικά των κατοίκων της πόλης που απαιτούμε μια πόλη


ανθρώπινη και φιλική στους κατοίκους της. Στα πλαίσια αυτού του αγώνα και της συγκρότησης ενός ενωτικού αγωνιστικού μετώπου διεκδίκησης του χώρου του στρατοπέδου Βελισσαρίου και δημιουργία Αστικού Πάρκου Πολιτισμού και Αναψυχής απευθύνουμε κάλεσμα συμμετοχής στις εκδηλώσεις και δραστηριότητες που οργανώνει το ΣΥΝΤΟΝΙΣΤΙΚΟ ΣΥΛΛΟΓΙΚΟΤΗΤΩΝ και ΠΟΛΙΤΩΝ.


Καλούμε την Παρασκευή 13 Νοέμβρη στις 6:00 το απόγευμα, στην Περιφέρεια, σε Συγκέντρωση – Πορεία για διεκδίκηση του ΠΑΡΚΟΥ μας.


Το ΣΥΝΤΟΝΙΣΤΙΚΟ συνεδριάζει ανοικτά κάθε Τρίτη 6μμ στον ΑΚΟΙΧΙ, προγραμματίζοντας δράσεις για την διεκδίκηση του χώρου του …

author: Kay Pacha / Equipo Pueblos Originarios del SERPAJ
title: México y la educación intercultural bilingue
content:
Tenemos el agrado de contar con el testimonio de la hermana del Pueblo Mixe de Oaxaca, México, Florinda Martina Jiménez, docente intercultural, que participó del VII Congreso de la Red de Formadores en Educación e Interculturalidad de América Latina (Red FEIAL) que se realizó en la sede del Suteba del Delta de Tigre.


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Micro-Kay-Pacha-Florencia-.mp3


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Micro-Kay-Pacha-Florencia-.mp3


Descargar audio


Del 28 al 30 de octubre pasado se llevó a cabo el VII Congreso de la Red de Formadores en Educación e Interculturalidad de América Latina (Red FEIAL) en la sede de SUTEBA del Delta de Tigre.


Esta Red de Formadores en Educación e Interculturalidad de América Latina (Red FEIAL) es una red internacional y académica de investigadores, educadores, antropólogos, lingüistas y formadores de docentes de distintos países de la región, y en esta oportunidad su lema fue: “Derechos en tensión: vulneraciones, resistencias y re-existencias en los contextos actuales”.


Los ejes temáticos abordados fueron, Lenguas en contacto en la educación, prácticas docentes innovadoras, migraciones y territorios de frontera, derechos humanos, artes comunitarias, TIC e inteligencia artificial en la educación digital, ambiente y justicia climática, y un eje destacado sobre Interculturalidad, cuidados y salud (articulación entre sistemas médicos hegemónicos y saberes ancestrales).


Cabe destacar que esta red nació en 2013 en México, impulsada originalmente por un grupo de académicos bajo el liderazgo de la educadora y antropóloga María Bertely Busquets y con el fin de promover espacios de diálogo, reflexión, investigación e intercambio de experiencias en torno a la educación intercultural, con un enfoque crítico que contempla dimensiones culturales, de clase y de género.


Y en esta oportunidad participaron investigadores, docentes y referentes provenientes de distintos lugares de Argentina, Brasil, México, Perú, Chile, Venezuela y Colombia, entre otros países de la región, y nosotras hoy tenemos el agrado de contar entonces con el testimonio de la hermana del Pueblo Mixe de Oaxaca, México, Florinda Martina Jiménez, docente intercultural y que nos va a explicar con más detenimiento sobre la Red y sobre la realidad de las lenguas en su país.Mexico y la educacion bilingue interciultural


El Micro Kay Pacha se realiza con el apoyo de la organización Otto per Mille-Chiessa Valdense.

México y la educación intercultural bilingue

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Israel Kills Doctor and Patients Awaiting Surgery in Gaza Hospital Airstrike
content:
An Israeli airstrike on one of the largest hospitals in Gaza has killed at least six Palestinians, including a prominent surgeon, and wounded more than 30 others. 


The attack on the Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza took place in the early hours of Thursday, local media and Gaza’s health ministry reported.


The doctor killed has been named Dr Rizq Abu Shaeira, and described by Al Jazeera as “a significant and prominent surgeon”. 


The airstrike directly hit the surgical department and caused significant damage to the facility’s intensive care wards, according to the hospital’s director Raed al-Dahshan, who added that the death toll is expected to rise.


A nurse working a night shift at the hospital

said it was “terrifying”

, adding: “‘I saw patients trapped under the rubble and colleagues injured. We lost some of the patients I had been caring for.”


“Most of those killed and injured were patients, including people who were scheduled to undergo surgery the following day,” Al Jazeera’s Gaza correspondent

Hind Khoudary reported

. 


“This is one of the largest hospitals in the Gaza Strip and the only hospital still standing in Khan Younis, serving at least 500,000 people in southern Gaza.”


The Israeli Defence Forces (IDF) claimed it was targeting a

“Hamas brigade commander”

 in the hospital.


This latest airstrike on Nasser Medical Complex is believed to be the seventh time it has been struck by Israel over the past three years. 


Israel has destroyed or damaged every single hospital in Gaza since October 2023 in a systematic campaign targeting healthcare infrastructure and medical staff.


Medical Aid for Palestinians is calling on the UK government to sanction Israel and suspend all arms transfers to the state, saying “there must be consequences for those responsible for the destruction of Gaza’s healthcare system”. 


Israeli attacks have killed another seven Palestinians across the Strip in recent days, including children, in what has been described as the indiscriminate targeting of civilians. 


Despite a US-brokered ‘ceasefire’ being in place since October 2025, Israel has continued to carry out near-daily attacks on Gaza with impunity, killing at least 1,600 people in the past year. 


Israeli attacks continue as Gaza’s displaced population is faced with catastrophic winter conditions, with heavy rain affecting more than 106,000 people, causing tents and makeshift shelters to flood and latrines to overflow. 


The Israeli military has systematically destroyed life-sustaining infrastructure, including Gaza’s sewage network, over three years of genocide. Israel maintains full control of Gaza’s borders and continues to restrict the entry of essential aid.


Around 950,000 Palestinians are forced to live in areas at medium or high risk of flooding and almost the entire population of Gaza needs shelter and other humanitarian assistance, according to

Medical Aid for Palestinians

.

title: Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik: We must fight the roots of violence against women
content:
Writer Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik spoke to ANF on the occasion of 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, highlighting the direct relationship between the women's struggle and social peace, as well as the connection between male violence and state violence. Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik discussed women's struggle to become active subjects in the process of bringing Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan's Call for Peace and Democratic Society of 27 February 2025 into society, as well as the struggle that must be waged against policies of impunity.


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik said that the Women's Initiative I Need Peace, of which she is a member, was established to bring Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan's Call for Peace and Democratic Society of 27 February 2025 into society and discuss how women could become active subjects in this process. She stated that, as efforts to build social support for peace continue, state violence against women throughout the 40 years of war remains one of the most urgent issues they face.


'Male domination persists under every ruling system'


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik said that women were discussing not only the future but also the past, summarizing the historical transformation of male domination as follows: "Femicide and male violence against women, which continue to exist in human life, have been the most visible manifestations of male domination since its emergence. At the same time, we know that male domination has become a system in its own right, infiltrating and becoming embedded in every dimension of economic, social and political life, regardless of the system in place, and maintaining its existence under every ruling order. This is the reality from which we proceed."


'The same reality lies behind domestic violence and state violence'


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik stated that the state is the structure that governs on behalf of the ruling powers in today's world, pointing out that the same state structure stands behind violence, protects male perpetrators through the judiciary and grants reductions in their sentences.


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik recalled that women's bodies and sexuality were targeted through sexual torture and massacres during the 40 years of war, saying, "The same reality lies behind the violence directed at a woman murdered by her husband at home or shot in the street by her ex-husband, and the sexual aggression women encounter at the hands of state police officers, soldiers, village guards or counterterrorism units. And we women are still struggling against this as one of our most fundamental issues."


'Musa Orhan's acquittal is a major cause for outrage'


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik strongly condemned the acquittal of Specialist Sergeant Musa Orhan in the case in which he was tried on charges of aggravated sexual assault, emphasizing that a policy of impunity had been implemented despite Ipek Er explicitly identifying the perpetrator in a letter before taking her own life. She recalled that women, journalists, filmmakers and writers who protested against this situation had been punished. Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik said, "While state officials are treated with extraordinary privilege, a murderer like Musa Orhan can be acquitted. There is no more striking example that illustrates the situation so clearly. Above all, this is a major cause for outrage."


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik stressed that this situation must occupy a central place in the upcoming 25 November mobilizations against violence against women. She called for all femicides covered up by the state to become a central focus of the struggle, particularly the Gülistan Doku case, which she said had been covered up by a network responsible for murder operating around the governor's office.


'Making people compete over their suffering is a state policy'


Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik said that an end to the conflicts would mean that massacres, torture and rape would cease and that this reality would become publicly acknowledged. She also stated that peace would lift the nationalist barriers obstructing class struggle. Pointing out that the 2027 budget had once again been prepared as a "war budget", with no allocation for women, Mukaddes Erdoğdu Çelik assessed the process as follows: "We need to stand side by side. title: Pascal Torre: Doubts will persist until Abdullah Öcalan is freed
content:
The discussions surrounding a democratic solution to the Kurdish question continue as part of the process initiated by Abdullah Öcalan's Call for Peace and Democratic Society. The legal and political steps that the Turkish state must take, as well as the responsibilities of the international community, remain on the agenda. Despite the decision by the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) to dissolve itself, the continued imprisonment of Öcalan, the situation of political prisoners and the lack of concrete steps towards recognizing the political and cultural rights of the Kurdish people remain central issues in discussions about the future of the process.


Pascal Torre, co-chair of the France-Kurdistan Association and a historian, spoke to ANF about the Peace and Democratic Society Process, the importance of Abdullah Öcalan's freedom for lasting peace and Europe's responsibilities in this process.


Torre emphasized that lasting peace is only possible through democratization and criticized the Turkish state's security-oriented approach to the process. He said that Öcalan's freedom is crucial for advancing peace negotiations and implementing any potential agreement. Torre also criticized the silence of France and the European Union, arguing that the Council of Europe must adopt a more determined stance towards Turkey.


Torre stressed that Öcalan's release would be an important indication of Turkey's commitment to peace, saying, "As long as Abdullah Öcalan is not released, doubts will persist about Turkey's willingness to bring this process to a conclusion."


The interview with historian Pascal Torre follows:


Efforts to find a democratic solution to the Kurdish question continue following Abdullah Öcalan

's call on 27 February 2025. How do you assess the process at its current stage? What do you think are the fundamental conditions for achieving lasting peace?


This is an extremely important process and, if it succeeds, although we are still quite far from that, it could mark the beginning of a new era. However, I would like to point out that this process is not entirely new. The Kurdish Movement and Abdullah Öcalan have been putting forward various proposals aimed at achieving lasting peace for many years.


Nevertheless, I believe that extremely important ideological and strategic innovations have taken place within the Kurdish movement. These innovations stem primarily from the conditions of armed struggle. But they also stem, above all, from the clearly expressed political will to find a solution, which has existed for a long time.


Secondly, there is the international situation, which is influencing this process today. So yes, this process could represent an extremely important development. However, to understand what is happening today, I believe we need to return to several fundamental points.


The political and cultural rights of the Kurds have not been recognized for decades. This lies at the root of the problems facing the Kurdish people as a whole. Through their struggle and at enormous cost, the Kurds have managed to overcome their marginalized position and become important actors in the states where they live and across the region. It is necessary to emphasize once again the extremely important role played by the PKK in this regard. However, as Abdullah Öcalan has stated, the PKK's historical mission has now come to an end.


'There can be no peace without democratization'


For many years, the PKK provided a guarantee for the Kurdish people. Today, however, it may be regarded as a source of vulnerability. As Abdullah Öcalan rightly stated, the era of non-state armed organizations is now over. The enormous political gains achieved by the Kurdish people through great struggles must now be transformed into institutional influence that will ensure the recognition of their rights and, above all, the fundamental democratization of Turkey.


These two issues cannot be considered separately. There can be no peace without democratization. In my view, this is the entire significance of Abdullah Öcalan's extremely important call. This call also responds to the fundamental issues of our time.


As you have pointed out, despite this peace process, Kurdish People's Leader Abdullah Öcalan remains imprisoned, and there has been no fundamental change in his legal situation. title: Tracing the footsteps of martyrs in Qendîl - I
content:
The absence of someone who has not been heard from for years remains a constant presence in the lives of those left behind. Families continue living, sometimes with the hope that their loved one will return one day, sometimes with an old photograph, and sometimes with unanswered questions. Not hearing from someone for years and learning that they are no longer alive do not evoke the same feelings. As time passes, children grow up, parents grow old, and some die without ever receiving the news they have been waiting for. The name of the missing person continues to live on in conversations, memories and the possibility that they might one day return. Whenever the possibility of peace begins to be discussed again, hopes that those who have been missing for so long might return also grow stronger.


The recent announcements of martyrdom came at such a time. Condolence gatherings were held in different cities, photographs kept for years were brought out, and the lives of the martyrs were recounted. Some families had already heard of their loved ones' martyrdom and had been waiting for official confirmation. Others received the news for the first time after years of uncertainty. Some wanted to understand the reasons for the delay. Others wanted to know about their loved ones' final days, where and with whom they had lost their lives, and whether they had a grave.


We spoke to Munzur Diyar, a member of the Martyrs' Studies Committee, in Qendîl (Qandil) about the establishment of the martyrs' cemeteries, the reasons why announcements of martyrdom were delayed and efforts to reach families. Before explaining how information about martyrs is collected and how families are contacted, Diyar takes us back to 1983. He traces the history of the martyrs' cemeteries in Qendîl to Mehmet Karasungur.


'We have come to collect what we entrusted to you'


At that time, Qendîl was an area where different Kurdish organizations were present. Karasungur was holding discussions with these organizations when he was martyred in an attack on 2 May 1983.


The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) began to become familiar with Qendîl during this period, and the area's significance grew following Karasungur's martyrdom. Following his death, Karasungur's body was entrusted to a villager named Sheikh Omar, who lived in the area.Those who handed over the body told him, "We are entrusting him to you. One day we will come back for him." Sheikh Omar, however, did not really believe them. He had previously encountered different organizations and seen bodies left behind. He thought that no one would return this time either. Fourteen years passed. In 1997, PKK members who arrived in Qendîl visited Sheikh Omarone night and asked about the body that had been entrusted to him years earlier: "We have come to collect what we entrusted to you."


The first martyrs' cemetery in Şehit Harun


Diyar says that the fact that the promise was remembered years later had a profound impact on the villagers. However, it was not immediately possible to retrieve the body. Several more years passed because of the fighting and security conditions in the area. In 2003, Karasungur's remains were taken from the grave in the villager's garden and transferred to one of the martyrs' cemeteries in Qendîl. In 2006, they were moved to the present central cemetery. The first martyrs' cemetery in Qendîl was established in 2001 in an area known as Şehit Harun. The Şehit Harun Martyrs' Cemetery was later renamed the Şehit Gulan-Şehit Simko Martyrs' Cemetery. As units stationed in different areas continued burying their fallen members where they were based, seven separate martyrs' cemeteries gradually emerged. When family visits increased in 2004 and 2005, reaching these cemeteries became increasingly difficult. Among those wishing to visit their children's graves were elderly mothers and fathers. Some cemeteries required a walk of one or two hours along mountain paths. 


Hundreds of guerrillas worked on the cemetery


A decision was therefore made to bring the graves together in one location. Hundreds of guerrillas worked on the construction of the Mehmet Karasungur Martyrs' Cemetery. Vehicles and construction machinery were limited at the time. Groups arrived to prepare graves and build paths before returning to other areas. Some of those who participated in the construction were martyred in subsequent years and buried in the very cemetery they had helped build.

author: CNT Valladolid
title: ¡Despotorre en Valladolid¡ Arriba el despotorre, abajo el facherio
content:
El fin de fiesta de las jornadas de inauguración del nuevo local de CNT en Valladolid fue la energía rebelde y contagiosa del espectáculo Despotorre, de las cómicas feministas y antifascistas Ane Lindane y Raquel Torres. Estuvieron con nosotras el sábado 24 de octubre, justo en medio de los preparativos de la huelga general del 11 de noviembre por la vivienda; y aunque no hace falta que nos den animo para luchar contra los usureros de la vivienda y sus aliados, podemos decir que este espectáculo sería suficiente para  inspirarnos ánimo de sobra.


Llenamos el local con la primera actuación en #Valladolid de estas cómicas, agotándose las reservas a los veinte minutos de ofrecerse públicamente. Casos como este o el de ‘No hay olvido ni sueño: carne viva’, que esa misma tarde enfrentaba el boicot made in fachadolid con absoluto éxito, demuestran que en la ciudad hay audiencia con demanda de actividades de arte combativo. ¡A ver si pronto Ane y Raquel pueden volver a Valladolid para más gente y con la tarima que merecen!


DESPOTORRE es un show de comedia salido directamente de nuestros mismísimos… corazones. Unidas en una visión feminista de la comedia y libres e irreverentes en el humor dan forma a éste espectáculo que no deja indiferente a nadie, sobre todo a los que no estén acostumbrados a ver a dos mujeres haciendo chistes, explicando por qué el machismo estriñe o lo difícil que es alcanzar los cánones físicos impuestos, pero sin parar de hacer reír al público. Durante casi 80 minutos puedes olvidarte de todo lo que te inquieta, te atormenta o te perturba, relajarte y dedicarte exclusivamente en reír –

 Así lo definen su espectáculo este pedazo no sólo de artistas, sino también de compañeras.


Compañeras que últimamente están sufriendo el intento de amedrantamiento de los empresarios de la vergüenza ajena made in Valladolid “Abogados Cristianos”, mediante querellas que pretenden censurarlas. Aprovechamos la ocasión para indicar nuestra solidaridad con las despotorres que están plantando cara a estos representantes de lo que toda la sociedad debe superar cuanto antes.


Ane y Raquel dijeron en sus redes que las agasajamos con nuestras risas durante el espectáculo. Ni que decir tiene que esas risas fueron absolutamente sinceras.


Compas, siempre en vuestro equipo, siempre antifascistas, siempre transfeministas.

author: CNT Santander
title: Seguimos en lucha
content:
A las 4:30h de la mañana de este 11 de noviembre, comenzamos de madrugada con los piquetes informativos en los que hicimos fuerza conjunta con CGT, CJS, Sindicato de Vivienda, Acampada de Vivienda de Cantabria, Las Calles contra el Fascismo, La Asamblea Antifascista y el PCTE. Conseguimos paralizar la salida de los autobuses del Polígono Industrial Candina, paramos el tráfico en diferentes puntos de la ciudad de Santander, en Valdecilla Sur, en Marqués de la Hermida; y al llegar a la estación frenamos la circulación. Fuimos recorriendo distintas calles a medida que avanzaba la mañana.


La convocatoria que organizamos a las 12:00h en Peña Herbosa ha sido un éxito. Más de 3.000 personas han caminado junto a nosotrxs.


Secundada por el Sindicato de Estudiantes de Cantabria y acompañadas por diferentes sindicatos y colectivos, (CGT, CJS, Sindicato de Vivienda, Acampada de Vivienda de Cantabria, STEC, Libres y Combativas, etc.), junto a personas que de manera individual han querido sumarse, la concentración resultó una marea de reivindicación y lucha obrera.


Tras la parada para comer colectivamente en nuestra sede y descansar para reponer energías, ya estamos preparadas para seguir luchando en la concentración de las 19:00h en Cuatro Caminos.


Acompañaremos al Sindicato de la Vivienda de Cantabria y la Acampada en su recorrido, con el resto de los colectivos con los que llevamos semanas trabajando, porque entendemos que la lucha colectiva llena más el corazón.


Hoy ha sido un paso firme en la reivindicación de una vivienda digna y accesible para todas, que incluya la defensa de las familias y las personas más vulnerables. Porque el acceso a la vivienda no es un privilegio como quieren que creamos, es un derecho al que no vamos a renunciar.


Cuando caminamos todas a una, con un mismo objetivo, somos visibles e imparables. Hoy, lo hemos demostrado. Ha quedado evidenciado durante toda la jornada de la mañana.


Gracias a todas las que nos han acompañado y luchado a nuestro lado.


Seguimos, con más fuerzas que nunca, para luchar por nuestros derechos y conquistar al sistema capitalista y patriarcal lo que nos pertenece.


¡Que viva la lucha de la clase obrera y del colectivo estudiantil!


¡Salud!

content:
Desde el Sindicato CNT Zaragoza valoramos muy positivamente la jornada de Huelga General que hemos vivido, o mejor dicho convivido, este 11 de Noviembre en nuestra ciudad.

El apoyo mostrado entre distintas organizaciones, el buen intercambio de experiencia y funciones

 – aún con cuestiones a pulir – ,

nos ha permitido llevar la lucha por toda Zaragoza durante toda la noche y el día, dejándonos un poso muy esperanzador en el porvenir de nuestra Clase Obrera

.


Empezando por

parar los camiones de FCC

 y ocupar la carretera de Castellón, nuestra ruta en Cogullada con empresas donde consigue victorias CNT – como

Cerma&Arriaxa

 -, informando a autobuseros de

Cerler

 y Trox, apoyando el piquete de los trabajadores de CAF, encontrándonos con el Bicipiquete por las calles, comprobando que al menos un 60% de la plantilla en

CityLogin

 (Amazon) no acudía a trabajar tras las labores de nuestra Sección Sindical… y acabando por esa enorme Manifestación, a pesar del cansancio y la lluvia, con

un Mitin final de las compañeras del Sindicato de Inquilinas del que CNT Zaragoza no cambiaríamos una coma

.


Basta de confiar en promesas de quienes usan nuestras luchas, victorias o derrotas, para apoyar en ellas su discurso político buscando ganar y gobernar en nuestro nombre. Sólo la Clase Obrera salvará a la Clase Obrera. Nuestro sindicato lo tiene claro.

Hoy hemos gritado hasta dejarnos la voz: viva la CNT, viva la lucha obrera, viva la lucha por la vivienda, y viva la Huelga General

.


Gracias a toda las compañeras y compañeros que lo han hecho posible, de CNT o del resto de Sindicatos y organizaciones de Zaragoza.

Nos veremos en el sindicato, nos veremos en las empresas, nos veremos en las calles. Porque la lucha es el único camino

author: Sofia Amaral
title: Os ventos que vêm dos EUA e o clima quente na COP31
content:
Nesta semana, acontece o evento mais importante para as negociações climáticas: a COP31, realizada na Turquia. No

Bom dia, fim do mundo

 desta semana, Isabel Seta, Marina Amaral e Ricardo Terto explicam o que está em jogo na Conferência deste ano e — spoiler: não é nada muito diferente dos anos anteriores, afinal, as negociações climáticas andam a passos de tartaruga, enquanto o aquecimento do planeta parece seguir de vento em popa. As

COPs

 ainda são, no entanto, a melhor aposta dos países para conter a emergência climática. Ruim com ela, pior sem ela? Com uma crise energética no horizonte e um El Niño que já faz estragos mundo afora, a melhor saída é apostar no multilateralismo — o que fica mais fácil após as eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA. Ouça agora.

Na Trombeta, corações partidos. E no quadro “Se é pra falar de economia…”, Eliane Barbosa fala de uma economia que continua degradando o planeta.

author: dialogocomospovos
title: Somos Mapuches
content:
A visita de Moira Millán, liderança mapuche, ao Assentamento Terra Vista marcou um importante momento de intercâmbio entre lutas indígenas e camponesas. O território do assentamento, fruto da luta do MST e reconhecido pelo protagonismo feminino e pela agroecologia, foi palco de duas atividades paralelas: o intercâmbio com lideranças indígenas de Mato Grosso do Sul —Guarani, Kaiowá e Terena — e a segunda etapa do Curso de Filosofia da Terra.


Durante a visita, Moira Millán, weychafe (lutadora) e militante pela recuperação de terras ancestrais Mapuche, ofereceu uma formação sobre a luta de seu povo. Em sua fala, Millán contextualizou a resistência histórica de sua nação, que habita ancestralmente o Wallmapu (território que abrange o sul do Chile e da Argentina) e que resistiu à invasão espanhola, aos tratados e, posteriormente, aos genocídios perpetrados pelos Estados chileno e argentino no século XIX.


A liderança explicou que o povo mapuche não se identifica com as identidades nacionais impostas, mas como parte de uma nação com quase 4 milhões de pessoas entre o que hoje é dominado pelos Estados Chileno e Argentino. Segundo Millán, os Estados são vistos como“forças de ocupação militar, política e econômica” em seu território:


“Nós não somos argentinos, não somos chilenos, nós somos Mapuches. E nós pensamos que o Estado argentino e o Estado chileno são uma força de ocupação militar, política e econômica em nosso território.”


Ela também relatou a resistência contemporânea, como a recuperação territorial realizada por mulheres mapuches há 26 anos, e a criminalização do movimento: “Estado argentino e Estado chileno declararam a guerra contra o povo Mapuche. Eles dizem que nós somos terroristas. Porque nós lutamos contra avanços extractivistas.”


A visita de Moira Millán ao Terra Vista reforçou a articulação entre povos originários e movimentos sociais, unidos na defesa de seus territórios e na luta contra o sistema capitalista e patriarcal.

author: Administrador
title: Eine Entschuldigung.
content:
An die Kollektive und Familien Sucherinnen der Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos.

Eine Entschuldigung. Oder viele Entschuldigungen – derart, dass sie alle und jede einzelne Familie Sucherinnen, welche sich auf der Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos versammeln, erreichen.

Wir fühlten uns angegriffen und verletzt. Wir haben durch mich Antwort gegeben (die Compas sind gewöhnlich heftiger), und Ihr habt Euch ebenso oder noch mehr gekränkt gefühlt.

Bezüglich der Worte liegt die Verantwortung vollkommen bei mir, dem Capitán Insurgente Primero de Infantería Marcos. Meine Worte wurden als Aggressionen gegen Euch verstanden. Wirklich, ich bedauere es.

Von Herzen bitte ich Euch um Entschuldigung, Euch gekränkt, verletzt und angegriffen zu haben. Es nutzt nichts zu sagen, es war keine Absicht oder als Ausrede »den Stress« wegen der Angriffe der drei Regierungsebenen zu verwenden. Ich sollte im Gebrauch von Worten und Tonfall vorsichtiger und klüger sein. Ich hoffe, es wird mir nutzen zu lernen, mich mit Takt und Sorgfalt an diejenigen zu richten, die Wahrheit und Gerechtigkeit suchen.

Es ist klar, wir denken: Art und Weisen, Geographien und Kalender müssen respektiert werden. Wir sagen Euch mit Aufrichtigkeit: Wir hoffen, Ihr habt mit Eurer Beharrlichkeit Erfolg und findet alle möglichen Abwesenheiten/Vermissten. Und findet immerzu auch die Form, diejenigen zu umarmen, welche alleine suchen, mit nicht mehr Unterstützung als ihrer eigenen Wut.

Denn manchmal kann vergessen werden, dass sich darum alles handelt: den*diejenige*n zu finden, der*die fehlt.

Nochmals meine Entschuldigungen an Euch. Ich hoffe wirklich, Ihr findet in Euren Herzen die nötige Güte, sie anzunehmen.

Ansonsten: Jede*r nach seinem*ihrem Modus und Kalender, seiner*ihrer Geographie … und Agenda.

Aus den Bergen des Südosten Mexikos.

Bezüglich der Initiative: Wir haben keine anderen Kontakte nach außen als das Frayba, niemanden sonst. Nur wenn sich im Zeitplan, der Agenda ein Punkt konkretisiert, machen wir einen direkten Kontakt mit den Gruppen und Kollektiven der Familien Sucherinnen oder den Familien Sucherinnen im besonderen – aber immer dem Frayba Bescheid gebend, welches die Registrierung, das Register macht.

author: Administrador
title: Fragen.
content:
An die Familien Sucherinnen mit oder ohne Kollektiv.

Seit dem 3. Oktober in den Nachmittagsstunden haben Personen, die der Glorieta de Los Desaparecidos nahestehen, in ihren sozialen Netzwerken bekanntgegeben, ein Treffen zwischen Familien-Kollektiven und der EZLN für den 6. Dezember an der Glorieta de Los y Las Desapericidos sei bestätigt – zu der Zeit hatte die Comisión Sexta [Zapatista] eine Versammlung mit Beauftragten der Sexta Nacional; daran haben, ohne [vorherige] Einladung, einige Sucherinnen teilgenommen.

Tage später hat jemand und im Namen der Familien Sucherinnen der »La Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos« in seinen sozialen Netzwerken eine »Einladung« zirkulieren lassen. Durch verschiedene Medien wurde ihnen vermittelt, so sei nicht das Vorgehen. Sie sollten die Einladung via des [Menschenrechtszentrums] Frayba schicken, welches uns unterstützt hat und weiterhin unterstützt, bezüglich der Registrierung und der Vorschläge der Familien, Gruppen, Kollektive* der Sucherinnen.

Danach, ebenfalls einige Tage später, haben wir ihnen Nachrichten via verschiedene Kanäle gesandt: Sie sollten ihre Einladung zurückziehen, denn derart würde sie zurückgewiesen werden. Sie beinhalte Erwähnungen, die als Zeichen dafür betrachtet werden könnten, dass sie diejenigen, die sie eingeladen haben, nicht kennen; Dinge, die für die zapatistischen Comunidades als kränkend angesehen werden könnten.

Auch sei es nicht die Art von »Versammlungen«, an die die Comisión Sexta denke, und dass es der zapatistischen Delegation zukommt, ihre Agenda zu bestimmen, mit Daten und Uhrzeiten.

Nicht nur haben sie uns nicht beachtet, sie weiteten ihre Verbreitung [des Treffens] aus und fügten an, es sei gesichert, dass es das Treffen mit der zapatistischen Delegation auf dem Glorieta-Platz geben würde, mit gesetztem Datum, sogar in einigen Fällen mit Uhrzeit.

Wir bestanden darauf, ihnen weiter Nachrichten zu schicken, sie sollten deswegen [siehe obige Gründe] die Einladung umarbeiten. Unterdessen wuchs die Konfusion weiter an; Gruppen und Kollektive fingen an, ihre Daten zu ändern, um bei »DER« Versammlung anwesend zu sein. Wir warnten sie, dass sie uns an den Rand eines öffentlichen Widerspruchs bringen. Dies bedeutet, eine genaue Antwort, um klarzustellen.

Soweit wir verstehen, ist La Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos keine Organisation sondern ein Raum des Zusammentreffens. Das bedeutet, sie haben keine etablierten Sprecher*innen oder Leitung. Es ist ein Ort, wo Gruppen und Kollektive der Familien Sucherinnen gewöhnlich zusammenkommen. Wir haben angenommen, sie hatten oder haben eine Einrichtung, um Übereinkünfte und Entscheidungen zu treffen. Und dass sie diesem Mechanismus [der Entscheidungsfindung] deshalb die Zulässigkeit oder Nicht-Zulässigkeit des abgefassten Schreibens [der »Einladung«] unterwerfen würden, welches – und das wussten sie zuvor – bei den Zapatistas solchen Ärger erzeugt hat.

Die »Einladung« beinhaltet drei grundlegende Punkte:

1.- Den Zapatistas wird Unterstützung angeboten. Darum haben sie die zapatistischen Comunidades »eingeladen«, Fotos ihrer Verschwundengemachten mitzubringen, und dass sie uns zeigen würden: wie ein Plakat mit der Suchanzeige für gewaltsam Verschwundengemachte hergestellt wird und wie es auf der Glorieta angeklebt wird, zusammen mit hunderten Fotos von Verschwundengemachten; welche Formalitäten gemacht werden müssen, damit eine NGO Finanzierung gewährt; an wen sich innerhalb der Regierungspyramide zu richten ist etc.

Schwestern Familien Sucherinnen: Innerhalb des zapatistischen Gebietes und den Gemeinden, die zuvor zapatistisch waren und jetzt Partei-Anhänge*rinnen sind, gibt es seit 30 Jahren KEIN GEWALTSAMES VERSCHWUNDENMACHEN.

Schaut, es gibt feministische Gruppen, die all das kennen, was mit Feminiziden in Verbindung steht. Andere Gruppen mit der Ermordung von Kindern, wieder andere mit Menschenhandel, andere mit ungestraften Verbrechen, andere mit Homophobie, andere mit Rassismus und Segregation; und so weiter mit jedem dieser Schrecken, die in dieser Mexiko genannten Geographie erlitten werden.

Bevor uns Workshops für diese Probleme angeboten werden, wäre da nicht zu erwarten, dass sie zumindest die Prozentzahl der allgemeinen Gender-Gewalt – sie sagen dazu bereits nicht mehr Feminizide – untersuchen würden? title: Sultangazi'de 6'ncı kattaki evinin balkonundan düşen kadın ağır yaralandı
content:
İstanbul - Sultangazi'de binanın 6'ncı katındaki evinin balkonundan düşen N.T, ağır yaralanarak hastaneye kaldırıldı.

DHA'da yer alan habere göre olay, saat 22.00 sularında Sultançiftliği Mahallesi'nde meydana geldi. Binanın 6'ncı katında yaşayan N.T. adlı kadın, evinin balkonundan şüpheli bir biçimde aşağı düştü. Sağlık ekiplerinin yaptığı kontrolde ağır yaralandığı belirlenen N.T, olay yerindeki ilk müdahalesinin ardından hastaneye kaldırıldı. Soruşturma sürüyor.

Olayın gerçekleştiği sokakta çiğ köfte dükkanı işleten Ramazan Kaya, "Burada esnafım, dükkanda da müşterim vardı. O anda bir ses geldi, araba kazası sandım. Sonrasında dışarı çıktığımda milletin toplandığını gördüm. Kadının dengesini kaybederek aşağı düştüğünü tahmin ediyorum. Kendisi yıllardır komşumdur, iyi insandır. Ailecek de herhangi bir sıkıntıları yoktu. Evde eşiyle beraber kalıyordu. Çocukları da var ama başka yerde oturuyorlar. N.T'yi en son iki gün önce gördüm. Buradan geçtiğinde hal hatır sorardı. Olayın sonrasında polis ve ambulans ekipleri geldi, olay yeri inceleme ekipleri gelip çalışma yaptı" ifadelerini kullandı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: UCM'den Trump ve Rubio'nun Gazze'deki soykırıma desteğinin soruşturulması istendi
content:
Fotoğraf: Official White House Photo by Molly Riley/Wikimedia Commons Public domain

Soykırıma Karşı Vergi Mükellefleri İttifakından (TAAG) yapılan yazılı açıklamada, grubun, Trump, Rubio ve bazı üst düzey ABD’li yetkililerin İsrail’in Gazze’de "işlediği soykırım", "savaş suçları" ve "insanlığa karşı suçlara yardım ettiği" iddiasının soruşturulması için dün Hollanda'nın Lahey kentindeki UCM Savcılık Ofisine resmi başvuruda bulunduğu belirtildi.

Üst düzey ABD’li yetkililerin "İsrail’in Gazze’de işlediği suçlara yardım ettiği" vurgulanan açıklamada, Gazze’de görev yapan doktorların yeminli beyanlarının, görgü tanıklarının ifadelerinin, video kayıtlarının ve ABD’nin İsrail’e verdiği askeri, mali, diplomatik ve siyasi desteğe ilişkin belgelerin savcılığa sunulduğu ifade edildi.

Açıklamada, başvuruda Gazze’de iki kez görev yapan ABD’li travma cerrahı Dr. Feroze Sidhwa ile Gazze İnsani Vakfının eski yöneticilerinden David McIntosh’un tanıklıklarının da yer aldığı vurgulanarak, "soykırımı finanse edenler, silahlandırarak suça yardım ve yataklık edenler için artık cezasızlık olmaması" ve hiçbir yetkilinin uluslararası hukukun üzerinde olmaması gerektiği çağrısı yapıldı.

Birleşmiş Milletler Filistin Özel Raportörü Francesca Albanese, başvurunun ardından Lahey’de düzenlenen basın toplantısında, uluslararası hukukun, adaletsizlikle yüzleşmek ve ileriye giden yolu açmak için elde kalan son barışçıl araç olduğunu söyledi.

title: YJK-E and KON-MED: Justice for Vesile Akın
content:
The Union of Kurdish Women in Germany (YJK-E) and the Confederation of Democratic Kurdish Communities in Germany (KON-MED) said in a written statement: “We learned with profound anger and sorrow that Vesile Akın, a 35-year-old mother of five, was stabbed to death on 9 November in the German city of Düren by her estranged husband.”


The statement continued: “Only recently, we raised our voices against the murder of Enda in Coesfeld. Today, once again, we are witnessing a woman being deprived of her right to life. The names and cities change, but male violence and the suffering endured by women remain the same.”


The statement, which emphasised that “violence against women is not only a women’s issue but a problem affecting society as a whole”, continued: “The murder of a woman is also an attack on the future of society and on our shared life together. According to information reported in the media, Vesile Akın had previously contacted the police, citing threats against her, and had requested protection. It has been reported that the threats continued despite restraining measures being imposed. Yet Vesile could not be protected. Today, five children have been left without their mother.


When a woman reports that she is being threatened, asks for help and turns to the state for protection, what more needs to happen to prevent her from being murdered?


Femicide is political! Laws introduced by the state to protect women must not be rendered ineffective by other legal regulations or shortcomings in their implementation. Protection orders must not remain mere words on paper; women's right to life must be guaranteed. Vesile Akın’s reports to the authorities and the protective measures taken must be investigated independently and transparently, and those responsible for any possible negligence must be held accountable.”


The statement underlined that “the male-dominated mentality that threatens women's right to life manifests itself not only through individual acts of violence but also through oppression within families and society. Women who wish to separate or divorce are sometimes pressured to abandon their decisions, even by members of their own families. Women cannot be expected to endure violence and oppression in the name of family unity. No woman should have to pay with her life for a decision she makes about her own future.


Preventing the murder of women cannot be left solely to the struggle of women themselves. Men must also take responsibility for challenging patriarchal attitudes, violence and society's silence. Because genuine social freedom cannot exist in a society where women are unable to live freely and safely. Through our campaign, launched on 1 November and continuing until 8 March, International Working Women's Day, entitled ‘We Are Strengthening Our Collective Struggle Against Femicide and the Male-Dominated Mentality!’, we are drawing attention precisely to this collective social responsibility. As part of this struggle, we aim to promote a democratic understanding of the family, strengthen equality between women and men, challenge patriarchal attitudes and raise social awareness against violence towards women. The murder of Vesile Akın has once again demonstrated just how vital the struggle we have launched truly is. We stand for life against femicide and for women's freedom against the male-dominated mentality. We are strengthening our collective struggle!”

title: EBRD'den Türkiye'nin temiz enerji dönüşümüne 6 milyar dolarlık yatırım planı
content:
Avrupa İmar ve Kalkınma Bankası (EBRD), Türkiye’nin yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını hızlandırmak amacıyla oluşturulan Yenilenebilir Enerji Hızlandırma ve Temiz Enerji Geçiş Platformu'na (REACT) katıldı. Banka, platform kapsamında önümüzdeki beş yıl içinde Türkiye’deki projelere 6 milyar dolar yatırım yapmayı planladığını açıkladı.

EBRD’nin duyurusu, Antalya’da 9-20 Kasım tarihleri arasında düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği Konferansı COP31 kapsamında yapıldı. Banka, platformun oluşturulması sürecinde Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanlığı ile birlikte çalıştı.

REACT platformunun temel hedefi, Türkiye’nin enerji dönüşümü için 2040 yılına kadar 300 milyar dolarlık yatırımı harekete geçirmek. Girişim, kamu kurumlarını, uluslararası finans kuruluşlarını, yatırımcıları ve özel sektörü ortak bir yatırım programı etrafında buluşturmayı amaçlıyor.

Platform kapsamında sağlanacak finansmanın güneş ve rüzgar enerjisi üretiminin artırılmasının yanı sıra elektrik şebekelerinin modernizasyonu, enerji depolama sistemleri, enerji ekipmanı üretimi ve elektrifikasyon projelerinde kullanılması öngörülüyor.

Türkiye, 2040 yılına kadar güneş ve rüzgar enerjisinin toplam kurulu gücünü 175 gigavata çıkarmayı hedefliyor. Bu hedef, mevcut enerji altyapısının genişletilmesini ve yenilenebilir kaynaklardan elde edilen elektriğin sisteme aktarılması için yeni yatırımlar yapılmasını gerektiriyor.

REACT platformuna EBRD'nin yanı sıra Avrupa Birliği (AB), Dünya Bankası, Uluslararası Finans Kurumu (IFC), Alman Kalkınma Bankası (KfW), Uluslararası İmar ve Kalkınma Bankası (IBRD), İklim Yatırım Fonları ve Birleşmiş Milletler Sınai Kalkınma Örgütü (UNIDO) gibi kuruluşlar da destek veriyor.

EBRD Başkanı Odile Renaud-Basso, bankanın Türkiye enerji sektöründe önemli bir deneyime sahip olduğunu belirterek enerji dönüşümünü desteklemek amacıyla yeni yatırımları harekete geçirmeye hazır olduklarını söyledi.

Türkiye’nin enerji dönüşümü konusunda iddialı hedefler belirlediğini ifade eden Renaud-Basso, bu hedeflerin somut yatırımlara dönüşmesi için uluslararası işbirliğinin ve finansman kaynaklarının önemine dikkat çekti.

EBRD, bugüne kadar Türkiye ekonomisine büyük bölümü özel sektöre olmak üzere 26 milyar avronun üzerinde yatırım yaptı. Banka, REACT platformuyla Türkiye’nin enerji altyapısının dönüşümünde ve yenilenebilir enerji kapasitesinin artırılmasında rol üstlenmeyi hedefliyor.
