title: Maraş’taki okul saldırısı: 11 kamu görevlisine soruşturma izni verilmedi
content:
Maraş’ın Onikişubat ilçesindeki Ayser Çalık Ortaokulu’nda 15 Nisan’da dokuz öğrenci ile öğretmen Ayla Kara’nın öldürüldüğü, 15 öğrencinin de yaralandığı silahlı saldırının ardından kamu görevlilerinin sorumluluğuna ilişkin yürütülen incelemede karar verildi. Valilik, aralarında eski il ve ilçe milli eğitim müdürleri ile okul çalışanlarının da bulunduğu 11 kamu görevlisi hakkında soruşturma izni vermedi.


Eski okul müdürleri M.B. ve C.K., müdür yardımcısı F.B. ile rehber öğretmen E.İ. hakkında ise “görevi kötüye kullanma” iddiasıyla soruşturma izni verildi.


Saldırıda yaşamını yitiren ve yaralanan öğrencilerin avukatı Furkan Mehmet Cinkara, saldırı öncesinde gerekli önlemlerin alınmadığı, yetkili kurumlara bildirim yapılmadığı ve saldırı sırasında bazı kamu görevlilerinin sorumluluklarını yerine getirmediği iddiasıyla şikâyette bulunmuştu.


Başvuru üzerine Maraş Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, kamu görevlileri hakkında soruşturma yürütülebilmesi için Valilikten izin istedi.


Maraş’taki okul saldırısı davasında iki hâkimin görev yeri değişti


8 Eylül 2026


İl ve ilçe müdürlerine bildirim yapılmadığı gerekçe gösterildi


Maraş Valiliğinin kararında, dönemin İl Milli Eğitim Müdürü Erhan Baydur, İl Milli Eğitim Müdür Yardımcısı H.A., Şube Müdürü Y.S., eski Onikişubat İlçe Milli Eğitim Müdürü Harun Kurt ile şube müdürleri A.K. ve R.S. hakkında soruşturma izni verilmedi.


Kararda, okul yönetimi veya rehberlik servisi tarafından saldırıyı gerçekleştiren öğrenci İ.A.M. hakkında saldırıdan önce il ya da ilçe milli eğitim müdürlüklerine yazılı veya sözlü bildirim yapılmadığı belirtildi.


Bu nedenle il ve ilçe milli eğitim yöneticilerinin saldırı öncesinde önlem almamalarından sorumlu tutulamayacakları sonucuna varıldı.


Valilik ayrıca müdür yardımcıları A.Y., Ç.S. ve Z.G., rehber öğretmen M.K. ile sosyal bilgiler öğretmeni İ.H. hakkında da soruşturma izni vermedi.


Ailelerin avukatı, 11 kamu görevlisi hakkında soruşturma izni verilmemesi kararına itiraz etti.


Hukukçular Maraş’taki okul saldırısı iddianamesini nasıl değerlendiriyor?


24 Temmuz 2026


İ.A.M. ile ilgili kayıtların tutulmadığı tespit edildi


Valilik kararında, İ.A.M.’nin okulda yaşadığı sorunların ve davranışlarının bilindiği, ancak gerekli tedbirlerin alınmadığı değerlendirmesine yer verildi.


İ.A.M. hakkında okulun E-Rehberlik sisteminde kayıt bulunmadığı, rehberlik servisiyle yapılan görüşmelere ilişkin açıklama ve arşiv kayıtlarının da tutulmadığı belirtildi.


Kararda ayrıca öğrencinin Rehberlik ve Araştırma Merkezi’ne yönlendirilmediği, ailesinden psikiyatrik tedavi durumuna ilişkin belge istenmediği ve Çocuk Koruma Kanunu kapsamında girişimde bulunulmadığı kaydedildi.


Bu gerekçelerle eski okul müdürü M.B. ile rehber öğretmen E.İ.’nin saldırıdan önceki süreçte sorumluluklarını yerine getirmediği değerlendirildi.


Eski okul müdürü C.K. ile müdür yardımcısı F.B.’nin ise saldırı sırasında görevlerini ihmal ettikleri değerlendirmesiyle haklarında soruşturma izni verildi.


EĞİTİME İKİ GÜN ARA VERİLDİ


Maraş'ta ortaokulda silahlı saldırı: 10 kişi yaşamını yitirdi


15 Nisan 2026


Müfettiş raporunda da dört eğitimciye ilişkin tespitler yer aldı


Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı müfettişlerinin hazırladığı raporda da dört eğitimciye ilişkin tespitlere yer verildi.


Raporda okul müdürü C.K. ile müdür yardımcısı F.B.’nin silah seslerinin ardından saldırının yaşandığı kata çıktıkları, daha sonra ise okul binasını terk ettikleri belirtildi. Öğrencilerin güvenliğinin sağlanması ve tahliyenin organize edilmesine ilişkin sorumluluklarının araştırılması istendi.


Rehber öğretmenin de İ.A.M. ile ilgili daha önce ortaya çıkan durumlar karşısında Çocuk Koruma Kanunu kapsamındaki bildirim yükümlülüğünü yerine getirip getirmediğinin değerlendirilmesi gerektiği belirtildi.


Ailelerin avukatı Cinkara, dört kişi hakkında soruşturma izni verilmesini daha önce adaletin sağlanması açısından önemli bir gelişme olarak değerlendirmiş, ancak soruşturmanın bu kişilerle sınırlı kalmaması gerektiğini söylemişti.


Ne olmuştu?


Ayser Çalık Ortaokulu’nda 15 Nisan’da sekizinci sınıf öğrencisi İ.A.M.’nin düzenlediği silahlı saldırıda dokuz öğrenci ile öğretmen Ayla Kara hayatını kaybetti, 15 öğrenci yaralandı.


Saldırıya ilişkin soruşturma kapsamında İ.A.M.’nin anne ve babası hakkında da dava açıldı.


Maraş Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının hazırladığı iddianamede baba U.M hakkında 10 kişiye yönelik “olası kastla öldürme”, 15 kişiye yönelik çeşitli “olası kastla yaralama” suçlarının yanı …

author: Unknown
title: Sigorta satışlarına yeni düzenleme: Alışverişte zorunlu olmayacak
content:
Fotoğraf: Scott Graham/Unsplash

Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumunun (SEDDK) tarafından hazırlanan Bütünleşik Sigortalar Hakkında Yönetmelik, 12 Kasım 2026 tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girdi.

Düzenleme; ürün satışı, kiralama ve hizmet sunumu sırasında bunlarla bağlantılı riskler için teklif edilen sigortaların satış koşullarını, kapsamını ve tüketicilerin haklarını belirliyor. Yönetmelik, sigorta ve reasürans şirketlerinin yanı sıra sigorta aracılarını, bankaları ve bütünleşik sigortaların sunulduğu ticaret ortamlarını sağlayan kişi ve kuruluşları da kapsıyor.

Yönetmeliğe göre bütünleşik sigortalar, ürünün satışı veya kiralanması ya da hizmetin sunulması sırasında teklif edilebilecek. Sigorta teklifi, satış veya kiralama sözleşmesinin kurulmasından itibaren 14 gün içinde de yapılabilecek.

Ancak sigorta satın alınması, ürün veya hizmetin satın alınmasının ya da kiralanmasının koşulu haline getirilemeyecek. Sigortayı kabul etmeyen tüketiciye ürün veya hizmet bedeli üzerinden farklı fiyat uygulanamayacak. Sigortanın reddedilmesi, diğer satış koşullarının tüketici aleyhine değiştirilmesine de gerekçe oluşturamayacak.

Yeni düzenlemeyle bütünleşik sigortalarda yıllık brüt prim tutarına üst sınır getirildi. Buna göre yıllık brüt sigorta primi, teminatın başladığı tarihte ilgili takvim yılının ilk altı ayında geçerli olan aylık brüt asgari ücret tutarını aşamayacak.

SEDDK Kurulu, bu üst sınırı mal veya hizmet türüne göre yarısına kadar düşürebilecek ya da iki katına kadar artırabilecek. Sigorta teminatının süresi ise en fazla iki yıl olacak. Uzatılmış garanti teminatı sunulan ürünlerde bu süre, garanti süresiyle uyumlu olacak şekilde uzatılabilecek.

Yönetmelik kapsamında ürünlerin kırılması, kaybolması, çalınması, yanması, arızalanması veya başka şekilde zarar görmesine ilişkin riskler için sigorta sunulabilecek. Ev hayvanlarının hastalanması, çalınması ve kaybolması da sigorta kapsamına alınabilecek.

Seyahat, ulaşım, konaklama, etkinlik, abonelik, fatura ödeme, siber güvenlik ile paylaşımlı ve kısa süreli araç kiralama hizmetlerinin kullanılamaması, iptal edilmesi, kesintiye uğraması veya yetkisiz kullanılması gibi riskler için de teminat verilebilecek.

İkamet izni ve vize başvurularında ibraz edilmesi gereken sigortalar ile bankaların kendilerine ait olmayan elektronik ticaret ortamları üzerinden sağladıkları bireysel kredilerle bağlantılı hayat, borç ödeme ve ferdi kaza sigortaları da belirlenen koşullarda bütünleşik sigorta kapsamında sunulabilecek.

Yönetmelikte bütünleşik sigorta kapsamında sunulamayacak sigortalar da sıralandı. Zorunlu sigortalar, konut ve işyeri sigortaları ile zorunlu deprem sigortası (DASK) kapsam dışında bırakıldı. Bunların yanı sıra inşaat ve montaj, tarım, nakliyat, hukuksal koruma, birikim ve yatırımlı sigortalar da bütünleşik sigorta kapsamında sunulamayacak.

Paylaşımlı ve kısa süreli araç kiralama hizmetleriyle bağlantılı olanlar dışındaki kara, hava, raylı sistem ve su araçlarına ilişkin sigortalar da kapsam dışında tutuldu. Özel sağlık, hastalık, ferdi kaza, hayat, sorumluluk, finansal kayıp, kredi ve kefalet sigortaları için de yönetmelikte belirtilen istisnalar dışında bütünleşik sigorta uygulaması yapılamayacak.

Yeni düzenlemeyle sigortanın sunulduğu fiziki satış noktalarında tüketicilerin kolayca görebileceği bilgilendirmeler yapılması zorunlu hale getirildi. İnternet üzerinden yapılan satışlarda ise bu bilgilere bağlantı aracılığıyla erişilebilecek.

Bilgilendirmelerde sigorta teminatını sağlayan şirketin adı ve iletişim bilgileri, varsa sigorta aracısının bilgileri, prim tutarı ve teminatın kapsamı açıklanacak. Ayrıca bir zarar meydana gelmesi halinde tazminatın ilgili sigorta şirketi tarafından ödeneceği belirtilecek. Sigortanın doğrudan satış yapan işletme tarafından sağlandığı izlenimi yaratılmasına izin verilmeyecek.

Yönetmelikle sigorta sözleşmelerinin sona erdirilmesine ilişkin koşullar da düzenlendi. Buna göre tüketicinin sözleşmeyi sona erdirme talebini herhangi bir uzaktan iletişim aracıyla sigortanın sunulduğu ticaret ortamını sağlayan işletmeye veya yetkili kuruluşa iletmesi yeterli olacak.

Sigorta satışı yapan işletmeler, sözleşmenin kurulduğu yöntemle iptal talebinin de iletilebilmesini sağlayacak sistemleri oluşturmakla yükümlü olacak. Tüketici, sözleşmeyi sona erdirmek için sözleşmenin kurulması sırasında kullanılan yöntemden daha ağır koşullara tabi tutulamayacak.

Ürün veya hizmete ilişkin sözleşmeden …

author: Administrador
title: Preparativi Zapatisti per l’Incontro Abbraccio con le Familias Buscadoras. Parte 3: CURARE, PROTEGGERE, CUSTODIRE
content:
Musica: Meme del Real, «El mundo en que nací»

Immagini, edizione e produzione: Terci@s Compas Zapatistas

Vi saluta il Subcomandante Insurgente Moisés, coordinatore generale della Gira por la Vida – Capitolo Messico.

Vi dico che continuiamo a prepararci per il viaggio che faremo per conoscervi, per ascoltare e imparare dalle vostre sofferenze e dalla vostra resistenza. E per custodire le vostre parole nei nostri cuori e nella nostra memoria. Speriamo davvero di imparare molto da voi.

Qui dove ci troviamo, ora piove molto e fa freddo. Va bene per chi viene dalle terre fredde, ma chi proviene dai territori caldi soffre un po’ perché non è abituato. Per quanto riguarda la pioggia, siamo tutti abituati, perché normalmente qui sulle montagne del sud-est messicano piove molto. Nell’entroterra, sulle colline e nella selva, piove anche quando non piove.

Alcune al freddo, altre al caldo, le comunità zapatiste hanno inviato delegate, delegati e 3 delegate a prepararsi. Finora sono 1530, secondo il conteggio. Forse il numero diminuirà a causa di malattie o impegni familiari. Ad esempio, una compagna si è sentita male, è stata visitata e dall’ecografia è emerso che è incinta. Ha dovuto tornare indietro per assicurarsi che lei e il suo piccolino stessero bene. Ma subito un compagno che se ne intende di tacos (di prepararli, non di mangiarli; perché per quanto riguarda mangiarli, siamo tutti e tutte ben addestrati), ha subito detto che sarebbe subentrato lui. E le comandanti e i comandanti hanno dato il loro consenso, perché lui ascolta sempre le discussioni che si tengono per prepararci al meglio.

In questo video vi mostriamo alcuni dei nostri preparativi.

Sia tutta la delegazione completa, sia nei gruppi in cui ci organizziamo, ci prepariamo per le marce se ci saranno o per i meeting, come li chiamano. In quelle marce, se si faranno, la nostra principale preoccupazione non sarà non è ciò che diremo, ma prendersi cura, tutelare e proteggere le Familias Buscadoras. Insomma, non andiamo lì per fare baldoria, per divertirci, ma per ascoltare la vostra parola. E quindi dobbiamo stare attenti, perché nel vostro cuore ci sono parole forti, dure, che insegnano e guidano nella lotta per la vita.

E sappiamo che impareremo perché portiamo con noi il nostro taccuino e la nostra penna. E persino computer, tablet e cellulari. E ci sono compagne che chiamiamo “Tercias Compas” che se ne intendono di telecamere, riprese, montaggio e trasmissione degli incontri. Ma la cosa più importante è che portiamo a testa, il cuore e lo stomaco con tanta voglia di imparare.

Come potete vedere nel video, alcune compagne si dispongono con i loro bambini come se fossero famiglie in cerca di verità e giustizia, e poi la nostra delegazione, o parte di essa, cammina al loro fianco e poi le avvolge come in uno scudo.

E persino il Comando Palomitas si esercita a formare lo scudo che cura, protegge e custodisce.

È proprio così che ci hanno insegnato i nostri antenati, dicendoci che siamo i custodi e le custodi della terra, la madre per eccellenza.

Come potete vedere dalle immagini, con tutto il fango che si forma durante gli allenamenti, ormai non si tratta più tanto di marciare, quanto piuttosto di scivolare. Un po’ come se pattassimo, insomma. E poi capita che il sandalo rimanga incastrato, o la scarpa da tennis, e non ci si può fermare perché da dietro arriva la folla, il grosso dei compagni. E allora, non c’è niente da fare, bisogna aspettare che finisca l’allenamento per andare a cercare nel fango dove è finito il sandalo o la scarpa da tennis. E così, per un po’ camminiamo come un cagnolino zoppo.

Non verremo a fare una passeggiata. Vi abbracceremo, se lo desiderate, e se non volete, verremo comunque per ascoltare le vostre parole.

Sappiamo che ci sono persone che parlano male del viaggio. Creano divisioni, vogliono decidere chi può e chi non può unirsi a noi, insomma vogliono escludere dei gruppi perché non vanno d’accordo, e cose del genere. Più avanti, un altro giorno, il Capitán Marcos ne parlerà citando anche i nomi.

Subcomandante Insurgente Moisés

title: Preparativi Zapatisti per l’Incontro Abbraccio con le Familias Buscadoras. Parte 4: Un Comando in Difficoltà
content:
Sono seduto qui, aspettando invano che mi portino dei tamales, anche se sono crudi. Da lontano osservo ciò che sta accadendo:

La Verónica (che ha appena compiuto 8 anni e a dicembre ne compirà 9, cioè entrerà nei 10), capa del tristemente famoso “Comando Palomitas”, aspetta pazientemente che il SubMoy esca da una delle riunioni della direzione zapatista. Con quella che si potrebbe definire una «manovra di aggiramento», intercetta il Coordinatore capo della Gira por la Vida – Capitolo Messico, e gli spara a bruciapelo:

Il SubMoy risponde quasi immediatamente: “Abbiamo? Mi suona da Unione Europea. Tu ce l’hai.”

Nella modalità Veronica, versione “comando palomitas”, la frase “abbiamo un problema” in realtà significa qualcosa del tipo “ho creato io un problema, tocca a te risolverlo”.

La ragazzina, o maledetta fanciulla del demonio, ignora l’osservazione critica del SubMoy e sintetizza:

Il SubMoy si blocca. «Quali magliette? Non so niente di magliette». Veronica passa all’attacco:

“È che sono già arrivati i nuovi ‘palomiti’ e non hanno la maglietta; come fanno a sapere che siamo Palomitas se non abbiamo la maglietta?”

“Beh, visto le marachelle che combinate. Smettetela e poi vedremo se ci saranno magliette o no”, dice il SubMoy.

La Verónica è già pronta e ribatte: «Come potremmo non combinare marachelle se siamo bambine? Altrimenti a cosa servirebbe essere bambine? Il capitano dice che tutte le bambine hanno il diritto di combinare marachelle, solo i bambini no, perché vengono puniti». (Nota della redazione: non è vero, io non ho detto questo).

“Ah”, sospira sollevato il SubMoy, “allora vedetevela con il capitano. È una sua responsabilità, non mia”. E se ne va.

La Verónica si dirige, ringhiando, verso il punto in cui mi trovo. Cerco di alzarmi e scappare, ma cado e, mentre mi riprendo, la nuova truppa del Comando Palomitas mi circonda e mi tiene sotto assedio. Ho il sospetto che non sia per proteggermi, ma per impedirmi di scappare.

“Perché dovrei soffrire in anticipo? Ci vuole ancora un bel po’ prima che arrivino la scuola, i compiti, l’impegno nella comunità, quel fenomeno chiamato mestruazione, poi i fidanzati – meglio se diversi, nel caso uno non vada bene –, gli amori e le delusioni amorose, poi il compagno con cui finalmente ti sistemerai, poi i figli e, prima che te ne accorga, sei già in menopausa. Avremo dei pronipoti e, per di più, non avremo nemmeno una maglietta. È incredibile.”

Non ho detto nulla. Mi guardo intorno disperato.

“Ma, ho detto al Monarca che servono la lista e le taglie per ordinare le magliette”, mi difendo.

“Gliele ho già consegnate”, dice quella maledetta ragazzina del demonio.

Il Monarca fa finta di niente, lo sguardo a terra, e dice: “Vado a controllare il furgone”.

“Non scappare, Monarca”, gli urla Veronica, “ti ho dato la lista, eccome”.

La cosiddetta lista è un foglio diviso in due parti su cui, di proprio pugno, la Verónica ha scritto i nomi delle nuove componenti del Comando Palomitas e le loro taglie. Qui potete vedere un’immagine della lista:

Grazie a un’applicazione speciale in grado di decifrare tutti i codici esistenti e immaginabili, si ottiene una sorta di traduzione. Un’analista, specializzata in archeologia e lingue rare, decifra un nome: “Sofilla”. E a quel punto, risolvere il resto è più semplice.

La Verónica spiega che lei ha rispettato i tempi e che è responsabilità del Monarca se non ha consegnato. Sfida il Monarca, che si nasconde dietro il veicolo.

A quel punto la Verónica dichiara: “Chiedo che si decida con un duello e scelgo La Pelusa come mia campionessa”. La Pelusa è una cagnolina che, proprio come suggerisce il nome, è piccola come un peluche, ma è coraggiosa come nessun altro: difende le galline e i gattini dagli opossum e dai topi (senza offesa), e i falchi non si avvicinano nemmeno più ai pollai.

Dato che Tzotz se la sta spassando con una cagnolina, al Monarca non resta che il Tragón come unica opzione. Il Tragón è disteso a pancia in su, godendosi un sole che ha tardato ad arrivare dopo giorni di pioggia battente.

Faccio un cenno al Monarca. Lui capisce: “compagno capitano, il SubMoy ha detto che bisogna controllare il registro con il Frayba”.

Ce la svigniamo. Ma quello che mi preoccupa è che ho intravisto il Comando Palomitas al completo riunito in cerchio a complottare.

Pensate che dovrei preoccuparmi?

I tamales non sono mai arrivati, ma al loro posto ci hanno mandato dei panini che sembrano sassi. Il Brallan mi dice di tenerli da …

author: Wanessa Celina
title: Violência eleitoral matou uma pessoa a cada 36 horas no Brasil após segundo turno
content:
O encerramento das eleições presidenciais, no dia 5 de outubro, e a divulgação do resultado do segundo turno, com a reeleição do presidente Lula (PT) e a derrota do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), gerou comemorações, mas também iniciou uma onda de violência no país. Entre os dias 5 e 31 de outubro, 379 episódios de violência política e eleitoral foram registrados em 198 municípios brasileiros, 27 unidades da Federação e no exterior, somando mais de uma ocorrência a cada duas horas.


O levantamento da Terra de Direitos e da Justiça Global ainda aponta que no mesmo período 18 assassinatos foram cometidos em função da violência eleitoral, registrando uma morte a cada 36 horas. Entre as vítimas, chama a atenção a presença das minorias, tendo em vista que 4 delas eram homens indígenas e uma era uma mulher trans e negra.


“Não podemos olhar apenas para a quantidade de vítimas, mas também para quem são essas pessoas. Os contextos e as especificidades desses ataques, as relações de poder que estão por trás deles. A pesquisa mostra isso de forma bastante evidente quando mapeia casos de morte de indígenas, quando registra ataques racistas contra eleitores e candidaturas negras, nas manifestações transfóbicas e ameaças contra mulheres que ocupam espaços de representação política”, avalia Gisele Barbieri, coordenadora de Incidência Política da Terra de Direitos e uma das coordenadoras da pesquisa. Além das mortes, ocorreram outros 18 atentados contra a vida, 12 deles envolvendo arma de fogo.


Três estados lideraram o número de casos de assassinato após o segundo turno. No Mato Grosso, cinco homens, entre 35 e 64 anos, foram assassinados.


Já no Rio Grande do Sul, três indígenas Kaingang foram mortos na Terra Indígena Votouro, em Benjamin Constant do Sul (RS), em 13 de outubro. O conflito teve início porque trabalhadores indígenas foram demitidos por participar de uma carreata em apoio à reeleição de Lula. Duas mortes ocorreram durante uma ação do Batalhão de Choque da Brigada Militar, que deixou mais 15 pessoas feridas. No Mato Grosso do Sul, foram mais dois assassinatos, de outro indígena e de um homem de 34 anos.


Em Alagoas, Bahia, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo, foi registrada uma morte por violência eleitoral. Entre os 10 estados onde os assassinatos ocorreram, em sete deles (RS, SC, PR, MS, MT, SP, RJ), Flávio Bolsonaro recebeu mais votos do que Lula.


Gisele Barbieri salienta que os dados “apontam indícios preocupantes de que a violência não foi apenas resultado de conflitos isolados ou de divergências entre eleitores”. Para ela, é necessário “diferenciar embates políticos gerados pela polarização, ou seja, por ideias contrárias, de uma estratégia de violência que tem sido utilizada pela extrema-direita nos últimos anos”.


“A pesquisa registra episódios concretos de incitação à perseguição política, inclusive por agentes públicos. Foram 15 manifestações de autoridades incentivando demissões ou boicotes contra eleitores do PT. Também foram identificadas ameaças, ataques à comemoração, perseguições e retaliações contra pessoas por sua identificação política”, ressalta. Os dados corroboram a avaliação da pesquisadora: entre os 242 registros em que foi possível identificar o lado político da vítima, 225 atingiram pessoas que apoiavam o PT e Lula (93%).


O levantamento também revela que os alvos da violência eleitoral mudaram entre os primeiro e segundo turnos. Se, após o primeiro turno, o foco era na violência contra candidatos e políticos eleitos, chegando a 134 denúncias registradas, com os resultados das eleições, o foco mudou para os apoiadores do PT e de Lula, com 225 denúncias. No total, 350 registros (92,3%) atingiram eleitores, militantes, equipes de campanha e comitês.


Entre a noite do dia 25 de outubro e a madrugada do dia seguinte, os ataques a eleitores tiveram o pico; foram 54 episódios em 43 municípios de 16 estados. Em sua maioria, as vítimas eram pessoas que estavam comemorando a vitória de Lula.


Para Barbieri, o agravamento dessas ocorrências exige das instituições federais uma ação para enfrentar a impunidade dos autores e garantir a integridade do processo democrático. “É uma violência que não se encerra com o resultado das eleições e escala de discussões políticas para ataques graves, como espancamentos e assassinatos em espaços públicos, locais de trabalho ou eventos de campanha”, conclui.

title: a14 – What’s fermenting underground – Jazz Dance with today’s zine scene
content:
Our collective can barely process all the correspondence coming our way. The least of which comes with scrappy limited edition zines. We endeavor to highlight them here when we can. Thankfully we have found a bright and wise ally who, when not tending to the garden warmly sits and reads deeply and widely freaky shit on paper. Maybe you will find a new life of reading zines, reviewing or even making them to thicken the plot we’re in.

Ear of Corn #66 24 pages – $2 foodfortunata@hotmail.com

It’s really endearing that even after 18 years, Ear of Corn still uses pasteup for the design, even as it’s moved to glossy paper. You can see on every page that Ear of Corn is still assembled old school and copied like we all used to do at Kinkos with glue sticks. The glue had a mild starchy taste, slightly sweet with a bitter finish; not unlike bad cheese pizza.

I have this conspiracy theory about this zine. I usually write reviews in batches, and I’ll often have multiple issues of Ear of Corn on my desk at a time. But I’ve never had any sequentially numbered issues. I’ve begun to suspect issues are not numbered non-sequentially or perhaps they are sequential, but aren’t printed in that order. Their practice of reviewing old and new releases side by side makes it impossible to know for sure; but they’re definitely up to something other than eating the glue.

Out From The Void #8 $5 – 70 pages outfromthevoid@yahoo.com

This issue goes places Out From The Void hasn’t gone before. The new topics are mostly adjacent to the core topic: the missing. So it’s the CAHOOTS program, police records requests, suicide, and police killings. But on page 51 begins a 6 page essay about Israel’s genocide in Gaza. It’s sober, historical and philosophical without trumpeting statistics.

In the middle of Issue #8 is a photo essay reprinted from the zine Here’s What I’ve Hidden Under My Tongue. Writer DJT was visiting an abandoned and mostly collapsed mental institution. In the introduction Brenton Gicker comments that he didn’t write any of the stories in this issue. I appreciate that Gicker puts his mission ahead of his ego to spread awareness of these topics but I do miss his voice as a writer. But until next time, we get more tales of the missing, the lost and the found.

The story of James B. Hunt and Fluke goes back to issue #16 of the infamous Fluke fanzine in 2018. Kudos if you kept that issue, it’s now a fine collectible. Even Maximum RockNRoll said so. They saw the future, perhaps even more clearly than I did. Gina Murrell always had a sixth sense for such things. But if you wake up feeling a bit goth, have a soft spot for monsters, or just like dead stuff, NXOEED might be for you.

If you don’t recognize his art that tells me you don’t skate bruh. His art appears on show flyers, album covers, websites, rad stickers and other greasy places. But among all that ephemera this issue is special. Usually Mr. Hunt lets the ink speak for him, but this time we actually get a few precious pages of text; our first sense of the man himself. He’s a geezer, like me, trying to do punk rock things, but to also go to bed on time. I feel that in my soul.

$20 – 192 pages inequitypress@hotmail.com

It’s hard to say that many poets are famous today. But as poets go, some of those published in Big Hammer are highfalutin people now like David Cope, Donald Lev, Chris Stroffolino, Ken Greenley, and Enid Dame (RIP). Others, like Michael Pingarron, are still writing for Big Hammer. They’ve found their layer of strata, and one would hope some sense of belonging.

The first issue of Big Hammer rolled off the press in 1988. That was 38 years ago, kids. Statistically most of you reading this weren’t even born yet. That zine was way underground, like the Lincoln Tunnel; like the FDR Train Car in the pitch blackness of Track 61 marooned below Grand Central since 1945. But Dave Roskos is still out there in the tunnels, in the darkness, still editing and publishing Big Hammer. He’s doing it his own way, and accountable to no one. Doesn’t it sound grand?

Zine content from the eighties makes more sense in the context of its contemporary punk 7-inches” like “Too scared to be queer,” “Be a Fag,” and “Forbidden Love.” So I queued up the Homocore Hit parade cassette, and pondered its place in history. Homocore ran for just 7 issues between 1988 and 1991. If you didn’t catch my drift, it tapped into two communities which still remain the core of the underground today: queers and …

author: Slingshot robot #1
title: a14 – Book Review of Empire of Normality by Robert Chapman
content:
Where do normal people come from?

In Empire of Normality, Robert Chapman, a British, neurodivergent Marxist, traces the idea of a normal person from the early stages of the industrial revolution. With the dismantling of the feudal agrarian economy, where a weird person still found belonging in family and community, society became a machine, a system where the roles of humans must fit the criteria of the machine, and if the machine adapts to humans at all, it considers an average person. Those who can’t adapt become deviant.

Chapman traces the change in the meaning of health, from harmony to normal functioning, by looking at key thinkers who helped this process along, starting with Descartes thinking of a human as a machine. This opened the door to evaluating each person according to a ideal of a correct, functional human. This was also the era of what Foucault called the “Great Confinement”, the warehousing of those considered insane or unemployable.

The Belgian statistician Aldolphe Quetelet wrote, L’Homme Moyen (the average man) in 1835, suggesting such a person as the basic interchangeable building block of an army or industry. Francis Galton, 1822-1911, applied statistical methods to human behavior to promote biological racism, social Darwinism (Darwin was his cousin), and eugenics. His idea of “hereditary genius” seems elitist rather than normal-centric at first, but paradoxically most people consider themselves above average.

Galton didn’t claim to be a doctor, but Emil Kraepelin followed up by using his methods to help with the medical discipline of psychiatry. This segued into the normalization of eugenics. The early Eugenics Society included “the economist John Maynard Keynes, the biologist Julian Huxley, and Galton himself.” You could show your child fit for life by cultivating their normality. “better baby” and “fitter family” contests. At the Iowa State Fair in 1911: “You are raising better cattle, better horses, and better hogs, why don’t you raise better babies?”

With the Holocaust, eugenics fell from popularity. Non-biological psychology, including Freudian psychoanalysis, returned to the older idea of health as harmony and balance, yet also advanced psychiatry into all aspects of society. And it could also be a tool of elites: Freud’s cousin, Edward Bernays, applied Freud’s concepts of the unconscious to advertising, spawning vast social control.

By the 1960s, the anti-psychiatry of Tomas Szasz, advanced in his pivoted The Myth of Mental Illness, challenged the consensus, and was perceived by many as a path of liberation from psychiatry. But as a conservative libertarian, he divided the mentally ill into those with a measurable medical illness, and those with mere problems in living, who he said sometimes pretended to be ill to get attention and avoid responsibility.

This perverse capitalist response to psychiatry influenced deinstitutionalization in the 1970s and 80s. As the ideal was “personal responsibility”, few resources were available to the liberated patients, who now faced nursing homes, prisons, homelessness and drug addiction. “From the Szaszian perspective, then, the shift from asylum to prison incarceration was a desired outcome, not an unfortunate side-effect.” Ironically, according to Chapman, Szasz’ claim, that so-called mental illness had to be a biological problem to be real, led to a re-medicalization of mental illness, the explosion of medications in our society, and even a return to Galton’s eugenics:

“In her 2008 book The Ethics of Autism, bioethicist Professor Deborah Barnbaum argued that, once prenatal diagnostic technology is capable, there will be a moral obligation to abort autistic foetuses on the grounds that being autistic is inherently incompatible with living a good human life.”

You might think that post-Fordism, the transition from an assembly line economy to more diverse forms of employment might ease the pressure for conformity. But it really diversifies that pressure to many aspects of life. In the service economy, one must always wear the mask. The work-life barrier collapses; one must be accessible to one’s employer by phone or email all the time. Not only is work driving more people to mental illness, but with the level of normality required, more people become classified as disabled relative to the economy.

At the end, Chapter reviews the neurodiversity movement, particularly autism acceptance. It expands the social model of disability, which frames …

author: Slingshot robot #1
title: a13 – The poet Nashipai
content:
My first teaching job straight out of college was on the other side of the mountain from my village, the second-highest mountain in Africa after Kilimanjaro. Mount Kenya separates two ethnic communities: The Samburu on the leeward side and the Gikuyu on the windward side. The land of the Samburu is endless savanna perfect for pastoralism. The windward side is characterized by heavy rainfall, dense forests and high-quality agricultural land; we are tillers of the soil.

Children on my side of the mountain grow up hearing wild tales of the people who live on the other side. How they only drink cattle blood mixed with milk, how a young man has to kill a lion to prove himself a true warrior, how they move often with their livestock chasing after the rains and the like. I found it quite fascinating. That’s why when the one-year contract teaching job arose in Samburu land, I accepted it quickly. I believe experiencing another people’s culture is the highest honor there is.

The Samburu people are a proud people who have clung to their culture despite “civilization” happening around them. They are also a very handsome people. The Samburu women in particular are quite graceful and charming.

Most of the teachers in the school, and in the entire Samburu land, came from my side of the mountain since literacy levels are very low in Samburu land. Over seventy percent of the Samburu cannot read or write while literacy levels are high at about ninety-two percent among the Gikuyu.

The year was 2015, and I quickly noticed how underdeveloped the area was as compared to the other side of the mountain where I’m from. They were decades behind. All the classrooms in the school were made of mud. A single room made of iron sheets served as the administration block and office for the teachers. We all had to cram into it. There wasn’t a library nor a laboratory and the latrine floors were a sea of urine. There was no lunch program, yet the little children would sometimes bring teachers milk in old soft-drink bottles which I found quite touching. Half the students had to cross a dangerous bridge from their villages to school, made of two long slippery tree trunks placed side by side, where brown water raced and roared at terrifying speed underneath them.

One of the students in the school was fifteen-year-old Nashipai who was in her second to last year of primary school. She was a brilliant student. I taught her class English. She wrote poems and short stories which she often handed to me for critique. Her literary deftness was many years ahead. I still remember the last poem I received from her, about the never-ending tribal clashes in Kenya. A lovely, sad, melodious poem. I still have it to this day and hold it dear. She handed it to me on a Friday; on Monday she didn’t show up to school.

I asked her classmates about her absence but they were tight-lipped. Ntoye, a close friend of Nashipai, came to me secretly during break.

“Nashipai got married on Saturday,” she said. “To an old man as his fourth wife,” she said, shaking her head. “She ran away on Friday night but her elder brothers caught up with her and beat her badly.”

I was a few weeks in the school and quite naïve about Samburu culture. I and two other teachers marched to the chief’s office not very far from the school. If it was any other girl, maybe they could have accepted it, they said. But Nashipai seemed like a girl who could light up the world someday. There’s a law against child marriage in Kenya, but it is rarely enforced. I believe the law only exists as one of the conditions to get funding from the West.

“But if the ceremony has already taken place and the ceremonial bull slaughtered and eaten, then there’s nothing I can do,” he said.

“She’s fifteen, chief,” we begged, “and one of our best students.”

“She’s someone’s wife now,” he said with finality.

We cycled to the nearest police post eight miles away. The police weren’t of any help either. They said they would look into it, but we knew they were going to do diddly-squat. We trudged back to school defeated. The teachers who had been in the school a long time laughed at our ignorance. They had seen it many times before, even with girls as young as eight.

Speaking to the girls of my class I realized how tradition meant everything to them. It was who they were. They couldn’t imagine not marrying a man picked for them by their fathers. Nor not getting circumcised, which they all were and is a prerequisite for …

author: Slingshot robot #1
title: a11  – Dystopian / utopian book club & walking tour  – Berkeley from a visitor’s perspective
content:
Growing up in the 90s in post-socialist Slovenia, people around me would say something was “American” when they meant it was really great. I heard things like, “Those pants are really American!” and “Wow, look at that table. That’s really American.” Soon after, however, that prevailing view became much more skeptical. While studying sociology in Slovenia, American practices were constantly on the table, subjected to ruthless criticism, starting with American military ambitions. That criticism is still very present, so whenever I go to America, people always ask me the same question: “Why?” Why would I want to go there? And yet, I found my way to Berkeley for the first time five years ago. Whatever one might think of the broader picture of America, UC Berkeley has long been seen as a top university, internationally known for both academic excellence and socio-political activism. Still, I did not expect to encounter what I did there. Berkeley surprised me. What I encountered there stayed with me.

One day in 2021, I was walking miles from South Berkeley to the Rose Garden … Yes, I walked to the Rose Garden. “You are a European, of course you walk,” people told me. On the way, I was admiring how people in Berkeley leave books they no longer want or need anymore on the sidewalk for someone else to take. Looking at it more closely, there it was – a cartoon book, Marx for Beginners by Rius. At first, I thought, “Wow!”, then I said, “Oh, of course, it is only for beginners!,” and later that book convinced me to take it home. Not because I needed an introduction to Marx, since by then I had already read the whole Capital during my Master’s. Not just once. A real one – three volumes, actually, no summaries. With footnotes, a lot of them. I took that book home because I found it fascinating that, at least in the past, it served someone. In America. And I took it home because I became part of a sharing practice that was new to me.

Marx’s famous line from his Theses on Feuerbach, “The philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways; the point is to change it,” had never really stuck with me. I had always been among those just criticizing the capitalist mode of production. But seeing alternative practices in Berkeley every day changed that and put me on the path to thinking about social relations outside of the dominant ones. Seeing a student as a temporary resident/visitor and a local as a permanent resident playing chess together on Telegraph, a piano at the Sproul Plaza welcoming passersby, Food Not Bombs feeding people in solidarity, not charity, unhoused people at that time living in People’s Park asking me about the result of the last Warriors game. Being part of practices like these, I think, can motivate or maybe even enable us to imagine relations outside those generated by competition. It can help us think beyond the demand to see ourselves constantly as entrepreneurs or projects, as people who have to manage and improve themselves and be as productive as possible, or even to think of our children in terms of human capital.

I came to think of these practices through Foucault’s view of resistance, meaning not as something outside power, but as ways of refusing to be governed in a particular way (see Security, Territory, Population). Sharing, cooperation, care, mutual aid, and collective self-organization can create what I think of as communities of resistance – communities that are not simply formed first and then resist but are produced through the very practice of relating to one another differently. These practices matter because they show that resistance is not only protest, opposition, or defending something from destruction. It means creating and sustaining different kinds of social relations in everyday life. During his repeated visits to California from the mid-70s to the early 80s, Foucault was critical of what he saw as a Californian search for an authentic “true self”. What interested him instead was how people actively shape themselves and their ways of living. What struck me in Berkeley, though, was that this experimentation was deeply relational. It was not only about shaping oneself, but also – and perhaps above all – about shaping ways of living with others. That relational dimension of Berkeley is, to me, what makes it truly distinctive – and what makes me want to return.

Does my excitement mean that if I want to live a radically different way of life, I need to pack my bags and move to …

author: Slingshot robot #1
title: 8 – DIY for  dummies – underground music festivals
content:
It all started with house shows. I moved into a garden shed in the back of a large communal house in North Oakland, and we were excited about a lot of things. We’d discuss our creative visions, share epic stories about our favorite alternative forms of travel (hitch hiking vs train hopping vs bike trips) and plot our immersive parties on the front porch over endless pots of coffee and shared spliffs. We decided to host shows once a month, and the everchanging and endlessly creative inhabitants of our home meant we had a lot of connections to musicians within the community and abroad.

Once a month or so our messy collective sprang to life — brooms and rags in action, record player bumping. We’d clean up the yard and the common spaces, redecorating with newfound objects from freepiles, sometimes fabricating props like cottony clouds billowing down from the ceiling. By early evening there were good smells bubbling out of the kitchen from big pots of stew, or pasta and veggies simmering in a cauldron of sauce. Eventually, some time before or after the last hangers-on finally stumbled home, guest musicians would retire into their sleeping bags on the living room floor or curl up on the porch sofa. Perhaps one band member was lucky enough to get snuggled by Sazmo, the sweetest of house cats.

I’ve done a lot of touring with my own bands over the years, making the most of friendships with other musicians. If I follow opportunity there’s always a place to play, a place to stay, and I can provide the same hospitality when folks come through Oakland. These creative connections still feel like my truest form of riches, the epitome of what I love about DIY music culture. You get a view into someone else’s world, what the stars look like from their backyard, what crazy outfits are in their closet, which albums they collect, where they walk for morning coffee. The (deaf?) kitten who likes to hang out inside the kick drum even while the drums are being played.

These days I don’t do as much band touring anymore, but I still find myself plotting adventures with brave friends. We travel by bicycle, and living in California gives us the opportunity to do so year round. I have a solid crew: a motley assortment of young and old bicycle riding weirdos, staunch outdoorspeople and lifelong wanderers, fearless of the weather.

It was on a bicycle trip to Angel Island about 5 years ago that my life took a turn. Angel Island is a place that you may not have heard of, since many residents of Berkeley and SF don’t even know it exists. It sits in the middle of the bay not too far from Alcatraz, across from the chaos of San Francisco’s bustling waterfront and North Beach neighborhoods, yet somehow entirely remote. What makes this place special, besides a little endemic mole and many strange abandoned buildings from bygone eras, is its complete inaccessibility to automobiles. You can take a ferry there, or a sailboat, or even a kayak, but no bridge spans from the mainland to the wilds of this mysterious place. How raccoons, deer and, more recently, coyotes got there remains a bit of a mystery — I like to imagine they came on tangled rafts of floating trash.

We had camped out at kayak camp, a 20 person site down a muddy hillside, and as the fog rolled away we went out to ride around the island and explore. We found a military battery, doors open, dark passageways that once held ammunition now littered with driftwood and pinecones. The battery was perched near the top of the mountain facing San Francisco, flanked by 3 campsites and not much else. As we surveyed the multi level ramparts, the strange passages, odd staircases and plateaus of concrete, a sweet adventurous friend of mine, a retired librarian, turned to me and said “Wouldn’t this be the best place for a music festival?”…and I had to agree. It didn’t take long for our excitement to spark like the cracklings of a fresh campfire. What could be more fun than exploring the world, sleeping outside, communal meals, evenings full of music and mornings full of coffee and sunshine? Sharing all this with our not-yet-bikey friends! And inviting bands!!! We had to try it…

The trickiest part about creating a multi-day DIY music festival campout is finding community to collaborate with. Lucky us…we have just that. My bike camping crew is family. We cook together, we eat together, we climb mountains together, we draw arrows on the ground in chalk so that no one misses the turns. When someone’s got a …

author: Slingshot robot #1
title: 7 – Spaghetti on the wall:  something  has to give
content:
We’re in a simultaneously dark and exhilarating time. Many people are feeling paralyzed and overwhelmed by economic stress, authoritarianism, the collapsing ecosystem and war.

And yet the system is toppling itself — bringing danger but also a path to a better future. How many people other than the oligarchs, the dictators and their henchmen feel like things are going well or support the economic and political establishment at this point? The bosses have over promised and under delivered — and billions of people are seething. Capitalism faces a looming debt crisis and stock market bubble of its own making, ruinously high fuel prices because of the war in Iran, increasingly destructive weather, and populations unable to start families, get decent jobs or afford health care and basic necessities. All the system seemingly has to offer is AI that will either usurp control over our lives, or go off the rails and kill us by mistake.

Extreme contradictions like this are highly unstable. You can feel it in the air — something has to give. Around the world revolts and riots are breaking out and old illusions and inertia are slipping away.

The only tool the system has left to save itself is distraction, disempowerment, isolation, and maintaining a sense that there are no alternatives — that current conditions are inevitable. Also police thugs and attacks on immigrants. None of it brings fulfillment, contentment, meaning or more than a fragile and superficial resignation to the status quo.

I want to do something to fight, but most of the time I can’t figure out what will work. It is tempting to just focus on my personal life because my little corner of life is still pleasant. But keeping our heads down under these circumstance is dangerous and just makes me feel worse in the long-run.

I think it helps to articulate the world we want clearly, boldly, publicly, and often. Corporations, computers and hierarchical structures only offer more of the same. It is up to us to dream worlds worth living in — full of emotion, cooperation, pleasure, abundance, beauty, community engagement, local color and meaning. You can’t make social change if you’re only focused on how bad everything is all the time.

We need to get beyond our bubbles and avoid setting our expectations too low. Community gardens and free boxes are great, but we can think bigger and demand more fundamental transformations. Let’s eat the whole pie, not just nibble around the edges.

When established structures collapse, it can suddenly open up opportunities for alternatives based on life-affirming values and principles. Luckily, decentralized networks and counter-institutions have been developing and refining non-coercive, horizontal, cooperative forms of organization and DIY skills for decades. These sleeper cells are ready for our moment.

We also need to be clear about what is unacceptable: wars in Gaza, Iran, Ukraine, Sudan, Myanmar and elsewhere. Masked thugs on the streets snatching our neighbors and surveillance cameras on every corner. We can’t tolerate a system which concentrates wealth for a few billionaires while most people are struggling — built on ecological destruction, fossil fuel dependence, deforestation, toxic pollution, and plastics choking the oceans and our bodies.

The passion behind the widespread rejection of data centers isn’t just about electricity prices or noise. AI is the logical conclusion of capitalism. The bosses have always sought to increase efficiency by replacing human labor with machines. Unlike previous tools that expanded human abilities, AI seeks to replace us entirely — our ability to make decisions and create. Constant interactions with machines brings only loneliness, isolation and meaninglessness. AI can’t benefit regular people — concentrates ever more wealth and power in ever fewer unaccountable hands.

To wake up from this nightmare, we need to focus away from danger, loss, grief and fear of police repression — and instead concentrate on our desires, the brighter future we’re fighting to build and the unbelievable weakness, fragility and isolation of the billionaires, their government puppets and those with fear and hate in their hearts who seek to serve them.

Making trouble in the streets isn’t the only answer — you can’t riot alone and sloppy actions can empower repressive forces — but a little disruption sure feels better than doing nothing. Action can help break the veneer of apathy and acceptance.

title: 14 de noviembre. IV Jornada de Reforestación
content:
CNT Zamora organiza un año más, en colaboración con la Regional Centro, la Jornada de Reforestación de la Sierra de la Culebra, una iniciativa nacida tras los devastadores incendios de 2022 para contribuir a la recuperación del entorno natural de Tábara. La convocatoria combina el trabajo colectivo de reforestación con árboles autóctonos, el homenaje a las víctimas de los incendios y actividades de reflexión sobre la defensa del medio rural y la responsabilidad ambiental, además de una comida popular y actuaciones culturales.

Η πρώτη φάση συγκέντρωσης υπογραφών θα ολοκληρωθεί 8 του Δεκέμβρη και οι  πρώτες υπογραφές θα επιδοθούν στο υπουργείο Οικονομικών στην Αθήνα και στο Υφυπουργείο Μακεδονίας-Θράκης στη Θεσσαλονίκη, στο πλαίσιο κινητοποιήσεων που θα πραγματοποιηθούν στα μέσα Δεκέμβρη  που παραδοσιακά καταβάλλονταν το Δώρο Χριστουγέννων.


Η συγκέντρωση των υπογραφών θα γίνει υπογράφοντας στον σύνδεσμο που έχει επισυναφθεί (ΔΕΙΤΕ ΠΑΡΑΚΑΤΩ), αλλά και με συγκέντρωση υπογραφών συνταξιούχων και εργαζομένων από κάθε σωματείο ηλεκτρονικά και έντυπα.


ΑΝΑΛΥΤΙΚΑ ΤΟ ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑ ΚΑΙ Η ΚΑΜΠΑΝΙΑ:


Συνεχίζουμε και με αποφασιστικότητα και αγώνα διεκδικούμε την 13

η

– 14

η

 σύνταξη / μισθό.


Συγκέντρωση Πέμπτη 15/10, 6μμ, άγαλμα Βενιζέλου


Τα Σωματεία των εργαζομένων στο Δημόσιο και των συνταξιούχων μετά τις επιτυχημένες κινητοποιήσεις την Πέμπτη 15 Οκτώβρη, με αιτήματα την

επαναφορά του 13ου–14ου μισθού/σύνταξης, τις ουσιαστικές αυξήσεις σε μισθούς και συντάξεις και τη λήψη μέτρων κατά της ακρίβειας, καλούν   την Πέμπτη 12 του Νοέμβρη νέα συγκέντρωση στις 6μ.μ. στο άγαλμα Βενιζέλου.


Οι συνταξιούχοι και οι εργαζόμενοι μέσα από τα σωματεία τους με αποφασιστικότητα και υπερασπιζόμενοι το δίκαιο του αγώνα τους

συνεχίζουν και  ενισχύουν τον κοινό τους αγώνα,

 με κοινές παρεμβάσεις και κινητοποιήσεις για την ανάδειξη των οξυμμένων οικονομικών προβλημάτων που αντιμετωπίζουν εργαζόμενοι και συνταξιούχοι και τη διεκδίκηση ουσιαστικών λύσεων στα αιτήματά τους.


Συνάδελφοι, συναδέλφισσες


Δεν αποδεχόμαστε να θεωρούνται κόστος

η επαναφορά του  13ου–14ου μισθού/σύνταξης, οι αυξήσεις στις συντάξεις και στους μισθούς, η δημόσια Παιδεία, Υγεία, Πρόνοια και Ασφάλιση, ενώ οι πολεμικοί εξοπλισμοί και τα συμφέροντα των επιχειρηματικών ομίλων αποτελούν προτεραιότητα

. Την ώρα που δισεκατομμύρια κατευθύνονται σε εξοπλισμούς, πολεμικές συμφωνίες και στην αποπληρωμή του δημόσιου χρέους, οι κοινωνικές ανάγκες μπαίνουν σε δεύτερη μοίρα.

Τα πρωτογενή πλεονάσματα και η υπέρβαση των φορολογικών εσόδων επιτυγχάνονται στις πλάτες του λαού

, τη στιγμή που η

ακρίβεια σε τρόφιμα, φάρμακα, ενέργεια και στέγαση εξανεμίζει το εισόδημα εργαζομένων και συνταξιούχων

και οι μεγάλοι επιχειρηματικοί όμιλοι καταγράφουν τεράστια κέρδη.


Το ζήτημα δεν είναι αν υπάρχουν χρήματα, αλλά ποιες ανάγκες επιλέγει η κυβέρνηση να χρηματοδοτεί.


Δεν ζητάμε ελεημοσύνη και προεκλογικά φιλοδωρήματα. Διεκδικούμε όσα μας ανήκουν!

Προτεραιότητά μας είναι οι κοινωνικές ανάγκες, η αξιοπρεπής ζωή, η ειρήνη και η δικαιοσύνη μεταξύ των λαών — όχι οι εξοπλισμοί, οι πόλεμοι και οι γενοκτονίες.


Με το πλαίσιο αιτημάτων που έχουμε συνδιαμορφώσει και

προτάσσοντας την επαναφορά της 13ης -14ης σύνταξης/μισθού συνεχίζουμε.

 Δεν προσαρμοζόμαστε στη φτώχεια, την εξαθλίωση και τον πόλεμο.

Δεν γινόμαστε θεατές στη λεηλασία του εισοδήματός μας, στην κατάρρευση των δημόσιων αγαθών, παιδείας, υγείας κ.λπ. και στο τσάκισμα των δικαιωμάτων μας.


Οι συνταξιούχοι εκπαιδευτικοί μαζί με τους εργαζόμενους, με τη δύναμη του δίκιου, την αλήθεια των αναγκών και το κοινωνικό συμφέρον, διεκδικούν:


Επαναφορά 13

ης

– 14

ης

σύνταξης – μισθού, 1400 βασικός μισθός – σύνταξη,  κατάργηση της εισφοράς αλληλεγγύης,  μπλόκο στην ακρίβεια με κατάργηση ΕΦΚ/ΦΠΑ στα είδη λαϊκής κατανάλωσης, μέτρα για τα ενοίκια και την κατοικία.


Όλοι/ες την  Πέμπτη 12 Νοέμβρη 2026, ώρα 6μ.μ.  στη συγκέντρωση στο Άγαλμα Βενιζέλου.


Καμπάνια συλλογής υπογραφών για την άμεση επαναφορά του 13ου-14ου μισθού και της

 

13ης-14ης σύνταξης


Εμείς που υπογράφουμε το παρακάτω κείμενο εργαζόμενοι, συνταξιούχοι, συλλογικότητες και κοινωνικοί φορείς

απαιτούμε την άμεση επαναφορά του 13ου-14ου μισθού/σύνταξης.


Η κατάργησή τους από τα χρόνια των μνημονίων ήταν άδικη, κοινωνικά ανάλγητη, νομικά ευάλωτη, οικονομικά αναποτελεσματική, ενώ ψευδώς και παραπλανητικά θεωρήθηκε ως προσωρινή.


Ο 13ος-14ος μισθός/σύνταξη  αποτελεί μια απολύτως δίκαιη κοινωνική κατάκτηση. Πρόκειται για «

αναβληθέντα μισθό

author: Kodao Productions
title: Detained journalist Cumpio receives international award
content:
The International Women’s Media Foundation (IWMF) bestowed on journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio the 2026 Wallis Annenberg Justice for Women Journalists Award in a ceremony in New York City on Tuesday.


IWMF said it honors Cumpio for reporting on social inequality in the Eastern Visayas region, including land rights abuses, the killings of farmers, disaster response, and the impacts of militarized conflict under government policies.


The prize was named after the prominent American philanthropist and heiress who championed various environmental and social advocacies such as the Liberty Canyon Wildlife Crossings LGBTQ+ and HIV/AIDS charities.


IWMF cited that as a student journalist at the University of the Philippines-Tacloban, Cumpio rose quickly within alternative media networks, becoming a leading voice in regional and grassroots reporting.


Charged with crimes widely regarded as fabricated, IWMF said Cumpio’s work – and her continued imprisonment – highlights the use of legal mechanisms, including anti-terror laws and red-tagging, to silence independent media in the Philippines.


The announcement of the 2026 Wallis Annenberg Justice for Women Journalists Award in New York City. (Photo by Vince Reasonda/Altermidya)


In a message upon learning of her victory last May, Cumpio said she is “deeply honored” to receive the award given to reporters unjustly detained, jailed, or imprisoned.


Cumpio added she gives “greater salute to everyone who continues to believe in truth and justice.”


Persecuted journalist


Cumpio had been in jail since her arrest in February 2020 in Tacloban City, along with four other fellow rights defenders.


Cumpio and church worker Marielle Domequil were acquitted from four charges of illegal possession of firearms and explosives but were convicted on the added charges of terrorism financing in 2025. Their conviction is being appealed with the Court of Appeals in the Visayas.


Both are currently detained at the Correctional Institute for Women in Mandaluyong City.


Cumpio was executive director of independent news outlet Eastern Vista and a radio broadcaster with Aksyon Radyo Tacloban at the time of their arrest.


In 2026, Cumpio was nominated for the UNESCO Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize and was shortlisted for the Reporters Without Borders Courage Prize in 2025.


“Growing up in one of the poorest regions in my country, taking part in unveiling the truth and exposing abuse has rather been a necessity than a choice. Journalism in a country ruled by only one percent of its population means providing the masses and marginalized sectors with a voice. This [award] is recognition of the truth and the strength of the united people,” Cumpio said.


Cumpio’s fellow alternative journalist Vince Reasonda was present in Tuesday’s awarding ceremony. #

(Raymund B. Villanueva)

author: Bulatlat Contributors
title: Gabriela sweeps away Trump’s Pax Silica
content:
Those who violate the rights and well-being of women and children are not welcome in the Philippines.

MANILA – “Stop the rape of our motherland! Kick Trump out!”

This is the call of progressive women’s group Gabriela during a protest near the US Embassy, November 9. The women’s group asserted that there should be no red carpet welcome to warmongerers like Trump.

Jacq Ruiz, spokesperson of Kilusan ng Manggagawang Kababaihan (KMK) said, “There is no special treatment for us women workers, who remain mired in extreme poverty, while billions of pesos are being allocated solely for preparations for the signing of the Pax Silica agreement.”

Read: Economic insecurity of women workers worsen

While Filipino culture is known for warmly welcoming visitors with a feast, they said Trump is an exception as many Filipino households are struggling to put even a decent meal on their own tables.

For a mother like Lanie Buena, 54, it is a struggle to get through the day. She is working as a manicurist and pedicurist in their house in Quezon City for eight years while her husband is working as a barber.

She earns P400 or about $6 for three clients in a day. But this is not enough, she said, as there are no guaranteed clients every day.

What she earns, she said, is not adequate for a family of seven with two students still going to school. There are still household expenses such as electricity and water bills.

Meanwhile, Gabriela Women’s Partylist Rep. Sarah Elago said, “Those who violate the rights and well-being of women and children are not welcome in the Philippines.”

Elago condemned Trump, calling him a macho-fascist and a war criminal, citing his role in waging and escalating wars that have claimed countless civilian lives, including children in Palestine. She added that Trump’s links to the Epstein files makes him less welcome in the country.

The Trump administration’s war against Iran and its support to Israel has contributed to a global oil price shock, with its effects now being felt by Filipino families from rising fuel costs to increasing cost of goods in the market.

The women’s group said they are determined to ensure that Trump will not receive a warm welcome but instead will be faced by massive protests rejecting his visit and the proposed Pax Silica Initiatives.

“What we will present is a flaming protest, because individuals like Donald—a rapist, molester, and war criminal—are utterly shameless and devoid of any moral compass,” said Elle Buntag, spokesperson of Salinlahi Alliance for Children’s Concerns. (AMU, RVO)

author: Bruno Fonseca
title: Na semana da COP31, Tarcísio nomeia Ricardo Salles para o governo de São Paulo
content:
O governador reeleito de São Paulo, Tarcisio de Freitas (Republicanos), tem um novo nome no seu quadro: o advogado Ricardo Salles, ex-ministro do Meio Ambiente do governo Bolsonaro, que assumirá o cargo de secretário de Justiça e Cidadania no estado. Ele substituirá Arthur Lima, militar que coordenou o Gabinete de Segurança Institucional (GSI) entre 2008 e 2011 nas gestões Lula e Dilma Rousseff (PT).


A nomeação de Salles para o governo Tarcísio a partir de janeiro de 2027 acontece num momento no mínimo contraditório: nesta quarta-feira, dia 11 de novembro, o presidente Lula (PT)

discursou

 na abertura da Cúpula de Líderes da 31ª edição da Conferência do Clima, pedindo que os países ricos cumpram seus compromissos assumidos no enfrentamento às mudanças climáticas. Na sua gestão como ministro do Meio Ambiente entre 2019 e 2021, Salles foi responsável por reduzir o trabalho de fiscalização do Ibama contra crimes ambientais.


Salles foi também o autor da célebre frase de que o governo deveria “passar a boiada” em relação à regulamentação ambiental no Brasil. A declaração aconteceu durante a também infame reunião ministerial do governo Bolsonaro, realizada em abril de 2020, em meio à pandemia de covid-19. Na data, o ministro do Meio Ambiente defendeu que: “precisa ter um esforço nosso aqui, enquanto estamos nesse momento de tranquilidade no aspecto de cobertura de imprensa, porque só se fala de covid, e ir passando a boiada, e mudando todo o regramento [ambiental), e simplificando normas”.


As falas de Salles e dos demais ministros vieram a público apenas em maio daquele ano, quando o vídeo da reunião foi tornado público por decisão do ministro Celso de Mello, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF).


O ministro relatava um inquérito que apurava se Bolsonaro havia tentado interferir na Polícia Federal (PF), como foi denunciado pelo ex-ministro Sérgio Moro e agora governador eleito do Paraná. Moro rompeu com Bolsonaro na época acusando o então presidente de interferência após demitir o então diretor-geral da PF, Maurício Valeixo, e insistir em trocas de comando da corporação no Rio de Janeiro, onde vivem seus filhos. Seis anos depois, Moro apoiou Flávio Bolsonaro na eleição para presidente e foi eleito pelo PL, partido da família Bolsonaro.


Um ex-ministro do Meio Ambiente acusado de envolvimento com extração ilegal de madeira


Ricardo Salles é réu, desde 2023, em uma ação penal sobre contrabando de madeira da Amazônia. Ele é acusado de suposto envolvimento com uma organização criminosa que contrabandeava madeira para os Estados Unidos e a União Europeia. O processo segue no STF, sob relatoria de Alexandre de Moraes.


Em 2021, a

Agência Pública


mostrou

 como o então ministro recebeu em seu gabinete um grupo de madeireiros envolvidos na exploração irregular no Pará. A reportagem revelou como esse primeiro encontro rendeu frutos, com Salles indo ao estado e gravando um vídeo defendendo a legalidade da extração e da ação dos madeireiros. A imagem foi usada na época para embasar uma notícia-crime da PF do Amazonas contra o ex-ministro.


Foram as investigações contra Salles que levaram à sua saída do governo. Ele pediu exoneração do Ministério do Meio Ambiente em 23 de junho de 2021.


A

Pública

 mostrou como a gestão de Salles no Ministério do Meio Ambiente foi marcada por uma redução na fiscalização ambiental e nas multas. Reportagem

revelou

 como essa diminuição aconteceu justamente em locais onde o desmatamento mais crescia. No Pará, houve descontinuação das ações de fiscalização, além de exonerações e trocas no corpo técnico do Ibama. Salles também foi responsável por nomear militares, muitos deles paulistas, nas ações de combate a crimes ambientais.


A

Pública

 também teve acesso a atas de reuniões do Conselho Nacional da Amazônia Legal (CNAL), nas quais Salles atacou, sem provas, a teoria do ponto de não retorno da Amazônia, considerada referência no mundo todo. A teoria alerta que o desmatamento do bioma pode levar a uma perda irreversível da floresta, que entraria em um processo de se tornar uma savana.


Além disso, a

Pública


mostrou

 em 2023 como uma representação contra Salles, que chegou na Comissão de Ética da Presidência, foi arquivada. A denúncia partiu justamente da fala do político contra a regulamentação ambiental feita na reunião ministerial de abril de 2020. O ex-ministro teve ainda outras cinco representações analisadas pela Comissão entre 2021 e 2022, que envolviam uso de redes …

author: Lilli Akpaleeapik
title: Iqaluit observes Remembrance Day at cadet hall
content:
The cadet hall in Iqaluit was overflowing with about 300 people during the Royal Legion’s Remembrance Day ceremony Wednesday morning.


The annual event began around 11 a.m. in both English and Inuktitut.


“Canada as a nation owes an everlasting debt of gratitude to the men and women who have served and continue to serve their country, in times of war and peace,” said legion Branch 168 president John Graham,  the master of ceremonies.


The day began with a march that included police, veterans and community members. It began at the RCMP building on Sivumugiaq Street and ended at the hall.


RCMP chaplain Paul Hitz spoke about sharing gratitude for those who served.


“It is also a day to express our gratitude to those who serve today, the members of our Canadian Armed Forces, including our Canadian Rangers who stand guard over the ideals we as Canadians cherish,” he said. “Lest we forget.”


Hitz also acknowledged the youth who joined the ceremony and highlighted the significance of their presence.


Remembrance Day wreaths were laid at the cadet hall in Iqaluit on Wednesday during the Royal Canadian Legion’s annual Remembrance Day ceremony. (Photo by Lilli Akpaleepaik)


“To the youth among us, many of whom cannot yet imagine the realities of war, this day matters too. May your hearts and minds be stirred by what we place before you today,” he said.


Nunavut’s deputy Commissioner Lew Philip and RCMP Staff Sgt. Abdelmalek Mezdour laid the first wreath. Nunavut MP Lori Idlout and Premier John Main followed.


Iqalummiut laid wreaths for loved ones who served. Cadets placed wreaths purchased by Canadian North, Arctic Survival Store, Baffin Building Systems and Nunavut Animal Rescue.


Just before Graham’s closing remarks, David Hoyt, an Iqaluit cadet flight sergeant, recited Lt.-Col. John McCrae’s

In Flanders Fields

.

content:

Sigamos uniendo las luchas de la clase trabajadora


¡Compañeras! ¡Compañeros! Hoy hemos parado y salido a la calle porque los derechos no se piden, ¡se toman y se defienden!


Si echamos la vista atrás: ni la jornada de ocho horas, ni las vacaciones pagadas, ni la protección frente al despido fueron concesiones; conseguimos esos derechos gracias a las huelgas, a las cajas de resistencia, a décadas de organización colectiva y a la generosidad y esfuerzo de todas las compañeras y compañeros que pelearon por un mundo mejor para la clase trabajadora.


Y por eso mismo estamos hoy aquí, organizadas y utilizando la herramienta que siempre nos ha funcionado, la huelga: para decir basta a que, después de sacrificar nuestro tiempo y vida a cambio de un salario, no podamos ni pagar un techo bajo el que vivir.


La huelga es algo más que una movilización, es una protesta que interrumpe la producción, que duele y pone nerviosa a la patronal cuando la ven reflejada en sus cuentas. La huelga va más allá de grandes manifestaciones, rebasa las calles y entra en los centros de trabajo; la huelga demuestra que somos nosotras las que hacemos funcionar la economía, y que la podemos parar ante la injusticia del acaparamiento del fruto de nuestro trabajo por parte del capital.


Nos pagan salarios de miseria que no alcanzan, se llevan otra mordida con alquileres imposibles, nos desahucian y cortan los suministros si encima no los podemos pagar, seguimos teniendo la misma jornada laboral que hace más de 100 años y después de una vida entera trabajando no nos queda ni la certeza de podernos jubilar. Y todo esto tiene unos responsables, unas causas comunes que debemos enfrentar. No podemos conformarnos con pedir precios más bajos. ¡En la CNT queremos lo que por justicia social nos pertenece!: salarios y pensiones dignos, reducción de la jornada sin reducir el salario, y trabajo y casa para todas. En estas exigencias está lo que nos une a quienes solo vivimos de nuestro trabajo. Y esta huelga lo está demostrando.


Sin embargo, también sabemos que no todas podemos parar. Hay compañeras migradas sin papeles, atrapadas por una Ley de Extranjería que exige un contrato que no se puede conseguir sin ellos, que arriesgan mucho más que un día de sueldo. También hay trabajadoras con contratos tan frágiles que ejercer su derecho equivale a perder el empleo, falsas autónomas sin amparo alguno, trabajadoras de los cuidados y del hogar sin convenio ni interlocutor, personas atrapadas en contratas y subcontratas que nunca ven a su verdadero patrón, y quienes temen las represalias de empresas que han hecho de la amenaza una forma de gestionar las relaciones laborales. El hecho de que no puedan parar es la prueba de que la precariedad está diseñada para que defender los derechos salga caro. Las que sí hemos podido parar en esta huelga la hacemos también suya. El apoyo mutuo es la base de nuestra lucha, el sindicalismo de clase y combativo no deja a nadie atrás.


Desde la CNT entendemos además que, en esta disputa, el Estado no es una institución neutral ni un simple instrumento de la patronal: es una institución con intereses propios. Estos, a veces, coinciden con los de las clases dominantes y, en otras ocasiones, parecen estar a nuestro favor. Pero no podemos dejar que la patronal y el Estado jueguen con nuestros derechos a su antojo. No podemos permitir que cojan nuestras exigencias y nos las devuelvan diezmadas e irreconocibles.


No podemos permitir, tampoco, que pretendan dividirnos dejando a las trabajadoras migradas sin derechos. No vamos a conformarnos con sus migajas, lo queremos todo para todas, y ese todo solo lo podemos conseguir unidas, mediante la acción directa y en organizaciones propias de clase, independientes de gobiernos, instituciones y partidos.


Para la CNT, la huelga de hoy es un punto de partida: un paro de 24 horas es insuficiente, pero es un comienzo. Mañana, las que hemos parado y las que no hemos podido, tenemos que seguir encontrándonos; hacernos fuertes en nuestros centros de trabajo mediante las secciones sindicales y las asambleas de trabajadoras, y en los barrios y pueblos con las redes de solidaridad de las vecinas. Los sindicatos somos el nexo de unión, el punto de encuentro de todas nuestras luchas. La forma en la que se ha organizado esta …

author: David Venn
title: QIA considers ‘next steps’ after NIRB recommends hydro plant move forward without review
content:
The Qikiqtani Inuit Association is “considering its next steps” after the Nunavut Impact Review Board recommended that Iqaluit’s proposed hydro project move forward without a public review.


“Our priority remains ensuring that the development of new energy infrastructure advances alongside the protection of Inuit rights,” reads a statement from QIA spokesperson Markoosie Qaunirq, issued Tuesday.


The $500-million Iqaluit Nukkiksautiit Hydro Project, currently in its preliminary design phase, is proposed by Nunavut Nukkiksautiit Corp., a subsidiary of Qikiqtaaluk Corp., which is the QIA’s development arm.


If approved, it will lead to the construction of a hydroelectric plant able to produce up to 30 megawatts on the Kuugaaluk River, about 60 kilometres northeast of the city. It will also include a 7,136-hectare reservoir and a 66-kilometre access road.


NNC president Harry Flaherty has said the plant could replace 15 million litres of diesel fuel imported every year to generate electricity.


In November 2025, Prime Minister Mark Carney named it a “nation-building” project to fast-track approvals. That move meant construction could begin in 2028 — two years earlier than originally anticipated.


On Nov. 4, the Nunavut Impact Review Board published its screening decision report, which determined a review of the proposal was unnecessary, and notified Minister of Arctic and Northern Affairs Rebecca Chartrand, who has the final say, of its decision. The board examines the social and economic impact of proposed developments and advises the federal government on whether the minister should allow the project to proceed.


The board’s reasoning was that potential adverse effects can be addressed through terms and conditions and that the project does not “involve technological innovations for which the effects are unknown,” according to the screening report.


But QIA had argued that the effectiveness of mitigation efforts was uncertain, particularly for fish habitat, wildlife movement, permafrost conditions and harvesting.


Chartrand has 150 days to respond.


In the meantime, the Inuit association is planning its own community engagement events in Iqaluit and Pangnirtung, the release said.


Qaunirq did not respond to a request for comment, nor did the review board.

title: Поздравьте политзаключенного панк-музыканта Максима Лунина с днем рождения!
content:
Команда «Огней свободы» напоминает о приближающемся дне рождения Максима Лунина:

22 ноября Максиму исполняется 21 год. Это его второй день рождения в заключении. Отправьте ему открытку или письмо — он будет этому очень рад!

Максима задержали в марте 2025 года. По версии следствия, он готовился атаковать релейный шкаф в городе Верхняя Салда Свердловской области и рисовал граффити со словом «РДК» по заданию «гражданина Украины». При этом из материалов дела понятно, что сотрудники ФСБ начали следить за Луниным за несколько дней до первого сообщения от «украинца».

Лунина обвиняют по статьям о «покушении на диверсию», «участии в террористической организации» и «призывах к терроризму». Сам он не отрицает, что общался с неизвестным, который предлагал ему денег, но подчеркивает, что в первую очередь им двигали антивоенные взгляды.

До ареста Максим был фронтменом панк-группы ДАША*, которую собрал с друзьями. Еще он увлекается комиксами и сам рисует их, любит видеоигры. В СИЗО он очень много читает.

Адрес для писем: 620019, ул. Репина д. 4, СИЗО-1, Свердловская область, г. Екатеринбург, Лунин Максим Петрович, 2005 г. р. Электронные письма можно отправить через сервис ZT.

Также можно поддержать сбор на юридическую помощь для Максима.

title: Çanakkale Emek, Barış ve Demokrasi Platformu: İşçilerin yaşam hakkı sermayenin kâr hırsından değerlidir
content:
Çanakkale Emek, Barış ve Demokrasi Güçleri HABAŞ’ta 19 işçinin hayatını kaybettiği ve pek çok işçinin yaralandığı patlamaya karşı bugün İskele Meydanında eylem ve basın açıklaması yaptı. Açıklamada iş cinayetlerine dikkat çekilirken Çanakkale de Dardanel işçilerinin ücretlerinin ödenmemesine de tepki gösterildi. Açıklamayı Eğitim Sen Şube Başkanı İnal Akoğlu okudu.

İşçilerin bir kez daha alınmayan iş güvenliği önlemlerinin, denetimsizliğin ve sermayenin kâr hırsının bedelini canlarıyla ödediğini söyleyen Akoğlu, “Bugün burada yalnızca acımızı paylaşmak için değil, bu katliamın sorumlularından hesap sormak için bulunuyoruz. HABAŞ’ta yaşananlar sıradan bir iş kazası olarak değerlendirilemez. İlk bulgular, bakım çalışmaları sırasında tavan vincinin düşmesi ve gaz hattının zarar görmesiyle patlamanın meydana geldiğine işaret etmektedir. Ancak asıl sorgulanması gereken, böyle bir facianın yaşanmasına hangi ihmallerin, hangi denetimsizliklerin ve hangi çalışma koşullarının zemin hazırladığıdır. Üstelik aynı fabrikada son üç hafta içerisinde, 21 Ekim ve 5 Kasım tarihlerinde iki işçinin daha yaşamını yitirdiği açıklanmıştır. Daha önce yaşanan ölümlere rağmen gerekli önlemler alınmamış, etkin denetim sağlanmamışsa bunun adı ihmal değil, göz göre göre gelen bir işçi katliamıdır” ifadelerini kullandı.

Türkiye’de işçi ölümlerinin ve emek sömürüsünün artık münferit olaylar olmaktan çıktığını vurgulayan Akoğlu, “Madenlerde, fabrikalarda, inşaatlarda, tersanelerde emekçiler çalışırken ölmekte; farklı işkollarında çalışan milyonlarca emekçi ise güvencesizlik, düşük ücret, ücret gaspı ve ağır çalışma koşullarıyla karşı karşıya bırakılmaktadır. Her facianın ardından aynı açıklamalar yapılmakta, soruşturmalar başlatılmakta, sorumluların hesap vereceği söylenmekte; ancak işçilerin yaşamına mal olan ve emeğini değersizleştiren düzen değişmemektedir” şeklinde konuştu.

İş güvenliğinin yalnızca işverenlerin iyi niyetine bırakılamayacağının altını çizen Akoğlu, “Devletin denetim sorumluluğu, işverenin yükümlülükleri ve çalışanların yaşam hakkı tartışmasız biçimde güvence altına alınmalıdır.

Buradan açıkça ifade ediyoruz. İşçiler çalışırken ölmek zorunda değildir. İş cinayetleri kader değildir. Çanakkale’de yaşananlar da emekçilerin karşı karşıya bırakıldığı tablonun başka bir yüzünü göstermektedir. İlimizde faaliyet gösteren Dardanel fabrikasında çalışan işçilerin ücretlerini zamanında alamaması, emekçilerin en temel haklarından biri olan ücret hakkının dahi güvencesiz bırakıldığını ortaya koymaktadır. İşçinin emeğinin karşılığını alamaması, geçimini sağlayamaması ve ailesinin ihtiyaçlarını karşılayamaz hale getirilmesi kabul edilemez. Ücret, işverenin lütfu değil, işçinin alın terinin ve emeğinin karşılığıdır. HABAŞ’ta işçiler yaşamını yitirirken, Çanakkale’de işçiler emeklerinin karşılığını almak için mücadele etmek zorunda bırakılmaktadır. Farklı biçimlerde ortaya çıksa da her iki tabloyu yaratan anlayış aynıdır: Emeği ucuzlatan, işçiyi güvencesizleştiren ve sermayenin çıkarlarını emekçinin yaşamının önüne koyan düzen. Buradan Dardanel yönetimine de çağrımızdır: İşçilerin birikmiş ücret alacakları derhal ve eksiksiz ödenmeli, emekçilerin ekonomik ve sosyal hakları güvence altına alınmalıdır” dedi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.
