author: CMI Argentina
title: Exigen reconocimiento de enfermedades laborales en escuelas por agrotóxicos
content:
Más de 165 organizaciones sindicales y colectivos socioambientales presentaron un petitorio ante la Dirección General de Cultura y Educación bonaerense (DGCyE), en La Plata, con más de 3.000 firmas de integrantes de comunidades educativas y de la población en general, para exigirle al Estado el reconocimiento de las enfermedades laborales de trabajadores/as de la educación originadas por la exposición a las fumigaciones con agrotóxicos y al consumo de agua con estos elementos, y por el efecto sinérgico que se produce por su combinación con agua contaminada con niveles de arsénico más elevados de lo permitido por normativa, en las instituciones educativas.


“Los casos de las compañeras maestras Ana Zabaloy en San Antonio de Areco (pcia Bs As), víctima de asesinato laboral por trabajar en condiciones insalubres en una escuela rural y a quien el Estado nunca le reconoció su enfermedad oncológica en el marco de la Ley de Riesgos de Trabajo; y de Estela Lemes en Entre Ríos, quien presenta agrotóxicos en sangre y tuvo que judicializar su situación para que le reconozcan su enfermedad laboral, son ejemplos contundentes del impacto del agronegocio en la salud. Se suman argumentos a nuestro planteo con la reciente investigación y denuncia protagonizada por el sindicato AMSAFE Rosario del 2024 (en ese entonces con la conducción de la Lista Multicolor) que demostró que docentes y auxiliares de distintas escuelas presentaban daño génico por la presencia de agrotóxicos en su ambiente laboral”, detallan las organizaciones, al tiempo que invitan a Sindicatos Docentes y de Auxiliares de la Educación a que se sumen a esta demanda.


Entre las medidas urgentes que reclaman las organizaciones se encuentran el reconocimiento inmediato, y con carácter retroactivo, de las enfermedades laborales productos del agronegocio; la implementación de programas permanentes de vigilancia sanitaria para docentes y auxiliares; la realización de análisis integrales del agua en todos los establecimientos educativos, donde se provea agua segura hasta tanto se demuestre su potabilidad; medidas de protección con aumento de distancias progresivas ante las fumigaciones de agrotóxicos para garantizar las condiciones mínimas de seguridad e higiene en cada escuela, en función de que se cumplan los derechos laborales básicos.


“La salud de las comunidades educativas no puede esperar. Exigimos respuestas concretas y medidas urgentes para garantizar el derecho a la salud y a condiciones de trabajo y de enseñanza seguras”, reclaman las organizaciones.

author: Julius Gavroche
title: The children in revolt
content:
by Francesco Demitry


from

lundimatin

, #541, 10/11/2026


They learn to wait for the bell, the bus, their turn to speak, permission to go out, for the day someone deems them old enough to understand the world. They learn to become alienated. They learn to keep quiet, to be silent. Then, one morning, they overturn the tables in front of the gate, and the town discovers they exist.


The young people who have occupied the streets in Italy and France in recent weeks are not mere ambassadors of hope, nor are they the innocent mascots of a political establishment running out of words. They are bodies that are hungry, that are cold, that feel anger and desire, that know overcrowded classrooms, dismantled services, and a mortgaged future. In France, the mobilisation began in the Parisian suburbs, where students denounced the deterioration of schools, vacant teaching positions, and the lack of nurses and social workers. It spread to more than a thousand schools across the country. In Italy, students led the marches against the high cost of living, rents, low wages, rearmament, and the war economy. In Genoa, thousands of people entered the port to protest the transit of weapons. Different stories, but on both sides of the Alps, the same melody is emerging: that of a generation rejecting a world it is supposed to inherit, a world that is already closed.


To whom does a school belong without teachers? To whom belongs a city where the bus is too expensive, where housing is becoming unaffordable, where the park is fenced off and the courtyard sold? School is where inequality is laid bare: a crumbling building in a working-class neighborhood, a replacement teacher who never arrives, a closed workshop, a dry tap. Our address should not determine our future, some French high school students have written. Capitalism seeks to transform space into destiny, assigning each person a piece of the city and calling the distance between those who can cross it and those who must remain confined to their neighborhood or be evicted a matter of merit.


Governments respond with budgets and decrees. They announce recruitment and controls, deploy law enforcement. On November 5th, in France, as unions and students took to the streets again to demand better wages, public services, and education, the state deployed a significant security apparatus. In Italy, a few days earlier, police water cannons had dispersed a march in Turin. Faced with people forging their own path, the authorities presented the bill: order. But a public square is not a classroom that can simply be brought into line. The square is overflowing; it is bursting at the seams. Those who are protesting cannot simply be asked to raise their hands and wait for their demands to be reviewed by the appropriate department.


Luis Buñuel found an extraordinary image of how a social class, that of the old petty bourgeoisie, manages to survive everything; even the disintegration of the world around it. In

The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie

, six characters are constantly trying to sit down at the table, to have a meal, to re-establish the small order of their habits. But something intervenes each time to interrupt them: a corpse, an army, the police, a story of violence, a dream that invades reality. The world knocks on the dining room door, and dinner is inevitably postponed. And the most disturbing thing is not that these people continue to desire their meal, but that each catastrophe seems incapable of changing anything in their lives. The bourgeoisie possesses this extraordinary capacity: to absorb interruption, to transform conflict into an annoyance, a minor inconvenience, history into a conversation that must be interrupted, always with decorum. Even when everything falls apart, the napkin is folded, the glass refilled, the appointment postponed. But it is above all in

The Phantom of Liberty

 that Buñuel pushes this intuition to its most radical consequences. A group of bourgeois is invited to dinner and cordially ushered around a table surrounded by toilets. The guests sit down, lower their trousers, relieve themselves, and, in the meantime, smoke while conversing amiably. They talk about travel, current events, social conventions, without anyone seeming to find anything strange about the situation. The indecency, if there is any in this scene, lies elsewhere: in the act of eating. When they are hungry, the guests discreetly withdraw to a small room to eat their meal alone …

author: Derek Seidman
title: WWII Sparked Anti-Fascist Ideas Among War Workers. What Lessons Can We Learn?
content:
Historian Tejasvi Nagaraja explains how wartime mobilization generated wider organizing around labor, race, and empire.

Historian Tejasvi Nagaraja explains how wartime mobilization generated wider organizing around labor, race, and empire.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

World War II was a period of enormous mobilization in U.S. society that brought together tens of millions of “war workers” — soldiers and laborers in war-essential industries, spanning the globe. While mainstream mythologies persist of the World War II years as a period of “consensus,” Black Americans fought in a Jim Crow military while Japanese Americans were interned by the U.S. government. Moreover, the wartime mobilization generated massive conflict and resistance around labor, race, and empire.

Tejasvi Nagaraja is a historian of labor and racial capitalism at Cornell University, and the author of Troop Movements: Labor, Race, and Global Freedom Struggles in America’s World War II. As he shows in this new book, soldiers and defense workers, stationed across much of the world, waged and linked struggles for labor and civil rights and against colonialism and imperialism throughout the 1940s. Furthermore, many World War II veterans and war workers, drawing on wartime political experiences forged in a period of rising anti-fascist consciousness, went on to lead and provide guidance for major postwar U.S. social movements into the 1960s and beyond.

In this exclusive Truthout interview, published on Veteran’s Day, Nagaraja discusses Troop Movements and what lessons its history might hold for organizers and activists today. This interview has been lightly edited for length and clarity.

Derek Seidman: The military is sometimes imagined as separate from the rest of society, but your book shows how blurred these lines really were during the 1940s. Can you elaborate on this?

Tejasvi Nagaraja: World War II was, at least for the United States, the closest thing to a total war mobilization. Most employment was converted to military service in the armed forces and to working in war-essential industries. Virtually every family and community had members in the military and defense industries.

The story I tell about World War II is about what happened in this realm, where tens of millions of people were in the armed forces and defense industries, and their experiences at home, but also abroad — in Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Caribbean.

Labor during World War II was not just working at a Michigan auto factory or Appalachian coal mine, but also cooking and cleaning on a military base in Texas and Mississippi or France, or building the Ledo Road across China, Burma, and India. These were sites of labor experience and labor struggle.

The 1930s and 1940s were a peak period of union membership growth and strike activity in U.S. history. Wildcat strikes were happening in defense industries during World War II. Service members in the Army, Navy, and Air Force engaged in wildcat strikes, hunger strikes, and mutinies to protest labor conditions.

The 1930s and 1940s were a peak period of union membership growth and strike activity in U.S. history. Wildcat strikes were happening in defense industries during World War II.

Black men and women protested labor, policing, and jailing conditions. They experienced race and class struggles — not just in Georgia, but in Massachusetts, as well as in France, India, and the Philippines. Their struggles linked up to global questions.

There was a real blurring of defense industry and service member labor, and civil rights and worker struggles, at home and abroad. It was a time of global anti-fascist struggle and global decolonial possibility, linking the U.S. working class, in some moments, to working people from other regions.

A huge part of the U.S. working class was tied to the war machine during World War II. How did leftists and anti-imperialists who opposed war and militarism engage with this reality?

The 1940s were a crucible through which the longer struggles of economic, racial, and global politics were transformed. In this context, labor, civil rights, and global justice activists navigated a contradictory and double-edged terrain. They sometimes made a devil’s bargain that we can understand as partly a question of choice and political ideology, but also of not making history as we please and having to navigate things bigger than …

title: Απελευθέρωση του Μπαρίς Ερχάν – Συλλογή υπογραφών
content:
Σκίτσο: Γιώργος Κωνσταντίνου


Μια κραυγή μέσα από τους τοίχους της φυλακής, η επιστολή του Barış Erhan. Είναι η φωνή ενός ανθρώπου που εγκατέλειψε την Τουρκία αναζητώντας ασφάλεια και ελευθερία, για να βρεθεί στην Ελλάδα αντιμέτωπος με μια πρωτόδικη καταδίκη 74 χρόνων και ενός μήνα για διακίνηση μεταναστών. Θύμα της θανατοπολιτικής του ελληνικού κράτους και της ΕΕ.


Πολιτικός ακτιβιστής, σοσιαλιστής και καλλιτέχνης, ο Barış περιγράφει τη διαδρομή του και τη δράση του, τις διώξεις στην Τουρκία, τις συνθήκες σύλληψης και δίκης στην Ελλάδα, αλλά και την οδυνηρή εμπειρία της φυλάκισης. Καταγγέλλει σοβαρές αδικίες και ζητά να ακουστεί…


Η μαρτυρία του ξεπερνά τα όρια μιας προσωπικής υπόθεσης. Θέτει ένα κρίσιμο ερώτημα για τη δικαιοσύνη, τα δικαιώματα των προσφύγων και τη μεταχείριση όσων κατηγορούνται για διακίνηση ανθρώπων. Πίσω από τους αριθμούς και τις βαριές ποινές υπάρχουν άνθρωποι, ζωές και αξιοπρέπειες που δεν μπορούν να αγνοούνται.


Ο Barış ζητά να μην παραμείνει αόρατος και ξεχασμένος. Η επιστολή του είναι μια έκκληση για αλήθεια, δικαιοσύνη και ελευθερία. Γιατί η αλληλεγγύη δεν σταματά στις πόρτες των φυλακών — και η ανθρώπινη αξιοπρέπεια δεν φυλακίζεται.

 Τετάρτη 11/11, στις 18:30


 Πάρκο Νίκου Παπάζογλου (Αγίου Θεράποντα), Κάτω Τούμπα


Η συναυλία πραγματοποιείται στην ίδια γειτονιά όπου τις προηγούμενες ημέρες δόθηκε ένας σημαντικός αγώνας ενάντια στην έξωση του ηλικιωμένου ζευγαριού. Η αναβολή της έξωσης μέχρι τις 19 Ιανουαρίου αποτελεί μια πρώτη ουσιαστική νίκη της οικογένειας, των σωματείων ενοικιαστ(ρι)ών, των εργατικών σωματείων, των συλλογικοτήτων, της γειτονιάς και της κοινωνίας της Θεσσαλονίκης. Μια νίκη που μας δίνει δύναμη να συνεχίσουμε, γιατί ο αγώνας για την οριστική προστασία της κατοικίας δεν έχει τελειώσει!


Τα δυσβάσταχτα ενοίκια, οι πλειστηριασμοί, οι εξώσεις, οι καταχρηστικές πρακτικές των εκμισθωτών και η τουριστικοποίηση των γειτονιών μας δεν είναι ανεξάρτητα προβλήματα. Είναι διαφορετικές πλευρές της ίδιας στεγαστικής κρίσης, που απειλεί όλο και περισσότερους ανθρώπους με εκτοπισμό από τα σπίτια και τις γειτονιές τους.


Η στεγαστική κρίση δεν έπεσε από τον ουρανό. Είναι αποτέλεσμα συγκεκριμένων πολιτικών που μετατρέπουν την κατοικία από κοινωνικό αγαθό σε επενδυτικό προϊόν. Οι πλειστηριασμοί, η συγκέντρωση ακινήτων σε επενδυτικά χαρτοφυλάκια, η κερδοσκοπία και η τουριστικοποίηση βάζουν τα κέρδη πάνω από τις στεγαστικές ανάγκες των ανθρώπων.

– Προστασία από τις εξώσεις και τις καταχρηστικές πρακτικές!

– Ουσιαστικό περιορισμό της βραχυχρόνιας μίσθωσης και κατάργηση της Golden Visa!


– Τέλος στην κερδοσκοπία και την τουριστικοποίηση των γειτονιών μας!


Την Τετάρτη βγαίνουμε στον δρόμο με μουσική, μαζί με όσους και όσες αγωνίζονται σε ολόκληρη την Ευρώπη!


Καλούμε τους κατοίκους της Θεσσαλονίκης, τα εργατικά σωματεία, τις συλλογικότητες και κάθε άνθρωπο που πλήττεται από τη στεγαστική κρίση να συμμετάσχουν στη συναυλία. Δεν θα ανεχτούμε άλλες αυξήσεις, άλλες εξώσεις και νέα νομοσχέδια σε βάρος μας!

Li Îzmîrê di kargehê de teqîn pêk hat: Hejmara miriyan derket 18an


10 Mijdar 2026


Kilinç piştî teqînê di destpêkê de biribûn Nexweşxaneya Dewletê ya Aliagayê û paşê sewqî Nexweşxaneya Perwerde û Lêkolînê ya Çigliyê ya Zanîngeha Bakirçaya Îzmîrê kiribûn.


Dermankirina şeş karkerên ku di teqînê de birîndar bibûn di nexweşxaneyan de berdewam dike.


Derbarê karkerên ku di teqîna HABAŞê de mirin em çi dizanin?


10 Mijdar 2026


Hejmara qurbaniyên HABAŞê gihîşt 19an


Ajansa Anadolyê (AA) nivîsî ku bi mirina Abdullah Kilinç re hejmara kesên ku di teqînê de jiyana xwe ji dest dane gihîştiye 18an. Lêbelê di lîsteya AAyê de navê Guner Gokçe cih nagire.


Cîgirê Wezîrê Dadê Can Tuncay, duh (10ê Cotmehê) piştî lêkolîna li tesîsê ji rojnamegeran re gotibû: “Li gorî serlêdana malbatan cenazeyê karkerekî me nehatiye dîtin. Lêkolînên li cihê bûyerê berdewam dikin.”


Piştî vê daxuyaniyê, hin ajansên nûçeyan, platformên nûçeyan ên herêmî û Meclisa İSİGê ragihandin ku termê karkerê bi navê Guner Gokçe di bin kavilan de hatiye dîtin. Ji bo Gokçeyê ku li Paşaliya (navê wê ê berê Berdik) ser bi navçeya Şenkayaya Erzurumê ji dayik bûye, di rûpeleke civata herêmî de jî peyama serxweşiyê hat weşandin.


Navên 19 karkerên ku jiyana xwe ji dest dane bi vî rengî ne:


Abdülkadir Kınacı, Abdullah Kılınç, Barış Güney, Ceylan Bıyıklı, Ersin Oğuz, Fatih Işık, Ferhat Maraşlı, Göksel Ünaldı, Güner Gökçe, Hüsnü Ersoy, İlker Sığırtmaçoğlu, Kadir Kaan Özçelik, Mustafa Sert, Orhan Altay, Özcan Efe, Recep Fedai, Serkan Kurt, Uğur Temel, Yasin Taşçı.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Meet David Morales: Providence Voters Elect Democratic Socialist Mayor, Approve Israel Divestment
content:
Voters in Providence, Rhode Island, approved a ballot measure last week that could result in the city divesting from Israel. The successful grassroots campaign makes Providence the first U.S. city to pass a binding divestment measure through a popular vote. The measure instructs the city to divest from countries and companies implicated in “ethnic cleansing, apartheid, illegal military occupation, or genocide.” The language does not mention Israel by name. We speak with one of the key backers of the divestment measure, Mayor-elect David Morales, a 28-year-old democratic socialist who made history on election night as the youngest mayor ever elected in Providence.


“What we saw was our neighbors coming out in the thousands to demonstrate that we are ready for change,” Morales says, promising to enact his affordability-focused platform. “It’s the responsibility of local government to take action. And for that reason, we are seeing a rise in democratic socialism and the representation of democratic socialists all across the country.”

author: CMI Argentina
title: A 4 años de la condena, detienen al policía bonaerense Pablo Moresco
content:
El Tribunal en lo Criminal N° 2 de San Nicolás, a cargo del juez Alejandro Gabriel López, ordenó la detención de Pablo Nicolás Moresco, el policía condenado en 2022 por atropellar con el patrullero y matar a Ulises Rial y Ezequiel Corbalán. A pesar de la decisión unánime de los jueces que lo encontraron culpable y lo sentenciaron a 17 años de prisión por homicidio doloso con dolo eventual, la Sala IV del Tribunal de Casación provincial integrada por Mario Kohan y Carlos Natiello cambió arbitrariamente la calificación por la de homicidio culposo y redujo la pena a 5 años de prisión. Moresco quedó en libertad hasta ahora. En ese juicio la CPM actuó como particular damnificado institucional en su función de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura de la provincia de Buenos Aires.


Desde el Tribunal en lo Criminal N° 2 de San Nicolás libraron una orden de allanamiento y detuvieron al responsable de atropellar con el patrullero a dos jóvenes en junio del 2020. El policía Pablo Nicolás Moresco fue juzgado en 2022 y condenado a 17 años de prisión por el delito de homicidio con dolo eventual y en concurso real. Teniendo en cuenta que en octubre de este año la sentencia quedó firme por cinco años de prisión de cumplimiento efectivo, las partes que fueron particulares damnificados en el juicio -la Comisión por la Memoria en su calidad de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura y el abogado Gabriel Ganon- solicitaron que se efectivice la prisión. El Ministerio Público Fiscal acompañó el pedido de manera tal que el tribunal libró este 4 de noviembre la orden de detención.


Durante la madrugada del 1 de junio de 2020 en el barrio San Jorge de San Nicolás, en el marco del aislamiento social preventivo y obligatorio, Ulises Rial y Ezequiel Corbalán salieron en moto a comprar bebidas y un móvil policial intentó identificarlos. Como no se detuvieron, los policías comenzaron a perseguirlos y dieron el aviso radial para detener la moto. El patrullero conducido por Pablo Nicolás Moresco se sumó al operativo, conducía con la sirena y balizas policiales apagadas por la calle Carbajo en sentido contrario a la moto, y cuando la vio cruzó el patrullero hacia el carril de circulación contraria (a contramano) para forzar su detención. Fue esa maniobra la que derivó en un violento impacto de la moto sobre el lateral del patrullero y que provocó la muerte de Corbalán y Rial.


Como resultado del juicio, la sentencia condenatoria reconoció la total desproporción entre la maniobra policial que provocó la muerte de ambos jóvenes respecto al objetivo de identificarlos en el marco del ASPO. Pero no quedó detenido al terminar el juicio porque el fiscal de juicio no lo solicitó en sus alegatos y los magistrados del TOC 2 de San Nicolás resolvieron que sin pedido del Ministerio Público no podían ordenar su detención.


Luego de que quedara firme el fallo de la Sala IV del Tribunal de Casación provincial que cambió la calificación por homicidio culposo y condenó a 5 años de prisión se dispuso su detención efectiva.


La muerte producida por policías mediante el uso de patrulleros que se utilizan con este fin ha provocado 62 muertes en los últimos 10 años en territorio provincial. Muchos de estos hechos son calificados como homicidios culposos -accidentes de tránsito- y quedan impunes sin juzgarse o sancionarse las responsabilidades policiales.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: $575M commitment a ‘first step’ in Inuit Child First transition, minister says
content:
The $575-million, five-year commitment to the Inuit Child First Initiative in Budget 2026 is the “first step” in a broader transition, says Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull-Masty.


The program, rebranded as Pirutsiagutiit and developed with Inuit Tapiriit Kanatami and the four Inuit treaty organizations, is expected to launch April 1, 2027. Delivery will be transferred from Indigenous Services Canada to the treaty organizations or their designates.


“I’m really proud of the work that was done by ITK and all of the partners in the space for Inuit Child First Initiative,” Gull-Masty said during a news conference at the Inuusirvik Community Wellness Hub in Iqaluit on Saturday.


“We’ve had a lot of feedback. They’ve given us a lot of data. They’ve given us a lot of information. That’s what helped us to be able to bring forth the funding commitment.”


Gull-Masty said further announcements are expected from Northern and Arctic Affairs Minister Rebecca Chartrand and Crown-Indigenous Relations Minister Rebecca Alty.


“This is the first step in what you are going to see. The next step that comes forward is built with the essential input of our partners,” she said. 


ITK said in an email to Nunatsiaq News that it would provide more details in the coming weeks, as well.


Nunavut MP Lori Idlout said the change in program delivery could have significant impacts for Nunavummiut. 


“Inuit leading how the program will be delivered could have creative solutions, like maybe providing more for hunters so that they can provide for their families, for their children, so that children can go to school with having food in their bellies,” Idlout said in an interview with Nunatsiaq News on Saturday.


The federal government launched the Inuit Child First Initiative in September 2018. It provides health, social, educational and other supports to Inuit children and youth.


The program’s funding ran out in 2025 and was extended through one-year commitments while Ottawa and Inuit partners worked on a replacement.


In November 2025, Gull-Masty told Nunatsiaq News the program would be retooled and made permanent but did not provide a timeline for the replacement.


The new funding commitment is $25 million below the $600 million ITK requested in its pre-budget submission.


“The fact that they can find billions of dollars for military spending — in fact, one in five dollars is going towards military spending, much of which is going to happen in Nunavut — but couldn’t even meet by $15 million what was requested, I think is kind of patronizing,” said NDP Indigenous services critic Leah Gazan in an interview with Nunatsiaq News Monday. 


Gazan also criticized changes introduced last February that required funding requests to demonstrate a child’s individual needs and include supporting documentation.


The changes also restricted funding for community-wide programs, including hamlet food voucher programs.


“We will continue to push the government to make sure that this actual transition occurs and it doesn’t fall by the wayside, like we’ve seen in the past,” Gazan said.


—

With files from Daron Letts.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "American Scoundrel": From Roy Cohn to Stephen Miller, "McCarthyism Lives On," Says Author Kai Bird
content:
We speak with historian Kai Bird about

American Scoundrel

, a new biography of the notorious political fixer Roy Cohn, who rose to fame as chief counsel to Joe McCarthy during the senator’s anti-communist campaign, served as a lawyer for the New York mob, and was an influential voice in Republican circles until his death from

AIDS

-related complications in 1986. His most impactful relationship, however, would prove to be with a young Donald Trump, whom he mentored in business and politics during the 1970s and ’80s.


Facing political setbacks during his first term as president, Trump reportedly asked, “Where’s my Roy Cohn?” Bird, who co-authored

American Scoundrel

 with his wife Susan Goldmark, says Trump may have found his Cohn in Stephen Miller, the architect of the administration’s mass deportation policies whom Trump just elevated to chief of staff.


“It’s not really a surprise that, cornered and wounded by the recent election results, he reaches out and pulls up Stephen Miller, who’s very similar in his willingness to go on the offensive and never back down, and to say outrageous things to try to change the narrative,” says Bird.

author: cnt.es
title: CNT valora positivamente el desarrollo de la huelga general del 11N y denuncia la actuación policial contra los piquetes
content:
Imagen

: 13:30h. Manifestación en Bilbao. Bloque propio | Fuente: CNT


La jornada está registrando paros importantes en distintos sectores y una notable movilización en las calles, mientras se repiten las actuaciones policiales contra piquetes en diferentes puntos del Estado.


La Confederación Nacional del Trabajo (CNT) realiza una valoración positiva del desarrollo de la huelga general convocada para este 11 de noviembre. La jornada está dejando importantes paros en distintos sectores productivos, una respuesta desigual según territorios y actividades, y una notable participación en las movilizaciones convocadas durante la mañana.


Los datos conocidos hasta el momento reflejan una incidencia importante en sectores como la automoción, la industria, la logística, los puertos y la recogida de residuos. La demanda eléctrica peninsular también está registrando una caída significativa respecto a jornadas laborables comparables, con diferencias que alcanzaban el 11,8 % respecto al miércoles anterior a primera hora de la mañana.


CNT señala que el seguimiento de una huelga no puede analizarse al margen de las condiciones laborales de cada sector. La precariedad, la temporalidad, el miedo a las represalias empresariales y la imposición de servicios mínimos abusivos dificultan especialmente el ejercicio del derecho de huelga en determinados ámbitos. Por ello, la diversidad de resultados no resta valor a una jornada que está demostrando capacidad de organización y respuesta colectiva.


La movilización también está teniendo una importante expresión en las calles. Las manifestaciones y concentraciones celebradas durante la mañana están registrando una asistencia elevada en distintos puntos del Estado, pese a las fuertes lluvias que están afectando a numerosas localidades y a tratarse de convocatorias en horario matinal. CNT espera que las movilizaciones previstas para esta tarde tengan igualmente una participación masiva.


CNT denuncia la extensión de las actuaciones policiales contra los piquetes


Junto al desarrollo de la huelga, CNT denuncia las actuaciones policiales registradas en distintos puntos del Estado contra piquetes y personas participantes en las movilizaciones. Cargas, golpes, utilización de gas pimienta, identificaciones y detenciones forman parte de los incidentes denunciados por las organizaciones sindicales durante la jornada.


La Confederación considera especialmente preocupante la extensión de este tipo de intervenciones. No se trata de prácticas desconocidas para los movimientos sociales y sindicales: actuaciones similares vienen produciéndose durante las movilizaciones por el derecho a la vivienda y otras protestas sociales. Por tanto, lo ocurrido durante esta huelga se enmarca en una dinámica represiva que las organizaciones sociales llevan tiempo denunciando.


CNT recuerda que el derecho de huelga está reconocido en el artículo 28.2 de la Constitución Española y que el ejercicio de este derecho incluye la actividad de los piquetes informativos. Las actuaciones policiales no pueden convertirse en un instrumento para obstaculizar la organización sindical ni para intimidar a quienes ejercen legítimamente sus derechos.


La organización exige que se investiguen los hechos denunciados, se depuren las responsabilidades correspondientes y se respete plenamente el ejercicio de los derechos sindicales y de manifestación.


La movilización continúa


Este balance es necesariamente provisional. Durante las próximas horas se conocerán nuevos datos sobre el seguimiento en sectores que todavía no han podido ofrecer cifras completas, así como sobre las movilizaciones previstas para la tarde.


CNT valora positivamente la respuesta que está teniendo esta huelga general y considera que la jornada debe servir para reforzar la organización y la capacidad de acción colectiva en los centros de trabajo y en los barrios. Asimismo, recuerda que la jornada del 11N es un paso más en la defensa de los derechos laborales y sociales. El trabajo de organización y movilización continúa.

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

author: Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Το Νήμα | Άγνωστοι Θάνατοι: Πόσοι πεθαίνουν στα χέρια της ΕΛ.ΑΣ.;
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Το Νήμα | Άγνωστοι Θάνατοι: Πόσοι πεθαίνουν στα χέρια της ΕΛ.ΑΣ.;


Όπως φαίνεται από τα

νέα στοιχεία

 που δημοσιεύτηκαν στο πλαίσιο του ερευνητικού εγχειρήματος

Detention Landscapes

, ούτε η ίδια η αστυνομία δεν γνωρίζει ή, μάλλον, δεν καταγράφει.


Με καλεσμένους την Ανδριανή Φίλη και τον Στέργιο Μαγκριώτη, ερευνητές που συμμετέχουν στο εγχείρημα

Detention Landscapes

, πιάνουμε το νήμα των θανάτων σε καθεστώς κράτησης στην Ελλάδα.


Παρακολουθήστε την εκπομπή Το Νήμα στο

:


YouTube


PeerTube


Spotify


Το Νήμα: Δείτε όλες τις εκπομπές


Η έρευνα συγκεντρώνει για πρώτη φορά σε ένα ενιαίο

δημόσια προσβάσιμο αρχείο

 στοιχεία για θανάτους σε αστυνομικά τμήματα, προαναχωρησιακά κέντρα κράτησης, κατά τη μεταγωγή κρατουμένων και σε νοσοκομεία όπου οι θανόντες εξακολουθούσαν να βρίσκονται υπό αστυνομική κράτηση.


Διαβάστε εδώ τη δημοσίευση των ερευνητών:

Building an archive of deaths in Greek immigration detention centres


Από τους 112 καταγεγραμμένους θανάτους, 81 σημειώθηκαν σε αστυνομικά τμήματα και 27 σε προαναχωρησιακά κέντρα κράτησης. Οι 82 νεκροί ήταν άνδρες, τέσσερις γυναίκες, ενώ σε 26 περιπτώσεις δεν καταγράφεται φύλο. Από τα 70 άτομα των οποίων είναι γνωστή η ηλικία, τα 45 ήταν κάτω των 40 ετών, με διάμεση ηλικία τα 33,5 χρόνια.


Σοβαρά κενά και αντιφάσεις στα στοιχεία της ΕΛ.ΑΣ.


Οι ερευνητές συγκέντρωσαν στοιχεία μέσω αιτημάτων πρόσβασης σε δημόσια πληροφορία προς την ΕΛ.ΑΣ., τα οποία αφορούσαν μεταξύ άλλων τις

αυτοκτονίες σε αστυνομικά τμήματα από το 2000 έως το 2024

, τους

θανάτους αλλοδαπών σε αστυνομικά τμήματα

 και τους

θανάτους σε προαναχωρησιακά κέντρα

.


Από τη διασταύρωση προέκυψε ότι 34 θάνατοι που είχαν καταγραφεί από δημοσιογράφους, οργανώσεις και φορείς παρακολούθησης

απουσίαζαν από τις στατιστικές που χορήγησε η αστυνομία

. Για άλλους 25 θανάτους, τα αστυνομικά στοιχεία περιλάμβαναν ουσιαστικά μόνο το έτος και τη γεωγραφική περιοχή.


Εντοπίστηκαν επίσης αντιφάσεις ανάμεσα σε διαφορετικές επίσημες καταγραφές. Για παράδειγμα, ενώ στα στοιχεία αυτοκτονιών αναφέρεται θάνατος αλλοδαπού στην Αθήνα το 2002, στα συγκεντρωτικά στοιχεία θανάτων αλλοδαπών υπό αστυνομική κράτηση δεν εμφανίζεται κανένας θάνατος την ίδια χρονιά.


Η ΕΛ.ΑΣ. αρνήθηκε να χορηγήσει συμπληρωματικές πληροφορίες, επικαλούμενη αρχικά

το απόρρητο ερευνών

.


Μια χαρακτηριστική απάντηση της ΕΛ.ΑΣ. σε αίτημα πρόσβασης σε δημόσια δεδομένα.


Μετά από παρέμβαση του Συνηγόρου του Πολίτη, η Ελληνική Αστυνομία επικαλέστηκε το ότι οι πληροφορίες δεν τηρούνται σε ψηφιακές βάσεις και τον

υπερβολικό διοικητικό φόρτο

.


Οι ερευνητές εκτιμούν ότι

ο πραγματικός αριθμός θανάτων πιθανότατα είναι μεγαλύτερος

, καθώς η

ανεξάρτητη παρακολούθηση

 των εγκαταστάσεων είναι περιορισμένη και η

πρόσβαση δικηγόρων, συγγενών και οργανώσεων

 συναντά σημαντικά εμπόδια. Επιπλέον, η κατάσχεση τηλεφώνων, οι περιορισμοί στην επικοινωνία και καταγγελλόμενες πρακτικές εκφοβισμού δυσχεραίνουν τη δημοσιοποίηση περιστατικών κακομεταχείρισης.


Ελλείψεις στην υγειονομική περίθαλψη


Ιδιαίτερη έμφαση δίνεται στην πρόσβαση των κρατουμένων σε ιατρική φροντίδα. Στα αστυνομικά τμήματα δεν υπάρχει ιατρικό προσωπικό, ενώ στα προαναχωρησιακά κέντρα η υγειονομική περίθαλψη παρέχεται από την

ΑΕΜΥ

, με ευρωπαϊκή χρηματοδότηση.


Ωστόσο, σύμφωνα με μαρτυρίες κρατουμένων, αιτήματα ιατρικής βοήθειας συχνά αγνοούνται ή καθυστερούν, ενώ αστυνομικοί παρεμβάλλονται ανάμεσα στους ασθενείς και τους υγειονομικούς.


Στην Αμυγδαλέζα, σύμφωνα με τα

τελευταία διαθέσιμα στοιχεία του Απριλίου 2026

, υπηρετούσαν μόλις επτά επαγγελματίες υγείας για 666 κρατουμένους: δύο γιατροί, δύο νοσηλευτές, δύο επισκέπτες υγείας και ένας οδοντίατρος.


Παράλληλα, το ευρωπαϊκά χρηματοδοτούμενο

πρόγραμμα AMIF 018

 καλύπτει τις αποδοχές 97 συνοριοφυλάκων, στους οποίους ανατίθενται και αρμοδιότητες σχετικές με τη διασφάλιση ιατρικών εξετάσεων και μεταφορών σε νοσοκομεία.


Συνεντεύξεις με εργαζομένους της ΑΕΜΥ αναδεικνύουν ανεπαρκή εποπτεία, μεγάλη εναλλαγή προσωπικού, ελλείψεις εξοπλισμού και παρεμπόδιση της πρόσβασης σε γιατρούς από αστυνομικούς. Οι ερευνητές επισημαίνουν ότι η ύπαρξη υγειονομικού προσωπικού δεν εγγυάται ουσιαστική πρόσβαση σε περίθαλψη.


Το νέο νομοθετικό πλαίσιο


Η δημοσίευση της έρευνας πραγματοποιείται έναν χρόνο μετά την ψήφιση του

Ν. 5226/2025

, ο οποίος αυστηροποίησε το πλαίσιο αντιμετώπισης της παράτυπης εισόδου και παραμονής στη χώρα.


Σύμφωνα με την ανάλυση των ερευνητών, το νέο πλαίσιο επιτρέπει

διοικητική κράτηση …

Eine Firma mit Verbindungen zum Schwiegersohn des US-Präsidenten will Hotelkomplexe in albanischen Schutzgebieten bauen. Der Regierungschef bestreitet eine Einigung. Bagger roden dennoch bereits Kiefernwald im Projektgebiet. Am Montag sind Tausende in Tirana, der Hauptstadt Albaniens, auf die Straße gegangen. Albanien: Studentenbewegung stellt Zweiparteiensystem in Frage. Regierungschef Rama setzt auf Repression, Oppositionsführer Berisha auf Vereinnahmung


„»

Rama ins Gefängnis, Berisha ins Gefängnis« – Mit diesem Banner empfingen albanische Studierende am Sonnabend vor dem Bildungsministerium in Tirana die Opposition. Anhänger der Demokratischen Partei (PD) von Sali Berisha waren von der Parteizentrale aus losmarschiert; die Studierenden hielten sie mit einer Menschenkette auf, es kam zu Handgreiflichkeiten. Vor dem Ministerium und auch am Regierungssitz verlagerte sich die Auseinandersetzung später in Richtung der Polizei: Steine, Böller und Molotowcocktails auf der einen Seite, Pfefferspray, Tränengas und Wasserwerfer auf der anderen.


Seit dem 13. Oktober fordert die Studentenbewegung den Rücktritt von Ministerpräsident Edi Rama. Doch der Sonnabend zeigte, dass sich die Demonstrationen nicht allein gegen die Regierungspartei richten. Dass auch die PD als Oppositionskraft adressiert wird, ist nicht neu. Bereits am 31. Oktober hatten die Studierenden PD-Abgeordnete mit dem Ruf »Die Opposition sind wir« aus ihren Reihen verwiesen. Am 2. November verbrannten die Demonstranten Puppen von Rama und Berisha auf einem Steintisch mit der Aufschrift »Dialog«, den der Premier vor seinem Amtssitz aufgestellt hatte. Rama und Berisha würden das Land seit 36 Jahren in Geiselhaft halten, so ein Aktivist gegenüber dem Portal balkanweb. (…)


Die Bewegung scheint nicht zu erlahmen: Laut der unabhängigen Demotrackingseite Pulsi gehörten die Demonstrationen an den Sonnabenden Ende Oktober zu den teilnehmerstärksten seit Anfang Juli. An diesem Mittwoch soll der nächste Protest stattfinden. Für den 28. November, den Unabhängigkeitstag, haben Aktivisten eine Massenkundgebung zusammen mit der »Flamingo-Bewegung« angekündigt. Offen bleibt die Frage, ob die Proteste – wie die serbische Studentenbewegung, die am 25. Oktober in Belgrad die Wahlen gewann – ohne Anbindung an eine Partei zu einer ernsthaften politischen Alternative werden können

.“

Artikel von Fabio Nacci in der jungen Welt vom 11.11.2026

title: El reclamo de Mirtha Baravalle vuelve a poner en cuestión a la Justicia: convocan a Comodoro Py por los bebés apropiados en la dictadura
content:
«O lloro o lucho», sentenció Mirtha Baravalle en un acto del 24 de marzo. | Foto: Osiris Martí.


«Que digan dónde están lxs nietxs». Con esa consigna, este jueves 12 de noviembre, a las 11, familiares y organizaciones de derechos humanos convocan a concentrarse frente a la Cámara Federal de Casación Penal, en Comodoro Py, donde se realizará una audiencia por el hábeas corpus que reclama conocer el destino de Ana María Baravalle, Julio César Galizzi, sus hijos o hijas nacidos en cautiverio y María del Carmen Gualdero, también desaparecida cuando cursaba un embarazo a término. La presentación incluye además un pedido de alcance general para que el Estado busque e identifique a todas las personas que pudieron haber sido apropiadas durante el terrorismo de Estado. La convocatoria recupera la lucha de Mirta Acuña de Baravalle, cofundadora de Madres y Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo, quien buscó durante casi cinco décadas a su hija, su yerno y a su nieto o nieta, a quien imaginaba como Camila o Ernesto. Mirta murió en noviembre de 2024 sin haber podido abrazar a ese nieto o nieta. Ahora, sus familiares continúan el reclamo judicial y exigen análisis genéticos masivos, apertura de archivos y el cese del ocultamiento de las identidades.

Por ANRed.

El reclamo llegó a Casación luego de que la Sala IV de la Cámara Federal de Casación Penal habilitara el recurso presentado por Ricardo Baravalle y Estela Gualdero contra el rechazo del hábeas corpus. Los jueces consideraron que la denegación del recurso anterior había sido errónea y dispusieron que se revisen los planteos. La resolución no implica todavía que el tribunal haya concedido el hábeas corpus ni ordenado las medidas solicitadas: abre una instancia para discutir la decisión que había rechazado inicialmente la acción judicial. El planteo fue presentado en los términos de la Ley 23.098, que contempla el hábeas corpus ante situaciones de desaparición forzada.

Mirta Acuña de Baravalle

Falleció en noviembre de 2024, a los 99 años, sin haber podido encontrarles

.

permaneció detenida en la Comisaría 11 y en la Sección de Seguridad General de la Policía Federal

.

author: Simon Childs
title: Broadcasters Ignored Warning About David Walliams, TV Agent Says
content:
Broadcasters failed to take action on “inappropriate behaviour” by David Walliams years before allegations against him came to light, it has been claimed.


Walliams is facing a police investigation after it was alleged he kissed and groped a 15-year-old in his north London flat when he was 36.


On Tuesday, the comedian and children’s author was accused in a joint investigation by the Guardian and ITV News of using his celebrity to prey on girls. The report was published after a failed attempt by Walliams to block it with an injunction.


Dermot McNamara, a TV agent, told Newsnight that his friend, whose name was not given, was 16 when Walliams invited her to a Britain’s Got Talent screening, after which he invited her and another girl back to his home “where inappropriate behaviour happened”.


The incident had a “profound effect on her mental health and her wellbeing,” he said.


It had been a “struggle” for her to “see him in the media, still getting jobs, still being able to conduct himself in public life.”


McNamara said: “I reported it to authorities and broadcasters.”


Asked if any action was taken, he said, “Not that I’m aware of, no… He was still on TV for many, many years. He was still allowed to, by the sounds of it, be involved with other young women – no.”


Walliams denies any wrongdoing.


The allegations have raised other questions about what was known about Walliams’ behaviour at the time.


TV personality Jonathan Ross released a statement saying he is “as horrified by the revelations about David Walliams and the crimes of Russell Brand as the rest of the nation”, after footage circulated of him making a joke at the 2004 Comedy Awards about Walliams going home with a 15-year-old.


Ross said the joke was “submitted to me by the Comedy Awards scriptwriting team, and I believed that the punchline was a reference to the fact he had publicly dated younger women, exaggerated for comic effect.


“Had I had any reason to suspect that it might be referring to actual events, I would not only have refused to use it, but I would not have felt comfortable continuing a personal or professional relationship with him. I also like to think that I would have acted upon that knowledge.”

title: Çiğdem Doğu: AKP's delaying tactics pose serious risks
content:
Kurdistan Women's Communities (KJK) Executive Council member Çiğdem Doğu appeared on a special program broadcast by Medya Haber television, where she discussed the Peace and Democratic Society Process initiated by Leader Apo (Abdullah Öcalan) and violence against women.


Çiğdem Doğu emphasized that the Peace and Democratic Society Process cannot be reduced to disarmament alone, arguing that a democratic solution to the Kurdish question and the democratization of Turkey must be addressed together. She stressed the importance of recognizing Leader Apo's role as coordinator of peace and political participation, saying that transparency, mutual dialogue and concrete steps are essential for building social support for peace.


Çiğdem Doğu also called on women to take action ahead of November 25, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. She emphasized that violence against women cannot be explained as a series of isolated incidents but is produced by the male-dominated system. She stressed that women must go beyond resisting violence by building free lives, organizing themselves and developing self-defense mechanisms. Çiğdem Doğu said that women must establish control over their lives in economic, social, cultural and physical spheres, calling for November to be dedicated to the struggle for women's freedom under the slogan, "Now is the time for women, now is the time for women's self-defense."


Çiğdem Doğu also discussed the youth movements emerging in different countries, describing them as expressions of significant social opposition to the existing political system. Citing the student movement in Serbia, she said that young people no longer accept the capitalist way of life or the existing order and have the potential to bring about profound change by joining forces with society.


Abdullah Öcalan took a step by initiating the Peace and Democratic Society Process and assumed full responsibility. However, the Turkish state has yet to take any concrete steps in response. There has been discussion in certain circles, but nothing tangible has emerged. Let me also mention that reports suggest Öcalan has been moved to a new location. Yet the Turkish state has made no official announcement concerning Öcalan's coordinating role. Could you provide some information about this?


Before answering, I would like to mention that we have entered November, and the anniversary of November 27 is approaching. On this occasion, I congratulate President Apo on the anniversary of November 27 and extend my congratulations to our people. Throughout our history of struggle, we have lost thousands of martyrs and martyred comrades. Each of these martyrs played an enormously significant role in affirming the existence of the Kurdish people and opening the path toward freedom and a free life. They opened this path for us and showed us the way. On the occasion of November 27, I commemorate all our martyrs with love, respect and gratitude.


November 25 is also approaching. From the Mirabal sisters to Rosa Luxemburg, our comrades Sakine Cansız (Sara) and Evîn Goyî, and all the women comrades who were martyred throughout the years of war, these deaths and massacres resulted from attacks produced by the male-dominated system. There are also women murdered in social life as a result of this murderous, hierarchical system and the violent masculinity it produces. Hundreds of thousands, even millions of women have been killed. The struggle against this violence and the creation of a life in which women can live freely constitute a fundamental responsibility and obligation for our women's struggle. I therefore commemorate all women who have been murdered.


Turning to your question, there is certainly a process underway, and it is being widely discussed. Some say that everything is progressing smoothly. We also assess the situation. In reality, the process is largely standing still. It is not progressing as smoothly as some claim. There are difficulties and steps that have not been taken. We can therefore speak of an existing process, but how effectively and healthily it is advancing remains highly questionable. From our movement's perspective, it is a process that is not functioning or moving forward. It has not collapsed, but neither is it actively progressing.


Are they deliberately dragging out the process?


Yes, the process is being prolonged. But this delay poses a very serious danger. You asked about reports that …

title: ISIG: At Least 193 workers killed in workplace incidents in October
content:
The report published by the Workers’ Health and Safety Observatory (ISIG) said that at least 193 workers died in workplace fatalities during October and provided data on the causes of these deaths.


According to the report, 22 percent of workplace fatalities were caused by crushing and building collapses, 18 percent by traffic accidents, and 16 percent by falls from height.


The report states that 15 of the workers who lost their lives in October were women and 178 were men. It also records the deaths of nine child workers and 25 refugee and migrant workers in workplace fatalities.


In its September Workplace Fatality Report, ISIG stated that at least 226 workers had lost their lives in workplace fatalities across Turkey. The same figure of at least 226 worker deaths was also reported in its August report.


Meanwhile, ISIG's Child Workplace Fatality Report, covering the period from September 2025 to August 2026, recorded the deaths of 95 children in workplace fatalities.

author: Unknown
title: Spring named after Martyr Zinar
content:
A spring flowing down the slopes of the Pirîz region in the mountains of Kurdistan not only brings life to its surroundings but also preserves the memory of the friendship between local villagers and guerrilla Zinar. Used by local residents as a source of drinking water and by travellers as a place to rest, the spring became known as “Kanîya Şehîd Zinar” (Martyr Zinar’s Spring) following Zinar’s death as a martyr. He had devoted considerable effort to protecting and maintaining it.


With their natural caves, steep cliffs and cold-water springs, every corner of the mountains of Kurdistan holds its own story. Among the hidden natural wonders high in the mountains, springs play an important role in sustaining the lives of both people and other living creatures.


 


Various species of plants grow around Martyr Zinar’s Spring. As the water nourishes the surrounding vegetation, greenery spreads throughout the valley, turning the area into a resting place for travellers as well. Those crossing the mountain roads stop by the spring to catch their breath and cool off with a bowl of cold water.


Despite the harsh natural conditions and airstrikes in the area, the spring continues to flow, also meeting the water needs of nearby villagers. The cleaning and maintenance of this water source, which holds an important place in local life, is carried out through the collective efforts of those who use it. Villagers clean the spring and maintain its surroundings at regular intervals.


A friendship forged by the spring


One of those who devoted their efforts to protecting the spring was the young guerrilla fighter Zinar. Whenever villagers came to clean the spring, Zinar would help them and take part in building its stone walls. His care for the water source and participation in collective work helped forge a strong friendship between him and the local community.


Believing that a life of freedom could only be achieved through collective labour and struggle, Zinar saw taking part in the maintenance of the spring as an expression of this way of life. Working alongside the villagers, he contributed to protecting a water source that everyone could benefit from.


Villagers gave the spring Zinar's name


After Zinar fell as a martyr, the villagers named the spring after him so that his labour and sacrifice would not be forgotten. In this way, the water source they had worked together to maintain became a place where Zinar’s memory would live on.


Today, villagers continue to collect water from the spring, while travellers still stop there to rest. Nourishing the surrounding plants and bringing life to the valley, the spring also preserves the memory of the shared labour and friendship between Zinar and the villagers.

author: Unknown
title: Climate change can be prevented through the struggle against capitalism
content:
The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) is being held in Turkey to discuss ecological destruction and climate change. Environmental movements are organizing an alternative gathering and protest demonstrations in response.


Turkey currently ranks among the countries causing the greatest destruction of nature worldwide. Almost no city or district has been spared from environmental destruction. Nature is being deliberately devastated, particularly in Kurdistan. The Turkish state has built dozens of dams to separate guerrilla areas from one another and destroyed forests in areas where guerrillas operate. It has eliminated the living spaces of villages under the pretext of mineral exploration. The areas where dams have been constructed are among humanity's earliest settlements. This has also been another dimension of the cultural genocide carried out against the Kurdish people.


Policies of ecological destruction are also being implemented throughout Turkey. Streams that provide essential water supplies to villages in the Black Sea region have been destroyed. Forests have been devastated, and water sources poisoned in many places, particularly in the Kaz Mountains. The Justice and Development Party (AKP) government has launched unprecedented attacks on nature to enrich companies close to it. The AKP, which describes itself as Islamist, has turned hostility toward nature into a political policy to generate profits for its supporters. Money has become the AKP's only religion. Those benefiting most from profiteering in Turkey today are AKP members. The AKP can boast of making its supporters wealthy. Almost all those involved in investment fund fraud are AKP supporters, while many of the victims are also AKP members. Such a government thinks of nothing other than money and profit. AKP members have become people who swallow everything whole. In short, the AKP, which claimed to have come to power to fight corruption, has established an entirely corrupt system.


Marx said that capitalists would cut down a tree if they could not sell its shade. This is precisely the mentality of the AKP government. There is virtually nothing left in Turkey that the AKP has not sold. Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek's greatest talent is his constant search for new sources of revenue. With such a mentality, even the air will eventually be sold.


Now this government, which is so hostile to nature, is organizing COP31. It has even enlisted Tarkan in an attempt to deceive the world. The AKP has become skilled at deceiving both its own people and the international community. The reality of the AKP is that it blames others for the wrongs it commits. Erdoğan, in particular, has become an expert at this. He can tell all kinds of lies without the slightest embarrassment. Through COP31, he will explain how much Turkey supposedly cares about nature. He will probably point to the few public gardens he has had built as evidence of his environmental credentials. Perhaps he will even boast about how environmentally conscious his wife is.


The AKP government's assault on nature is a clear example of an authoritarian state's practices. It acts as though it can say, "I am the state, and I can turn nature upside down wherever I want." Yet nature is humanity's living environment. Settlements were established in particular places because those areas were suitable for human life. Settlements that have existed for thousands of years are being forcibly destroyed by an authoritarian state. No power has the right to make decisions concerning nature without the consent of the people. Yet this authoritarian state destroys people's living environments without their consent. From this perspective, holding COP31 in Turkey is deeply ironic.


Capitalist modernist forces around the world are hostile to nature. Industrialism, which is inherently destructive to nature, is being legitimized. Capitalist modernist forces attack nature from the air, land and sea, only to shed crocodile tears afterward. They conceal their true nature by organizing conferences on eliminating the factors that damage the climate. Capitalist powers destroy nature while competing with one another, then hold meetings to discuss how to prevent air pollution. This is the extent of the hypocrisy and dishonesty of capitalists.


Once everything becomes permissible in the pursuit of wealth and profit, nature is polluted and the climate is altered to a degree that threatens humanity's future …

title: Συγκέντρωση για το δικαίωμα στη στέγαση, την Τετάρτη 11/11, 18.00, στην πλατεία Κλαυθμώνος
content:
Την Τετάρτη 11/11, στις 18.00, στην πλατεία Κλαυθμώνος, οργανώσεις και τοπικές πρωτοβουλίες καλούν σε συγκέντρωση για το δικαίωμα στη στέγαση, διαδηλώνοντας ενάντια στις εξώσεις, τις πολιτικές των funds και τις αυξήσεις των ενοικίων. Την ίδια μέρα πραγματοποιείται γενική απεργία στην Ισπανία με βασικό αίτημα το δικαίωμα στη στέγη ενώ παρόμοιοι αγώνες αρχίζουν να πραγματοποιούνται και σε άλλες χώρες στην Ευρώπη δομώντας ένα πανευρωπαικό αγώνα για την στέγαση.


Αφίσες/Καλέσματα:


Γειτονιές για το Δικαίωμα στη Στέγη


ΑΠΟ ΤΗΝ ΙΒΗΡΙΚΗ ΧΕΡΣΟΝΗΣΟ ΜΕΧΡΙ ΤΗΝ ΕΛΛΑΔΑ, ΒΓΑΙΝΟΥΜΕ ΣΤΟΥΣ ΔΡΟΜΟΥΣ!


Τα ενοίκια ανεβαίνουν, οι εξώσεις και οι πλειστηριασμοί απειλούν όλο και περισσότερους ανθρώπους, οι γειτονιές μας αλλάζουν και η κατοικία μετατρέπεται ολοένα και περισσότερο από δικαίωμα και βασικό αγαθό σε εμπόρευμα και πεδίο κερδοσκοπίας.


Το τελευταίο διάστημα, η επίθεση στο δικαίωμα στην κατοικία κλιμακώνεται. Κάθε λίγο γινόμαστε μάρτυρες μιας νέας περίπτωσης όπου οι περίφημοι «επενδυτές» προσπαθούν να υφαρπάξουν σπίτια και να τα μετατρέψουν σε επενδυτικές αποδόσεις. Στις γειτονιές, στα χωριά και στις πόλεις μας, το αυτονόητο δικαίωμα στη στέγη και την αξιοπρεπή ζωή βρίσκεται υπό συνεχή πίεση, στο όνομα του υπερκέρδους και της μετατροπής ολόκληρων περιοχών σε θεματικά πάρκα για τουρίστες.


Όμως, τίποτα από όλα αυτά δεν συμβαίνει σε κενό. Αποτελούν μέρος ενός συνολικότερου αναπτυξιακού μοντέλου που προωθεί η ίδια η κυβέρνηση, ξεπουλώντας τη γη και την κατοικία και επιχειρώντας να μετατρέψει τη χώρα σε ένα Ελ Ντοράντο του επενδυτικού real estate. Τελευταία πράξη αυτής της προσπάθειας είναι το νομοσχέδιο «Ενίσχυση εποπτείας των υπό διαχείριση απαιτήσεων από δάνεια και πιστώσεις», όπου, παρά τον τίτλο του, στην ουσία δίνεται η δυνατότητα στα funds και στους servicers να λειτουργούν πλήρως ανεξέλεγκτα.


Απέναντι σε αυτή την επίθεση, όμως, οι τοπικές κοινωνίες και οι κοινότητες μας δεν μένουν με σταυρωμένα τα χέρια. Οργανώνονται, βρίσκει η μία την άλλη και δίνουν δεκάδες μικρές και μεγάλες μάχες. Αυτές οι διεκδικήσεις δείχνουν ότι η Ελλάδα έχει μπει για τα καλά στη μάχη για την κατοικία και ότι μόνο η συλλογική διεκδίκηση μπορεί να νικήσει.


Όμως δεν είμαστε μόνες/οι.


Στην Ισπανία ο κόσμος ξεσηκώθηκε για να υπερασπιστεί το σπίτι της Μαρικάρμεν και, μέσα από αυτή τη μάχη, να υπερασπιστεί τα σπίτια όλων. Στην Πορτογαλία, αντίστοιχα, όλο και περισσότεροι άνθρωποι οργανώνονται και παλεύουν για το δικαίωμα στην κατοικία.


Στις 11 Νοεμβρίου, ημέρα πανευρωπαϊκής διεκδίκησης του δικαιώματος στην κατοικία, δίνουμε ραντεβού στις 18:00 στην πλατεία Κλαυθμώνος. Ενώνουμε τις φωνές μας με όσους και όσες αγωνίζονται σε όλη την Ευρώπη για το δικαίωμα να ζούμε στις πόλεις και τις γειτονιές μας.


Διεκδικούμε:


• Πλαφόν στα ενοίκια


• Απαγόρευση πλειστηριασμών πρώτης κατοικίας & πώλησης κόκκινων δανείων με προσημείωση της πρώτης κατοικίας


• Κατάργηση της Golden Visa


• Φρένο στο Airbnb


• Δημόσια και αξιοπρεπή κοινωνική κατοικία


• Στήριξη εγχειρημάτων συλλογικής και συνεταιριστικής, μη κερδοσκοπικής κατοικίας


• Δημιουργία επαρκούς φοιτητικής στέγης


• Φρένο στις εξώσεις


• Καμία εκκένωση καταλήψεων στέγης


• Κανένας άνθρωπος στον δρόμο


Μας πετάνε στον δρόμο. Βγαίνουμε στους δρόμους!


Κατάληψη Στέγης Προσφύγων/Μεταναστών Νοταρά 26


Στηρίζουμε τα καλέσματα για το δικαίωμα στη στέγαση ενάντια στα ψηλά ενοικία, στο gentrification, στα airbnb, στα funds κοράκια, στις εξώσεις, κλπ.


Στηρίζουμε την γενική απεργία για το στεγαστικό στην Ισπανία που προκυρήχθηκε την ίδια μέρα.


Νίκη στον αγώνα των κατοίκων ενάντια στους εκμισθωτές, τους επενδυτές και τους επιχειρηματίες του real estate!


Συγκέντρωση-πορεία αυτή την Τετάρτη 11/11 στην Πλατεία Κλαυθμώνος, στις 18.00!


Κοινότητα Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών


ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑ ΤΗΣ ΚΟΙΝΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΤΕΙΛΗΜΜΕΝΩΝ ΠΡΟΣΦΥΓΙΚΩΝ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΙΝΗΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΤΗ ΣΤΕΓΑΣΗ ΣΤΙΣ 11 ΝΟΕΜΒΡΗ

Τους τελευταίους μήνες, σε πολλές χώρες της Ευρώπης και ιδιαίτερα στον ευρωπαϊκό Νότο, αναπτύσσονται σημαντικοί αγώνες με επίκεντρο το ζήτημα της στέγης. Στην Ισπανία, την Καταλονία και την Ιταλία, χιλιάδες άνθρωποι βγαίνουν στους δρόμους δυναμικά, αντιστέκονται στις εξώσεις και διεκδικούν το δικαίωμα της κοινωνικής βάσης στη στέγη.

Για εμάς, ως Κοινότητα Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών, που συγκροτεί μια μορφή κοινωνικής στέγης με ριζοσπαστικούς όρους, η διεκδίκηση της στέγης -στην περίπτωσή μας μέσω της κατάληψης- δεν αφορά απλώς την εξασφάλιση ενός χώρου κατοικίας. title: La huelga general del 11N transcurre con normalidad generalizada, con incidencias en varios puntos del Estado
content:
Imagen

: 07:30h. Piquete informativo en el Poligono do Tambre (Compostela) | Fuente: CNT


CNT denuncia que, en algunas localidades, los cuerpos policiales están impidiendo a los comités de huelga ejercer su labor de comprobación del cumplimiento de los servicios mínimos, obstaculizando así el legítimo ejercicio de las funciones que corresponden a la representación de las personas trabajadoras durante la huelga.


La huelga general convocada este 11 de noviembre está teniendo un seguimiento e incidencia desigual en los distintos territorios, con una situación de relativa normalidad generalizada, aunque con actuaciones destacadas de los piquetes informativos y algunos incidentes policiales.


Todo esto, después del establecimiento de servicios mínimos abusivos, como ha ocurrido en Madrid, donde el Tribunal Supremo ha anulado los servicios mínimos establecidos por la Comunidad para esta huelga.


En varios puntos, sobre todo en Valencia y Cataluña, se han producido cortes de tráfico en los accesos a la ciudad o a los polígonos industriales, en una acciones conjuntas de los comités de huelga de barrio, sindicatos de vivienda y CNT.


La situación más tensa se ha vivido en Zamora, donde durante el primer piquete en el servicio de autobuses se han producido agresiones policiales, con un compañero detenido y varias personas identificadas. En Madrid, también se ha producido una detención durante las actuaciones de los piquetes.


CNT continuará informando del desarrollo de la jornada y de las incidencias que se produzcan en los distintos territorios.

author: TGEU
title: A Monitorização de Assassinato Trans de 2026 mostra que a cada 32 horas, uma pessoa trans foi morta.
content:
A Monitorização de Assassinato Trans [Trans Murder Monitoring] (TMM) da TGEU registou 273 pessoas trans e de género diverso assassinadas mundialmente ao longo do ano passado, em média, um homicídio registado a cada 32 horas. Assassinatos foram registados em 35 países, o segundo número mais elevado desde que a monitorização começou, e pela primeira vez na Roménia e no Camarões. No total, a TMM registou até à data mais de 5,500 assassinatos globalmente desde que a recolha de dados começou em 2009.


A TGEU – Trans Europe and Central Asia publica a actualização anual do seu projecto global Monitorização de Assassinato Trans no âmbito da Semana de Consciencialização Trans, que termina com o Dia da Memória Trans (TDoR) a 20 de Novembro.


O projecto da TMM conta apenas com números registados, e o trabalho de monitorização está a tornar-se mais difícil. O número total de assassinatos registados é inferior a 300 apenas pela segunda vez numa década, mas a violência não terminou. O espaço cívico em declínio, a hostilidade contra pessoas trans incentivada pela media e pelo estado, e cortes a financiamento tornam menos provável que um assassinato seja relatado e registado.


Principais Conclusões


273 pessoas trans e de género diverso foram registadas como assassinadas

 entre 1 de Outubro de 2025 e 30 de Setembro de 2026 – um assassinato a cada 32 horas.


35 países diferentes

 registaram um assassinato –

o segundo maior número de sempre

. Apenas em 2024 os números de países com dados foram mais altos (38).


Uma em três vítimas eram trabalhadoris do sexo (32%), que continuam a ser o grupo mais atingido

 de todas as ocupações.


Ecoando os padrões de anos anteriores,

quase todos os assassinatos registados (95%) foram feminicídios

 (vítimas foram mulheres trans ou pessoas transfemininas), e

três quartos (75%) das vítimas eram pessoas Negras ou Marrom trans

.


O perfil etário das vítimas de assassinato parece estar a mudar para uma

idade ligeiramente  mais avançada

. Mais de um terço (35%) tinham idades compreendidas entre os

31-40

 anos em 2026, enquanto uma em cinco (21%) das vítimas tinham idades entre os

19-25

 – o que era, consistentemente o maior grupo etário na primeira década da TMM. Uma em vinte (5%) das vítimas do ano anterior foram

menores de 18 anos de idade

.


Sete em cada dez (69%) dos assassinatos ocorreram na América Latina e nas Caraíbas

. O Brasil lidera na lista mais uma vez, representando um em três (32%) do total mundial. Números continuam a cair no

México

, com o número mais baixo de assassinatos registados (29) desde 2011.


No entanto, 2026 viu o mais alto total de sempre na

Argentina

 (16) e o segundo maior no

Equador

 (16) desde que o TMM começou.


O número de assassinatos registados na

Ásia

 (32) caiu desde o mais alto de sempre do ano passado (51). O total deste ano é

muito provavelmente uma subcontagem

 – alguns parceiros na Ásia relataram não terem capacidade para fornecer dados este ano, citando falta de recursos e até mesmo de eletricidade.


13 assassinatos foram registados na Europa,

o total mais elevado desde 2023

 – tantos como 2024 e 2025 combinados. A

maioria das vítimas eram migrantes internacionais

.


Um em dez assassinatos foram registados nos

Estados Unidos

 (29), um valor semelhante a 2025 (31).


Dois em cinco (40%) dos assassinatos registados foram

a tiro

, enquanto que um quarto (24%) foram

por esfaqueamento

. Três em dez (30%) dos assassinatos ocorreram na

rua

, e um quarto (25%) ocorreram

na casa

 da própria vítima.


Dos autores dos crimes de que se tem conhecimento, um em cada quatro (25%) era um ex ou actual parceiro, namorado ou marido. Outros autores comuns dos crimes registados eram grupos/gangues organizados de ódio (15%), estranhos (14%), polícia/militares/exército (12%) e clientes de trabalhadoras do sexo (8%).


Apenas um  agressor foi preso

 em cinco assassinatos (21%) onde autoridades locais documentaram uma resposta.


Violência Interseccional


Ano após ano, o mesmo perfil demográfico de pessoas trans são assassinadas. Quase todas as vítimas registadas (95%) foram mulheres trans e pessoas transfemininas. Trabalhadoras do sexo, que fazem uma em cada três vítimas, permanecem o grupo mais atingido de todas as ocupações, e três em quatro vítimas eram pessoas Negras ou Marrom de experiência trans.


Isto é como a opressão de intersecção se parece na prática. Misoginia, transfobia, racismo, xenófobia e putofobia se reforçam …

author: TGEU
title: El Trans Murder Monitoring 2026 muestra que cada 32 horas, una persona trans fue asesinada
content:
El Monitoreo de Asesinatos de Personas Trans de TGEU (TMM por sus siglas en inglés) ha registrado 273 personas trans y de diversidad de género asesinadas en todo el mundo durante el último año, en promedio, un asesinato informado cada 32 horas. Se reportaron asesinatos en 35 países, el segundo número más alto desde que comenzó el monitoreo, y por primera vez en Rumania y Camerún. En total, el TMM ha registrado ahora más de 5,500 asesinatos en todo el mundo desde que comenzó la recopilación de datos en 2009.


TGEU – Trans Europa y Asia Central publica la actualización anual de su proyecto global de Monitoreo de Asesinatos de Personas Trans en la antesala de la Semana de Conciencia Trans, que culmina con el Día de la Remembranza Trans (TDoR por sus siglas en inglés) el 20 de noviembre.


El proyecto TMM solo cuenta los asesinatos reportados, y el trabajo de monitoreo se está volviendo más difícil. El número total de asesinatos reportados está por debajo de 300 por segunda vez en una década, pero la violencia no ha disminuido. El espacio cívico se está reduciendo, hay hostilidad hacia las personas trans desde los medios y el Estado, y los recortes de financiamiento hacen menos probable que un asesinato sea reportado y registrado. 


Conclusiones clave


Se informó que 273 personas trans y de género diverso fueron asesinadas

 entre el 1 de octubre de 2025 y el 30 de septiembre de 2026

, lo que equivale a un asesinato cada 32 horas.


35 países diferentes

 reportaron un asesinato,

el segundo número más alto hasta ahora.

 Solo en 2024 fue mayor el número de países que reportaron (38).


Una de cada tres víctimas eran trabajadoras sexuales (32%), que siguen siendo el grupo más atacado

 de todas las ocupaciones conocidas.


Siguiendo los patrones de años anteriores,

casi todos los asesinatos reportados (95%) fueron feminicidios

 (las víctimas eran mujeres trans o personas transfemeninas),

y tres cuartas partes (75%) de las víctimas eran personas trans negras o morenas.


El perfil de edad de las víctimas de homicidio parece estar cambiando hacia

edades un poco mayores.

 Más de un tercio (35%) tenía entre

31 y 40

 años en 2026, mientras que uno de cada cinco (21%) tenían entre

19 y 25

 años, siendo consistentemente el grupo de edad más grande en la primera década de TMM. Uno de cada veinte (5%) de las víctimas del último año eran

menores de 18 años.


Siete de cada diez (69%) asesinatos ocurrieron en América Latina y el Caribe.

 Brasil vuelve a liderar la lista, representando uno de cada tres (32%) del total mundial. Los números siguieron bajando en

México

, con los asesinatos más bajos reportados (29) desde 2011. Sin embargo, 2026 registró el total más alto de la historia en

Argentina

 (16) y el segundo total más alto en

Ecuador

 (16) desde que comenzó la TMM.


El número de asesinatos reportados en

Asia

 (32) cayó después del récord histórico del año pasado (51). Es probable que el total de este año esté subestimado: algunos socios de monitoreo en Asia informaron no tener capacidad para proporcionar datos este año, citando

falta de recursos

 e incluso de electricidad.


Se reportaron 13 asesinatos en Europa,

el total más alto desde 2023

, tantos como en 2024 y 2025 juntos.

La mayoría de las víctimas eran migrantes internacionales.


Uno de cada diez casos se registró en

Estados Unidos

 (29), un nivel similar al de 2025 (31).


Dos de cada cinco (40%) de los

asesinatos

 reportados fueron tiroteos, mientras que una cuarta parte (24%) fueron

apuñalamientos

. Tres de cada diez (30%) de los asesinatos ocurrieron en la calle, y una cuarta parte (25%) ocurrieron en el propio

hogar

 de la víctima.


De los perpetradores conocidos, uno de cada cuatro (25%) era una pareja, amante o cónyuge actual o anterior. Otros perpetradores comúnmente reportados fueron grupos/ pandillas de odio organizadas (15%), desconocidos (14%), policía/militares/ejército (12%) y clientes de trabajo sexual (8%).


Se arrestó a un agresor

 en solo uno de cada cinco casos (21%) donde las autoridades locales registraron una respuesta.


Violencia interseccional

author: dialogocomospovos
title: Tecnologias Espirituais
content:
Entre os dias 4 e 11 de novembro, durante um intercâmbio no Assentamento Terra Vista, Anastácio Peralta, autor do livro Tecnologias Espirituais: Reza, Roça e Sustentabilidade entre os Kaiowá e Guarani, participou de um encontro com lideranças indígenas de Mato Grosso do Sul dos povos Guarani, Kaiowá e Terena. Na ocasião, ele segurava em mãos o milho guarani branco (Avati Morontî), cultivado pela Rede de Sementes da Teia dos Povos, e explicava à liderança Mapuche Moira Milan, que visitava o território, sobre o "pai de todas as sementes".


Peralta detalhou que, para o seu povo, não existe fim do mundo enquanto houver reza, crianças nascendo e o milho produzindo. Ele narrou que Nhanderu Guassu criou o mundo e enviou um espírito com sementes nas mãos e nos pés. Enquanto esse espírito rezava, nasceu o milho sagrado Jakaira, que possui alma e é o mburuvixa (líder) de todas as sementes.


O autor explicou que essa é a essência da "ciência Kaiowá e Guarani", definida em sua obra como as negociações realizadas entre seres humanos e não humanos. Como a terra e as sementes têm alma e são tratadas como crianças, a tecnologia espiritual é aplicada em todas as etapas: na preparação do solo, no plantio e no chamamento da chuva. Na colheita, a comunidade reza por 12 horas para celebrar e manter o milho feliz, garantindo que o alimento traga alegria e que a alma da semente retorne no próximo ano. Além disso, ao ocuparem uma terra, rezam por meses para afastar maus espíritos. Dessa forma, ele demonstrou que a sustentabilidade e a própria existência dependem intrinsecamente da manutenção dessas tecnologias espirituais ancestrais.

author: Dominic Gutoman
title: Rights groups support proposed treaty on crimes against humanity
content:
Photo by Raymund B. Villanueva/Kodao Productions

Philippine-based and international human rights groups called for the adoption of the proposed Crimes Against Humanity Convention to provide more avenues for victim-survivors and strengthen accountability mechanisms against high-level perpetrators, governments, and corporations.

Crimes against humanity is the only core international crime without a dedicated treaty on prevention, punishment, and inter-state cooperation. The only international legal remedy available for the victims-survivors is the prosecution of the International Criminal Court (ICC), which is currently facing consecutive sanctions from the Donald Trump administration of the United States.

Read: US intensifies sanctions vs. ICC

The proposal of the Crimes Against Humanity Convention is one of the topics that takes center stage during the ASEAN Civil Society Conference in the Philippines this year, October 27 to 29, 2026, weeks before the official summit.

“Victims and survivors of human rights violations, wars, and genocide must have more avenues to pursue justice and accountability,” Karapatan Secretary General Cristina Palabay told Bulatlat.

Crimes against humanity are defined by the Rome Statute as acts committed as part of a widespread or systemic attack directed against any civilian population, with knowledge of the attack. This includes, but not limited to murder, extermination, enslavement, deportation or forcible transfer of population

Palabay said that the Convention is of utmost significance, especially in the quest for justice of families and communities affected by widespread extrajudicial killings during the administration of Rodrigo Duterte, who is now in ICC custody, awaiting trial starting on November 30.

The Prosecution is expected to present some witnesses, followed by the observations of the Common Legal Representative of the Victims. The Defense (Duterte’s counsel) will also have the opportunity to present its case and witnesses.

Duterte is charged with three counts of crimes against humanity — extrajudicial killings when he was the mayor of Davao City from 2013 to 2016 (Davao Death Squad killings), murder of ‘high-value targets’ across the Philippines, and the murder and attempted murder cases during the barangay clearance operations when he was President (‘Oplan Tokhang’ killings).

Rights groups monitored more than 30,000 extrajudicial killing victims of Duterte’s anti-illegal drugs campaign, which is significantly higher than the official government records of over 6,000 victims. Only five cases resulted in conviction and some of them remain on appeal.

During the ASEAN CSO conference, Jerrie Abella, Amnesty International’s regional campaigner, said that the prosecution of the perpetrator of crimes against humanity brings hope to the families of extrajudicial killings under Duterte’s so-called “drug war”.

“A mother took a long time to muster the courage to talk about her loss and to actively fight for justice. Inspired and empowered not just by the support that her newfound community offered, but also by the fact that Duterte is now in jail and awaiting trial,” said Abella.

“This is just one of the more tangible results of prosecuting an alleged perpetrator of crimes against humanity, even as we may still be years away from the actual court decision,” he added.

However, Abella enumerated several critical gaps for the accountability of the perpetrators and full justice, including Duterte’s co-perpetrators who remain free and are hiding, the national judicial system’s failure to prosecute perpetrators with only a handful of police officers convicted, and the failure of the government to prevent the crime from happening in the first place.

“Impunity persists precisely because the system we have in place allows it,” Abella said. “With this Convention, states will be obligated not just to investigate and prosecute these crimes, but also to adopt concrete measures to prevent their commission.”

A key recommendation from Amnesty International is to recognize the survivors’ right to truth in the context that disinformation happens during the anti-drug campaign until the present administration when coordinated online attacks against victims and their families have intensified.

Read: Women human rights defenders face rising tech-assisted violence

The Convention is not only relevant for the Philippines but for all countries, especially in Asia like Palestine, Myanmar …

title: YENİ Parti’de gözler 14-15 Kasım kurultayında
content:
YENİ Parti, 14-15 Kasım’da düzenleyeceği 1’inci Olağan Kurultayı’na hazırlanıyor. Genel Başkan Özgür Özel’in 150 kişiden oluşacak Parti Meclisi (PM) listesinde ekonomi, adalet, eğitim, sağlık ve çevre gibi alanlarda uzman isimlere yer vermesi bekleniyor.


ANKA'dan Gülara Subaşı'nın haberine göre, “Türkiye Yenileniyor” sloganıyla yapılacak kurultay öncesinde Özel, PM listesi ve kurultayda yapacağı konuşma için çalışmalarını sürdürüyor. Üç bölümden oluşması planlanan PM’de, parti örgütü, politika geliştirme ve yasama grupları yer alacak.


Parti kurmayları, PM listesinde yer alacak yeni isimlere ilişkin, “Alanında uzman, siyasette yeni isimler olacak” dedi.


İl başkanlarıyla görüşecek


Özel, 13 Kasım Cuma günü partisinin genel merkezinde 81 il başkanıyla bir araya gelecek. Toplantının ardından PM’nin “Parti Örgütü Grubu”nda bulunacak 40 ismin netleşmesi bekleniyor.


PM’nin 30 kişilik “Politika Geliştirme Grubu”nda ise ekonomi, adalet, eğitim, sağlık, kültür-sanat ve çevre gibi alanlarda uzman isimlerin yer alması planlanıyor. Bu yapılanmanın, Özel'in CHP Genel Başkanlığı döneminde oluşturduğu gölge kabine ve Cumhurbaşkanlığı Aday Ofisi'ne benzer bir anlayışla şekillendirilmesi bekleniyor.


77 milletvekili PM’de yer alacak


PM’nin üçüncü bölümünü ise “Parti Yasama Grubu” oluşturacak. Bu kapsamda TBMM’de grup yönetiminde görev almayan 77 YENİ Parti milletvekilinin PM’de yer alması öngörülüyor.


Özel’in, Kurucular Kurulu’nda bulunan bu isimleri PM’ye alarak “geride bırakmamak” ve bir “vefa” göstergesi ortaya koymak istediği belirtiliyor.


Eski CHP milletvekilleriyle buluşacak


Özel, 13 Kasım’da eski CHP milletvekilleriyle de bir araya gelecek. Buluşmanın, butlan tartışmaları ve YENİ Parti’ye geçiş sürecinde kendisine destek veren eski milletvekillerine teşekkür etmek ve kongrelerde üstlendikleri görevleri değerlendirmek amacıyla yapılacağı ifade ediliyor.


Kurultayda YENİ Parti’nin üç aylık mali raporu da açıklanacak. Partinin kuruluş ve işleyiş giderleri delegelerin onayına sunulacak. Genel Sayman’ın çağrısıyla isteyen yurttaşlar, parti genel merkezine giderek aidat, bağış ve faturaları inceleyebilecek.


Öte yandan parti kulislerinde, PM ve Yüksek Disiplin Kurulu (YDK) seçimlerinin blok liste yöntemiyle yapılması eğiliminin ağırlık kazandığı belirtiliyor.


(EMK)
